sql_infos.sql: SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, AVG(gat.age) AS avg_age FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age_train gat ON e.device_id = gat.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ae.is_active = 1 AND gat.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM phone_brand_device_model2 WHERE phone_brand = 'Xiaomi') GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 25 ORDER BY app_count DESC;

SELECT e.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, AVG(ae.is_active) AS avg_active_rate, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY ga.age ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_apps FROM events e JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 19 AND ga.age <= 58 GROUP BY e.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 16 ORDER BY ga.age DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS cross_event_count, AVG(e2.longitude - e1.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e2.latitude - e1.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.event_id != e2.event_id JOIN app_events ae1 ON e1.event_id = ae1.event_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON e2.event_id = ae2.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e1.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ga.age >= 74 GROUP BY e1.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) > 65 ORDER BY cross_event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND g.age >= 57 AND g.age <= 32 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 76 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -59.25 AND 13.26 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 37 AND AVG(e.latitude) < 83.6 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ( e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = g.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' ) ) AND g.age BETWEEN 38 AND 57 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 3 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND g.age >= 45 AND g.age <= 33 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 845 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -52.3 AND 164.91 AND g.age >= 44 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 51 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -142.98 AND 83.49 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 63 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps_installed, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels_used, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id WHERE ga.age >= 63 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 30 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 37 AND 31 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.latitude > 54.0 AND e.longitude < -153.46 AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 59 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 28 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_latitude ASC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps_count, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_install_rate, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS app_categories FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 28 AND 54 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -129.2 AND -174.87 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -29.47 AND -84.36 AND ga.device_id IN ( SELECT device_id FROM gender_age_train WHERE age > 40 AND gender = 'F' GROUP BY device_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 6 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 17 ORDER BY total_events DESC, active_apps_count DESC LIMIT 706;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age > 61 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 26 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, (SELECT AVG(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = ga.device_id) AS avg_f23 FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 33 AND ga.age <= 56 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -8.51 AND -13.18 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -38.54 AND 68.63 AND ga.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM gender_age_train WHERE age > 41 AND gender = 'F') GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 1 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 19 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(aer.is_active) FROM app_events_relevant aer JOIN events_relevant er2 ON aer.event_id = er2.event_id WHERE er2.device_id = ga.device_id AND er2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_active_ratio FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-04-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -73.17 AND 103.56 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -62.35 AND -75.9 AND ga.age >= 65 AND ga.age <= 33 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 87 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 28 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, total_installs DESC LIMIT 407;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, (SELECT MAX(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = ga.device_id) AS max_f23, (SELECT MIN(s.m39) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = ga.device_id) AS min_m39 FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -158.5 AND 125.2 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 19.15 AND -1.05 AND ae.is_installed > 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp < e.timestamp AND er.longitude IS NOT NULL AND er.latitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY er.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 371 ) AND ga.age BETWEEN 9 AND 95 AND ga.gender = 'F' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 29 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 322 AND SUM(ae.is_active) < 8739 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC LIMIT 34;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, (SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = ga.device_id) AS last_event_time, (SELECT MIN(timestamp) FROM events e3 WHERE e3.device_id = ga.device_id) AS first_event_time FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -11.28 AND -101.66 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -21.79 AND -46.25 AND ga.age >= 15 AND ga.age <= 99 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app_events_relevant aer WHERE aer.event_id = e.event_id AND aer.is_installed = 1) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 195 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 339 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 372 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(e.latitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, total_installs DESC LIMIT 711;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps_interacted, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_and_active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ga.age < 25 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS young_user_flag, SUM(CASE WHEN ga.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_flag, SUM(CASE WHEN ga.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_flag, (COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id), 0)) AS apps_per_event_ratio, (SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS active_to_installed_ratio FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 44 AND ga.age <= 55 AND e.longitude >= 98.53 AND e.longitude <= 178.54 AND e.latitude >= -47.04 AND e.latitude <= -13.12 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 616 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 232 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 28 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps_interacted DESC LIMIT 6100;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_installs, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.app_id) FROM app_events_relevant aer JOIN app_all a2 ON aer.app_id = a2.app_id WHERE aer.event_id = e.event_id AND aer.is_installed = 1) AS installed_apps_per_event, (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) FROM app_labels al2 JOIN label_categories lc ON al2.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE al2.app_id = ae.app_id) AS app_categories FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id WHERE (e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' OR e.longitude > 145.84 OR e.latitude < 22.73) AND ga.age BETWEEN 34 AND 45 AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gender_age_train gat WHERE gat.device_id = ga.device_id AND gat.gender = 'F') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gender_age_test gatest WHERE gatest.device_id = ga.device_id)) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, e.event_id, ae.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 85 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 19 ORDER BY total_events DESC, ga.age ASC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, DATE(e.timestamp) AS event_date, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS daily_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS daily_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS daily_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS daily_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS daily_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS label_categories, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.device_id ORDER BY DATE(e.timestamp) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '169' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_event_count, AVG(SUM(ae.is_active)) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand ORDER BY DATE(e.timestamp) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '70' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_active_by_group_brand FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.timestamp < '2016-02-01' AND ga.age >= 39 AND ga.age <= 24 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, DATE(e.timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 62 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 43 ORDER BY event_date DESC, daily_events DESC, ga.device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1) AS active_installs, SUM(ae.is_installed * ae.is_active) AS weighted_activity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_per_group, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ae.is_installed) DESC) AS install_dense_rank FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-02-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -101.9 AND 128.47 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -21.98 AND 81.46 AND ga.age >= 24 AND ga.age <= 52 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category), (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model), (ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand), (ga.gender, ga.group1, lc.category), (lc.category, ae.app_id), (ga.group1), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 38 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 30 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude, avg_latitude;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 32 AND ga.age <= 26 AND ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.app_id IN ( SELECT app_id FROM app_labels WHERE label_id IN ( SELECT label_id FROM label_categories WHERE category = 'Communication' ) ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 2 ORDER BY installed_apps DESC, active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp) AS event_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) AS event_quarter FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.timestamp < '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude > 9.73 AND e.latitude > 12.7 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 30 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 15 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank_by_gender FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 19 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING SUM(ae.is_active) > 55 ORDER BY app_rank_by_gender, total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 38 AND 50 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.latitude BETWEEN 88.78 AND -72.11 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 22 AND AVG(e.longitude) > -79.79 ORDER BY installed_apps DESC, active_apps DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 62 AND 24 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.latitude BETWEEN 81.55 AND -35.12 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 38 AND AVG(e.longitude) > -68.35 ORDER BY installed_apps DESC, active_apps DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM gender_age ga LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id LEFT JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 37 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND (e.longitude BETWEEN 140.57 AND 138.59 OR e.longitude IS NULL) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 14 ORDER BY event_count DESC, last_event_time DESC LIMIT 831;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp) AS event_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) AS event_quarter FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2017-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 65.65 AND 70.81 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -29.83 AND -14.52 AND ga.age >= 49 AND ga.age <= 72 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 632 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_latitude ASC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) FROM app_labels al WHERE al.app_id = ae.app_id) AS label_count_per_app FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 34 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 3 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps_sum, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE pbdm.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' AND ga.age > 45 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 29 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 21 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, SUM(ae.is_active * ae.is_installed) AS active_installed_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank_by_gender, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_dense_rank FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 26 AND ga.age <= 48 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) >= 128 UNION ALL SELECT gat.device_id, 'UNKNOWN' AS gender, 'UNKNOWN' AS group1, COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN aer.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN aer.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT er.event_id) AS total_events, MIN(er.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(er.timestamp) AS last_event_time, AVG(er.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(er.latitude) AS avg_latitude, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, SUM(aer.is_active * aer.is_installed) AS active_installed_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY 'UNKNOWN' ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank_by_gender, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT er.event_id) DESC) AS event_dense_rank FROM gender_age_test gat JOIN events_relevant er ON gat.device_id = er.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON er.event_id = aer.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON aer.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON gat.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND er.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY gat.device_id, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) > 97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT er.event_id) >= 867 ORDER BY total_events DESC, app_rank_by_gender ASC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-02 00:00:00' ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae INNER JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_active = 1 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 27 AND g.age <= 63 ), app_label_categories AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al INNER JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 282 ), complex_join AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.event_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, daa.app_id, daa.is_installed, daa.is_active, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, alc.category, ss.f23, ss.m22 FROM ranked_events re INNER JOIN device_app_activity daa ON re.event_id = daa.event_id LEFT JOIN device_demographics dd ON re.device_id = dd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_label_categories alc ON daa.app_id = alc.app_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON re.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE re.rn = 1 ) SELECT cj.gender, cj.phone_brand, cj.category, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.event_id) AS unique_events, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.app_id) AS unique_apps, AVG(cj.age) AS avg_age, SUM(cj.is_active) AS total_active, SUM(cj.f23) AS sum_f23, SUM(cj.m22) AS sum_m22, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cj.latitude) AS median_latitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cj.longitude) AS median_longitude FROM complex_join cj GROUP BY cj.gender, cj.phone_brand, cj.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cj.device_id) > 255 AND AVG(cj.age) BETWEEN 22.37 AND 34.55 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, avg_age ASC LIMIT 178;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 74.31 AND 3.5 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' ) SELECT phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, category, COUNT(*) AS event_count, SUM(is_active) AS active_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM ranked_events WHERE rn <= 44 AND age >= 59 GROUP BY phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, category HAVING COUNT(*) > 820 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ae.is_active = 0 GROUP BY e.device_id ORDER BY app_count DESC;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ae.is_active = 1 GROUP BY e.device_id ORDER BY app_count DESC;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM events e LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -140.46 AND 12.87 GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) < 90 ORDER BY app_count DESC, last_event_time DESC;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM events e LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id AND ae.is_installed = 1 LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude > -64.4 GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) < 20 ORDER BY installed_apps DESC;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS cross_event_count, AVG(e2.longitude - e1.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e2.latitude - e1.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.event_id != e2.event_id JOIN app_events ae1 ON e1.event_id = ae1.event_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON e2.event_id = ae2.event_id JOIN app_labels al1 ON ae1.app_id = al1.app_id JOIN app_labels al2 ON ae2.app_id = al2.app_id JOIN label_categories lc1 ON al1.label_id = lc1.label_id JOIN label_categories lc2 ON al2.label_id = lc2.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e1.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 34 GROUP BY e1.device_id, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) > 25 ORDER BY cross_event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.age) AS gender_age_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS install_rank FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -67.95 AND 75.99 AND ga.age >= 59 AND ga.age <= 26 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 53 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 491 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.age) AS gender_age_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS install_rank FROM gender_age_train ga JOIN events_relevant e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -92.78 AND 61.18 AND ga.age >= 45 AND ga.age <= 25 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 75 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 106 ORDER BY install_rank, last_event_time DESC;

ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, SUM(CASE WHEN pb.phone_brand = 'Samsung' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_brand_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.device_model) AS distinct_models, SUM(CASE WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 19 AND 31 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ga.gender = 'F' THEN ae.is_active ELSE 0 END) AS gender_active_sum, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM e.timestamp) IN (0, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_events, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM e.timestamp) BETWEEN 14 AND 16 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hour_window_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_train gat ON ga.device_id = gat.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_test gatest ON ga.device_id = gatest.device_id LEFT JOIN events_relevant er ON e.event_id = er.event_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON ae.event_id = aer.event_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-02 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -63.24 AND -10.14 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -89.33 AND -37.27 AND ga.age > 7 AND (gat.device_id IS NOT NULL OR gatest.device_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 4 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 63 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 28 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude, avg_latitude LIMIT 1788;

WITH combined_events AS ( SELECT e.event_id, e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude FROM events e UNION ALL SELECT er.event_id, er.device_id, er.timestamp, er.longitude, er.latitude FROM events_relevant er ), device_info AS ( SELECT d.device_id, d.phone_brand, d.device_model, COALESCE(gt.age, ga.age) AS age, COALESCE(gt.gender, ga.gender) AS gender, COALESCE(gt.group1, ga.group1) AS group1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 d LEFT JOIN gender_age_train gt ON d.device_id = gt.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON d.device_id = ga.device_id ), app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.event_id, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active FROM app_events ae UNION ALL SELECT aer.event_id, aer.app_id, aer.is_installed, aer.is_active FROM app_events_relevant aer ), labeled_apps AS ( SELECT al.app_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id ) SELECT di.phone_brand, di.device_model, di.age, di.gender, la.category, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.app_id) FILTER (WHERE aa.is_installed = 1) AS installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.app_id) FILTER (WHERE aa.is_active = 1) AS active_apps, AVG(ce.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(ce.latitude) AS avg_latitude, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score FROM combined_events ce JOIN device_info di ON ce.device_id = di.device_id JOIN app_activity aa ON ce.event_id = aa.event_id JOIN labeled_apps la ON aa.app_id = la.app_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ce.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE ce.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ce.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND di.age BETWEEN 26 AND 54 AND ce.longitude BETWEEN 146.16 AND 7.44 AND ce.latitude BETWEEN -2.52 AND -4.71 GROUP BY di.phone_brand, di.device_model, di.age, di.gender, la.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) > 693 AND COUNT(DISTINCT aa.app_id) FILTER (WHERE aa.is_installed = 1) >= 81 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_submission_score DESC LIMIT 83;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 106.02 AND -26.75 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 44.4 AND -58.01 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 0 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 375 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 38 AND g.gender = 'F' ), event_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 95 GROUP BY re.device_id ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(das.is_active) AS total_active_apps, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dd.gender ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC) AS event_rank_by_gender FROM device_demographics dd JOIN event_aggregates ea ON dd.device_id = ea.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON das.app_id = ald.app_id WHERE ea.total_events > 284 GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) >= 31 ORDER BY app_rank, event_rank_by_gender LIMIT 6246;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -79.94 AND -101.15 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -64.55 AND -44.2 AND ae.is_active = 0 AND ga.age >= 48 AND ga.age <= 98 ), aggregated_stats AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT re.label_id) AS distinct_labels, SUM(re.is_installed) AS total_installs, AVG(re.age) AS avg_age, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(re.timestamp) AS first_event_time, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.latitude) AS median_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 237 GROUP BY re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) > 27 AND AVG(re.age) BETWEEN 58.02 AND 26.72 ), windowed_analysis AS ( SELECT as1.*, LAG(as1.distinct_apps, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.phone_brand, as1.gender ORDER BY as1.avg_age) AS prev_distinct_apps, LEAD(as1.total_installs, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.device_model, as1.group1 ORDER BY as1.last_event_time) AS next_total_installs, SUM(as1.distinct_labels) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.phone_brand ORDER BY as1.avg_age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_labels, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY as1.gender ORDER BY as1.distinct_apps DESC) AS rank_by_apps FROM aggregated_stats as1 JOIN events_relevant er ON as1.device_id = er.device_id WHERE er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND er.timestamp <= '2016-01-01' ) SELECT wa.phone_brand, wa.device_model, wa.gender, wa.group1, wa.distinct_apps, wa.distinct_labels, wa.total_installs, wa.avg_age, wa.last_event_time, wa.first_event_time, wa.median_longitude, wa.median_latitude, wa.prev_distinct_apps, wa.next_total_installs, wa.running_total_labels, wa.rank_by_apps, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY wa.phone_brand, wa.gender) AS count_per_brand_gender, AVG(wa.distinct_apps) OVER (PARTITION BY wa.device_model ORDER BY wa.avg_age ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_apps FROM windowed_analysis wa LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON wa.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE wa.rank_by_apps <= 41 AND wa.running_total_labels > 2223 ORDER BY wa.rank_by_apps, wa.running_total_labels DESC LIMIT 2142;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ) SELECT phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS unique_devices, AVG(age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, SUM(CASE WHEN is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_events FROM ranked_events WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1 HAVING AVG(age) > 29 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC LIMIT 62;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e1.event_id, e1.device_id, e1.timestamp, e1.longitude, e1.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e1.device_id ORDER BY e1.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e1 WHERE e1.longitude BETWEEN 76.27 AND -35.69 ), device_app_metrics AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, re.device_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude FROM app_events ae JOIN ranked_events re ON ae.event_id = re.event_id WHERE re.rn = 1 ), brand_model_agg AS ( SELECT pbd.device_id, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT dam.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(dam.is_active) AS total_active_apps FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbd LEFT JOIN device_app_metrics dam ON pbd.device_id = dam.device_id GROUP BY pbd.device_id, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model ), gender_age_enhanced AS ( SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, bma.phone_brand, bma.device_model, bma.distinct_app_count, bma.total_active_apps, CASE WHEN ga.age < 20 THEN 'teen' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 20 AND 35 THEN 'young_adult' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN 'middle_aged' ELSE 'senior' END AS age_group FROM gender_age ga JOIN brand_model_agg bma ON ga.device_id = bma.device_id WHERE ga.age >= 33 ), label_category_agg AS ( SELECT al.app_id, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id ), app_behavior AS ( SELECT dam.device_id, dam.app_id, aa.app_id AS app_exists, lca.categories, dam.is_installed, dam.is_active, dam.timestamp, dam.longitude, dam.latitude FROM device_app_metrics dam LEFT JOIN app_all aa ON dam.app_id = aa.app_id LEFT JOIN label_category_agg lca ON dam.app_id = lca.app_id ), final_aggregation AS ( SELECT gae.age_group, gae.gender, gae.phone_brand, gae.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.app_id) FILTER (WHERE ab.is_installed = 1) AS installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.app_id) FILTER (WHERE ab.is_active = 1) AS active_apps, AVG(gae.distinct_app_count) AS avg_distinct_apps_per_device, SUM(gae.total_active_apps) AS total_active_apps_across_devices, MAX(ab.timestamp) AS latest_event_timestamp, MIN(ab.timestamp) AS earliest_event_timestamp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gae.age) AS median_age FROM gender_age_enhanced gae LEFT JOIN app_behavior ab ON gae.device_id = ab.device_id WHERE gae.age <= 74 GROUP BY gae.age_group, gae.gender, gae.phone_brand, gae.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ab.device_id) > 100 ) SELECT fa.age_group, fa.gender, fa.phone_brand, fa.device_model, fa.unique_devices, fa.installed_apps, fa.active_apps, fa.avg_distinct_apps_per_device, fa.total_active_apps_across_devices, fa.latest_event_timestamp, fa.earliest_event_timestamp, fa.median_age, ss.f23, ss.m22, (fa.unique_devices * 1.0 / NULLIF(ss.f23 + ss.m22, 0)) AS device_to_submission_ratio FROM final_aggregation fa LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON fa.unique_devices = ss.device_id ORDER BY fa.total_active_apps_across_devices DESC, fa.unique_devices DESC LIMIT 548;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e1.event_id, e1.device_id, e1.timestamp, e1.longitude, e1.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e1.device_id ORDER BY e1.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e1 WHERE e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e1.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.event_id, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_active = 0 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id >= 737 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age BETWEEN 46 AND 56 ), event_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM ranked_events re GROUP BY re.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) > 37 ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(daa.is_installed) AS total_installed, SUM(daa.is_active) AS total_active, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39 FROM device_demographics dd JOIN event_aggregates ea ON dd.device_id = ea.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_activity daa ON re.event_id = daa.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON daa.app_id = ald.app_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON dd.device_id = ss.device_id GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) >= 38 ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC, dd.age ASC LIMIT 205;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e1.event_id, e1.device_id, e1.timestamp, e1.longitude, e1.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e1.device_id ORDER BY e1.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e1 WHERE e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e1.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ), device_app_metrics AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, re.device_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model FROM app_events ae JOIN ranked_events re ON ae.event_id = re.event_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON re.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON re.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE re.rn = 1 ), app_label_aggregates AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id ), complex_join AS ( SELECT dam.device_id, dam.app_id, dam.age, dam.gender, dam.group1, dam.phone_brand, dam.device_model, dam.timestamp, dam.longitude, dam.latitude, ala.distinct_labels, ala.label_categories, aa.app_id AS all_app_id, CASE WHEN dam.is_active = 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN dam.is_installed = 1 THEN 'Installed' ELSE 'None' END AS app_status, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY dam.device_id) AS apps_per_device, AVG(dam.age) OVER (PARTITION BY dam.phone_brand, dam.device_model) AS avg_age_by_model FROM device_app_metrics dam JOIN app_label_aggregates ala ON dam.app_id = ala.app_id LEFT JOIN app_all aa ON dam.app_id = aa.app_id WHERE dam.age BETWEEN 63 AND 42 ), final_aggregation AS ( SELECT cj.device_id, cj.phone_brand, cj.device_model, cj.gender, cj.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(cj.distinct_labels) AS total_labels, MAX(cj.apps_per_device) AS max_apps_per_device, AVG(cj.avg_age_by_model) AS overall_avg_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cj.age) AS median_age, BOOL_OR(CASE WHEN cj.app_status = 'Active' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS has_active_app FROM complex_join cj GROUP BY cj.device_id, cj.phone_brand, cj.device_model, cj.gender, cj.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cj.app_id) > 43 AND AVG(cj.avg_age_by_model) < 59.69 ) SELECT fa.device_id, fa.phone_brand, fa.device_model, fa.gender, fa.group1, fa.total_apps, fa.total_labels, fa.max_apps_per_device, fa.overall_avg_age, fa.median_age, fa.has_active_app, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fa.total_apps DESC, fa.total_labels DESC) AS overall_rank FROM final_aggregation fa LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON fa.device_id = ss.device_id ORDER BY overall_rank, fa.device_id LIMIT 8382;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM events e LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id AND ae.is_installed = 1 LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude > -10.63 GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) < 22 ORDER BY last_event_time DESC;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS related_event_count, AVG(e2.longitude - e1.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e2.latitude - e1.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.timestamp < e2.timestamp AND e1.event_id != e2.event_id WHERE e1.longitude BETWEEN 104.39 AND -70.52 AND e1.latitude BETWEEN 5.19 AND -14.25 AND e2.timestamp >= e1.timestamp + INTERVAL '293 hour' GROUP BY e1.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) > 271 ORDER BY related_event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model FROM gender_age ga LEFT JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -178.23 AND 4.37 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 571 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS rank_by_apps_in_demographic FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 63 AND ga.age <= 58 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 94 ORDER BY rank_by_apps_in_demographic, ga.device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_installed FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age > 77 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.device_id IN ( SELECT device_id FROM events_relevant WHERE longitude BETWEEN -52.92 AND -129.7 ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 2 ORDER BY total_active DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installed, GROUPING(ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand) AS grouping_id FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 44 AND ga.age <= 41 GROUP BY CUBE(ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand), ga.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 92 ORDER BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 30 AND ga.age <= 61 GROUP BY CUBE(ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ga.device_id) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 43 ORDER BY total_events DESC, ga.device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 38 AND ga.age <= 34 GROUP BY CUBE(ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ga.device_id) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 29 ORDER BY total_events DESC, ga.device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand, ', ') AS phone_brands, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.device_model, ', ') AS device_models, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS label_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp BETWEEN '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS relevant_event_count, (SELECT AVG(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = ga.device_id AND s.f23 > '0.0') AS avg_sample_f23 FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN gender_age_train gat ON ga.device_id = gat.device_id JOIN gender_age_test gatest ON ga.device_id = gatest.device_id WHERE ( (e.longitude BETWEEN 169.9 AND 173.04 OR e.latitude BETWEEN -47.6 AND 73.84) AND e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND (ae.is_installed = 1 OR ae.is_active = 1) AND NOT (ga.gender = 'F' AND ga.age < 95) AND ga.group1 IN ('F23-', 'F23-', 'F23-') AND pb.phone_brand NOT LIKE '%Apple%' AND (lc.category = 'Game' OR lc.category IS NULL) ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 803 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 78 AND AVG(e.latitude) <> 56.83 AND (MAX(e.timestamp) - MIN(e.timestamp)) > INTERVAL '27 days' ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS label_categories, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, (MAX(e.timestamp) - MIN(e.timestamp)) AS event_time_span, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id), 0.0) AS active_app_ratio, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY ga.age) AS prev_event_count_by_gender_age FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_train gat ON ga.device_id = gat.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_test gatest ON ga.device_id = gatest.device_id LEFT JOIN events_relevant er ON e.event_id = er.event_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON ae.event_id = aer.event_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -74.44 AND -71.9 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 71.57 AND -0.58 AND ga.age >= 37 AND ga.age <= 85 AND (pb.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' OR pb.device_model LIKE '%Galaxy%') AND (ga.gender = 'F' OR ga.group1 LIKE '%F%') AND lc.category LIKE '%Game%' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 735 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 2 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 25 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(e.latitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, ga.device_id LIMIT 3397;

WITH device_aggregates AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, COUNT(*) AS total_events, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT COALESCE(ga.device_id, gat.device_id) AS device_id, COALESCE(ga.age, 0) AS age, COALESCE(ga.gender, 'unknown') AS gender, COALESCE(ga.group1, 'unknown') AS demographic_group, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model FROM gender_age ga FULL OUTER JOIN gender_age_train gat ON ga.device_id = gat.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON COALESCE(ga.device_id, gat.device_id) = pb.device_id ), app_label_analysis AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM app_events ae JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY ae.app_id ) SELECT dd.demographic_group, dd.gender, CASE WHEN dd.age < 20 THEN 'under_20' WHEN dd.age BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN '20_30' WHEN dd.age BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN '31_40' WHEN dd.age > 40 THEN 'over_40' ELSE 'unknown' END AS age_group, dd.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) AS device_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ala.app_id) AS total_apps_used, SUM(da.distinct_apps) AS sum_distinct_apps, AVG(da.distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, SUM(da.active_apps) AS total_active_apps, SUM(da.installed_apps) AS total_installed_apps, SUM(da.total_events) AS grand_total_events, MIN(da.first_event) AS earliest_event, MAX(da.last_event) AS latest_event, CORR(da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude) AS geo_correlation FROM device_aggregates da JOIN device_demographics dd ON da.device_id = dd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON da.device_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_analysis ala ON ae.app_id = ala.app_id WHERE dd.age >= 72 AND dd.age <= 21 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (dd.demographic_group, dd.gender, age_group, dd.phone_brand), (dd.demographic_group, dd.gender, age_group), (dd.demographic_group, dd.gender), (dd.demographic_group), (dd.phone_brand), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) > 865 ORDER BY device_count DESC, demographic_group, gender, age_group, phone_brand LIMIT 9684;

WITH device_aggregates AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installed, COUNT(*) AS total_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 39 AND g.age <= 78 ), app_label_analysis AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 16 ), device_app_label_summary AS ( SELECT da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active, da.total_installed, da.total_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, da.first_event, da.last_event, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ala.app_id) AS apps_with_many_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ala.label_categories, ' | ') AS aggregated_categories FROM device_aggregates da JOIN device_demographics dd ON da.device_id = dd.device_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON da.device_id = ae2.event_id JOIN app_label_analysis ala ON ae2.app_id = ala.app_id GROUP BY da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active, da.total_installed, da.total_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, da.first_event, da.last_event, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model ) SELECT gender, group1, phone_brand, device_model, COUNT(device_id) AS device_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, AVG(total_active) AS avg_total_active, AVG(total_installed) AS avg_total_installed, SUM(total_events) AS grand_total_events, MIN(first_event) AS earliest_event, MAX(last_event) AS latest_event, AVG(avg_longitude) AS avg_center_longitude, AVG(avg_latitude) AS avg_center_latitude, SUM(apps_with_many_labels) AS total_apps_many_labels, MAX(aggregated_categories) AS sample_categories FROM device_app_label_summary GROUP BY gender, group1, phone_brand, device_model HAVING COUNT(device_id) > 24 AND AVG(distinct_apps) >= 33.8 ORDER BY device_count DESC, avg_distinct_apps DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, al.label_id, lc.category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -67.23 AND -118.31 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ga.age >= 36 ) SELECT phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, category, COUNT(*) AS event_count, SUM(is_active) AS active_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM ranked_events WHERE rn <= 95 GROUP BY phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, category HAVING COUNT(*) > 203 ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 82;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM events e LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -113.06 AND 175.28 GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 56 ORDER BY app_count DESC;

SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, AVG(ae.is_active) OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_active, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_event_count FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 56 GROUP BY e.device_id, e.timestamp, ae.is_active ORDER BY e.device_id, e.timestamp;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS related_event_count, AVG(e2.longitude - e1.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e2.latitude - e1.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.event_id != e2.event_id JOIN app_events ae ON e2.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e1.longitude > 106.91 GROUP BY e1.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) > 69 ORDER BY related_event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -165.67 AND 156.39 AND lc.category = 'A' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 208 AND AVG(e.longitude) < -82.39 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -35.49 AND 12.53 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 59 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 6 ORDER BY event_count DESC, g.device_id;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -134.15 AND 82.22 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_all aa WHERE aa.app_id = ae.app_id LIMIT 1 OFFSET 312 ) AND lc.category = 'A' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 40 ORDER BY total_events DESC, g.device_id;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, (MAX(e.timestamp) - MIN(e.timestamp)) AS event_time_span, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id), 0)::numeric AS active_event_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY g.gender, g.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_demographic FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -152.76 AND -129.41 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 10.92 AND 9.3 AND g.age >= 73 AND g.age <= 52 AND ae.is_installed >= 1 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 94561 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 1387 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 67967 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_active DESC LIMIT 665;
