SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand) AS distinct_brands, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.device_model) AS distinct_models, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS distinct_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, MAX(ga.age) AS max_age FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 55 AND ga.age <= 41 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 93.82 AND 79.8 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 10.45 AND 71.57 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand) > 5 ORDER BY distinct_apps DESC, distinct_labels DESC, distinct_brands DESC LIMIT 249;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 34 AND ga.age <= 26 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 68 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 96 ORDER BY unique_apps_installed DESC, total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 36 AND ga.age <= 47 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 83 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 465 ORDER BY unique_apps_installed DESC, total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, MAX(pb.phone_brand) AS phone_brand, MAX(pb.device_model) AS device_model FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 119.95 AND -176.64 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 41.85 AND -48.46 AND ga.age >= 70 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 38 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 781 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_installs DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, SUM(CASE WHEN pb.phone_brand = 'Samsung' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_brand_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.device_model) AS distinct_device_models, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_and_active_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN e.longitude > -128.23 AND e.latitude > 0.22 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS events_in_high_coords, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 AND al.label_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps_with_labels FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_train gat ON ga.device_id = gat.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_test gatest ON ga.device_id = gatest.device_id LEFT JOIN events_relevant er ON e.event_id = er.event_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON ae.event_id = aer.event_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND (gat.age >= 55 OR gat.age IS NULL) AND (e.longitude BETWEEN -59.03 AND 46.96 OR e.longitude IS NULL) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 389 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 86 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 28 ORDER BY total_events DESC, installed_apps DESC;

WITH device_activity AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 AND ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 'active_installed' WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 'installed_only' ELSE 'inactive' END AS app_status, CASE WHEN ga.age < 20 THEN 'teen' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 20 AND 35 THEN 'young_adult' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN 'middle_aged' ELSE 'senior' END AS age_group, CASE WHEN lc.category IN ('Social', 'Communication') THEN 'social_category' WHEN lc.category IN ('Game', 'Entertainment') THEN 'entertainment_category' ELSE 'other_category' END AS app_category_group FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-02 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -10.02 AND 74.19 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -11.02 AND 86.92 AND ga.age >= 56 ) SELECT da.phone_brand, da.device_model, da.gender, da.age_group, da.app_category_group, COUNT(DISTINCT da.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT da.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN da.app_status = 'active_installed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_installed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN da.app_status = 'installed_only' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_only_count, AVG(da.age) AS avg_age, MIN(da.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(da.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM device_activity da GROUP BY da.phone_brand, da.device_model, da.gender, da.age_group, da.app_category_group HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT da.event_id) > 1988 AND COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) >= 816 ORDER BY total_events DESC, unique_devices DESC LIMIT 131;

WITH device_aggregates AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, COUNT(*) AS total_events, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 15 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT COALESCE(ga.device_id, gat.device_id) AS device_id, COALESCE(ga.age, 0) AS age, COALESCE(ga.gender, 'unknown') AS gender, COALESCE(ga.group1, 'unknown') AS demographic_group, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model FROM gender_age ga FULL OUTER JOIN gender_age_train gat ON ga.device_id = gat.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON COALESCE(ga.device_id, gat.device_id) = pb.device_id ), app_label_analysis AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM app_events ae JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY ae.app_id ) SELECT dd.demographic_group, dd.gender, CASE WHEN dd.age < 20 THEN 'under_20' WHEN dd.age BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN '20_30' WHEN dd.age BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN '31_40' WHEN dd.age > 40 THEN 'over_40' ELSE 'unknown' END AS age_group, dd.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) AS device_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ala.app_id) AS total_apps_used, SUM(da.distinct_apps) AS sum_distinct_apps, AVG(da.distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, SUM(da.active_apps) AS total_active_apps, SUM(da.installed_apps) AS total_installed_apps, SUM(da.total_events) AS grand_total_events, MIN(da.first_event) AS earliest_event, MAX(da.last_event) AS latest_event, CORR(da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude) AS geo_correlation FROM device_aggregates da JOIN device_demographics dd ON da.device_id = dd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON da.device_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_analysis ala ON ae.app_id = ala.app_id WHERE dd.age >= 47 AND dd.age <= 40 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (dd.demographic_group, dd.gender, age_group, dd.phone_brand), (dd.demographic_group, dd.gender, age_group), (dd.demographic_group, dd.gender), (dd.demographic_group), (dd.phone_brand), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) > 1 ORDER BY device_count DESC, demographic_group, gender, age_group, phone_brand LIMIT 2781;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -44.69 AND -83.73 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 45.31 AND 73.78 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, re.device_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude FROM app_events ae JOIN ranked_events re ON ae.event_id = re.event_id WHERE re.rn <= 29 AND ae.is_installed = 1 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category, daa.device_id, daa.timestamp, daa.is_active FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN device_app_activity daa ON al.app_id = daa.app_id WHERE lc.category IN ('A', 'A') ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT gat.device_id, gat.age, gat.gender, gat.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ald.category, ald.timestamp, ald.is_active FROM gender_age_train gat JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON gat.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON gat.device_id = ald.device_id WHERE gat.age >= 40 AND gat.age <= 23 ), aggregated_metrics AS ( SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT dd.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(CASE WHEN dd.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps_count, AVG(dd.age) OVER (PARTITION BY dd.phone_brand, dd.gender) AS avg_age_by_brand_gender, MAX(dd.timestamp) AS last_activity_time FROM device_demographics dd GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model ), final_join AS ( SELECT am.device_id, am.age, am.gender, am.group1, am.phone_brand, am.device_model, am.distinct_categories, am.active_apps_count, am.avg_age_by_brand_gender, am.last_activity_time, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY am.active_apps_count DESC, am.distinct_categories DESC) AS activity_rank FROM aggregated_metrics am LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON am.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE am.active_apps_count > 492 AND am.distinct_categories >= 10 ) SELECT device_id, age, gender, group1, phone_brand, device_model, distinct_categories, active_apps_count, avg_age_by_brand_gender, last_activity_time, f23, f24_26, f27_28, f29_32, f33_42, f43, m22, m23_26, m27_28, m29_31, m32_38, m39, activity_rank FROM final_join ORDER BY activity_rank, last_activity_time DESC LIMIT 732;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-02 00:00:00' ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae INNER JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_active = 1 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 18 AND g.age <= 57 ), app_label_categories AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al INNER JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 986 ), complex_join AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.event_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, daa.app_id, daa.is_installed, daa.is_active, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, alc.category, ss.f23, ss.m22 FROM ranked_events re INNER JOIN device_app_activity daa ON re.event_id = daa.event_id LEFT JOIN device_demographics dd ON re.device_id = dd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_label_categories alc ON daa.app_id = alc.app_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON re.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE re.rn = 1 ) SELECT cj.gender, cj.phone_brand, cj.category, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.event_id) AS unique_events, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.app_id) AS unique_apps, AVG(cj.age) AS avg_age, SUM(cj.is_active) AS total_active, SUM(cj.f23) AS sum_f23, SUM(cj.m22) AS sum_m22, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cj.latitude) AS median_latitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cj.longitude) AS median_longitude FROM complex_join cj GROUP BY cj.gender, cj.phone_brand, cj.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cj.device_id) > 433 AND AVG(cj.age) BETWEEN 26.31 AND 49.97 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, avg_age ASC LIMIT 5574;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS event_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand ORDER BY e.timestamp) AS group_brand_rank FROM events e INNER JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id INNER JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id INNER JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON e.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 119.11 AND 104.52 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ga.age >= 34 ) SELECT phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, category, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS unique_devices, SUM(is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(is_active) AS total_active, AVG(age) AS avg_age, MAX(f23) AS max_f23, MIN(m22) AS min_m22, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f24_26) AS median_f24_26 FROM ranked_events WHERE event_rank <= 27 AND group_brand_rank > 413 GROUP BY phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) > 73 AND AVG(age) < 38 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, total_active DESC LIMIT 787;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -82.15 AND -37.44 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -43.72 AND -3.27 AND ae.is_active = 1 AND ga.age >= 52 AND ga.age <= 2 ), aggregated_labels AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.age, re.gender, re.group1, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT re.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT re.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(CASE WHEN re.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN re.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 17 GROUP BY re.device_id, re.age, re.gender, re.group1, re.phone_brand, re.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.label_id) > 272 ), device_summary AS ( SELECT al.device_id, al.age, al.gender, al.group1, al.phone_brand, al.device_model, al.distinct_labels, al.distinct_categories, al.installed_apps, al.active_apps, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY al.distinct_labels DESC, al.active_apps DESC) AS label_rank FROM aggregated_labels al LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON al.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE al.installed_apps >= 4082 ) SELECT ds.device_id, ds.age, ds.gender, ds.group1, ds.phone_brand, ds.device_model, ds.distinct_labels, ds.distinct_categories, ds.installed_apps, ds.active_apps, ds.label_rank, COALESCE(ds.f23, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f24_26, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f27_28, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f29_32, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f33_42, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f43, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m22, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m23_26, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m27_28, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m29_31, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m32_38, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m39, 0) AS total_prediction_score FROM device_summary ds WHERE ds.label_rank <= 7547 ORDER BY ds.label_rank, ds.active_apps DESC, ds.device_id LIMIT 25830;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn, AVG(ae.is_active) OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_active FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-02-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 27 AND ga.age <= 50 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -105.55 AND -65.11 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 27.57 AND 85.16 ), aggregated AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(re.is_installed) AS total_installed, SUM(re.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(re.moving_avg_active) AS avg_moving_active, MAX(re.age) AS max_age, MIN(re.age) AS min_age, COUNT(*) AS total_events, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT re.category, ', ' ORDER BY re.category) AS label_categories FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 796 GROUP BY re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) > 20 AND SUM(re.is_active) >= 29 ) SELECT a.device_id, a.phone_brand, a.device_model, a.gender, a.group1, a.distinct_apps, a.total_installed, a.total_active, a.avg_moving_active, a.max_age, a.min_age, a.total_events, a.label_categories, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand, ', ') AS phone_brands, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.device_model, ', ') AS device_models, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS label_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp BETWEEN '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS relevant_event_count, (SELECT AVG(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = ga.device_id AND s.f23 > '0.0') AS avg_sample_f23 FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN gender_age_train gat ON ga.device_id = gat.device_id JOIN gender_age_test gatest ON ga.device_id = gatest.device_id WHERE ( (e.longitude BETWEEN 142.26 AND 82.76 OR e.latitude BETWEEN -53.39 AND -48.8) AND e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND (ae.is_installed = 1 OR ae.is_active = 1) AND NOT (ga.gender = 'F' AND ga.age < 57) AND ga.group1 IN ('F23-', 'F23-', 'F23-') AND pb.phone_brand NOT LIKE '%Apple%' AND (lc.category = 'Game' OR lc.category IS NULL) ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 132 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 85 AND AVG(e.latitude) <> 50.91 AND (MAX(e.timestamp) - MIN(e.timestamp)) > INTERVAL '19 days' ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, SUM(CASE WHEN pb.phone_brand = 'Samsung' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_brand_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.device_model) AS distinct_device_models, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_and_active_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN e.longitude > 40.81 AND e.latitude > -60.59 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS events_in_high_coords, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 AND al.label_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps_with_labels FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_train gat ON ga.device_id = gat.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_test gatest ON ga.device_id = gatest.device_id LEFT JOIN events_relevant er ON e.event_id = er.event_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON ae.event_id = aer.event_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND (gat.age >= 45 OR gat.age IS NULL) AND (e.longitude BETWEEN -21.09 AND -24.93 OR e.longitude IS NULL) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 840 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 305 ORDER BY total_events DESC, installed_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp) AS event_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) AS event_quarter FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-06-02 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 25 AND ga.age <= 37 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 29 ORDER BY total_events DESC, event_year DESC, event_quarter DESC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 145.62 AND -68.43 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 28.93 AND -34.26 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, r.device_id, r.timestamp FROM am.distinct_app_count, am.total_active_events, am.avg_installation_rate, am.total_events_processed, am.latest_event_time, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, e.longitude BETWEEN 169.82 AND 142.37 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -12.01 AND -50.23 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM total_active_apps, sa.avg_f23, sa.sum_m22, CASE WHEN dd.age < 30 THEN 'Young' WHEN dd.age BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle' ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_group FROM device_demographics dd INNER JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN events_relevant er ON re.event_id = er.event_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON er.event_id = aer.event_id LEFT JOIN device_app_activity daa ON aer.app_id = daa.app_id AND aer.event_id = daa.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON daa.app_id = ald.app_id LEFT JOIN sample_aggregates sa ON dd.device_id = dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, sa.avg_f23, sa.sum_m22 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) >= 9 AND SUM(daa.is_active) > 32 ORDER BY WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 146.28 AND -95.96 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 2.95 AND -2.99 AND ae.is_active = 1 AND ga.age >= 52 AND ga.age <= 49 ), aggregated_labels AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.age, re.gender, re.group1, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT re.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT re.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(CASE WHEN re.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS re.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.label_id) > 472 ), device_summary AS ( SELECT al.device_id, al.age, al.gender, al.group1, al.phone_brand, al.device_model, al.distinct_labels, al.distinct_categories, al.installed_apps, al.active_apps, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.device_id, ds.age, ds.gender, ds.group1, ds.phone_brand, ds.device_model, ds.distinct_labels, ds.distinct_categories, ds.installed_apps, ds.active_apps, ds.label_rank, COALESCE(ds.f23, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f24_26, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f27_28, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f29_32, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f33_42, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f43, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m22, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m23_26, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m27_28, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m29_31, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m32_38, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m39, 0) AS total_prediction_score FROM device_summary ds WHERE ds.label_rank <= 5755 ORDER BY ds.label_rank, ds.active_apps DESC, ds.device_id LIMIT 53235;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ) SELECT phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS unique_devices, AVG(age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, SUM(CASE WHEN is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS install_events FROM ranked_events WHERE rn <= 86 GROUP BY phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1 HAVING AVG(age) >= 53 AND COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) > 402 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, avg_age ASC;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, AVG(gat.age) AS avg_age FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age_train gat ON e.device_id = gat.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude > 77.52 GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 83 INTERSECT SELECT e2.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae2.app_id) AS app_count, AVG(ga.age) AS avg_age FROM events_relevant e2 JOIN app_events_relevant ae2 ON e2.event_id = ae2.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e2.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e2.latitude > 29.0 GROUP BY e2.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae2.app_id) > 95 ORDER BY app_count DESC;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_app_count FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ae.is_active = 0 GROUP BY e.device_id ORDER BY unique_app_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE (e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00') AND (e.longitude BETWEEN -100.3 AND -34.69 OR e.latitude BETWEEN -23.44 AND -17.81) AND NOT (g.age < 7 OR g.age > 67) AND (g.gender = 'F' OR lc.category = 'A') GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 140 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-06-01 00:00:00' AND g.age >= 26 AND g.age <= 55 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 15 ORDER BY total_events DESC, g.device_id;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND g.age >= 22 AND g.age <= 55 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 4 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, g.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ael.label_id) FROM app_labels ael WHERE ael.app_id = ae.app_id ) AS label_count_per_app FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON g.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -18.08 AND 144.36 AND g.age >= 59 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, g.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, ae.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 109 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ga.age > 61 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 49 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND lc.category = 'A' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) <= 33 ORDER BY device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 18 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 96 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.gender = 'F' AND lc.category = 'Game' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender ORDER BY device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_app_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 37 AND ga.age <= 25 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 44 ORDER BY app_rank;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS distinct_event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_label_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id WHERE ga.age >= 46 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 2 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 41 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING SUM(ae.is_active) > 3 ORDER BY total_active DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pbdm.phone_brand, ', ') AS brands FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 28 AND ga.age <= 41 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -18.82 AND -160.85 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 84.99 AND -20.98 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 8 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 50 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pbdm.phone_brand, ', ') AS brands FROM gender_age_train ga JOIN events_relevant e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 50 AND ga.age <= 63 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -67.35 AND 15.73 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 65.3 AND -51.53 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 83 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 59 ORDER BY event_count DESC, total_active DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 40 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 56.4 AND -1.64 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 79 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude ASC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 45 AND 27 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.latitude > -59.75 AND e.longitude < -176.25 AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 79 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 6 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_latitude ASC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga INNER JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 43 AND ga.age <= 30 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-06-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 6 ORDER BY event_count DESC, total_active_apps DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 62 AND ga.age <= 41 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-06-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 2 ORDER BY event_count DESC, total_active_apps DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-06-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 61 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE al.app_id = ae.app_id AND lc.category = 'Communication' ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 3 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(ae.is_active) AS avg_active_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, SUM(s.f23 + s.f24_26 + s.f27_28 + s.f29_32 + s.f33_42 + s.f43 + s.m22 + s.m23_26 + s.m27_28 + s.m29_31 + s.m32_38 + s.m39) AS total_submission_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_demographic, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY pbdm.phone_brand) AS avg_apps_per_brand, SUM(SUM(ae.is_active)) OVER (ORDER BY ga.age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_active_apps FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission s ON ga.device_id = s.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 34 AND ga.age <= 77 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -165.74 AND 80.48 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 70.17 AND 69.92 AND (s.f23 >= '0' OR s.f23 IS NULL) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) >= 188 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps_installed DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(ae.is_active) AS avg_active_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, SUM(s.f23 + s.f24_26 + s.f27_28 + s.f29_32 + s.f33_42 + s.f43 + s.m22 + s.m23_26 + s.m27_28 + s.m29_31 + s.m32_38 + s.m39) AS total_submission_score, AVG(SUM(ae.is_active)) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY ga.age ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_active_apps_by_group_age FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission s ON ga.device_id = s.device_id WHERE ga.age > 65 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -171.1 AND 137.43 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -74.86 AND -15.46 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 74 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 31 ORDER BY total_apps_installed DESC, total_active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS distinct_event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_label_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 59 AND ga.age <= 48 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 135.38 AND -76.78 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 72.77 AND -58.62 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 69 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 30 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 20 ORDER BY distinct_event_count DESC, total_active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 54 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 19 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND e.timestamp <= '2016-06-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age <= 42 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) < 61 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_labels al WHERE al.app_id = ae.app_id AND al.label_id IN ( SELECT lc.label_id FROM label_categories lc WHERE lc.category = 'Game' LIMIT 66 OFFSET 703 ) ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 16 ORDER BY total_active DESC;

MIN(e.timestamp)) AS event_time_span, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score, CASE WHEN ga.age < 20 THEN 'Teen' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 20 AND 35 THEN 'Young Adult' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN 'Middle Aged' ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_group, CASE WHEN pbdm.phone_brand IN ('Samsung', 'Apple', 'Huawei', 'Xiaomi') THEN 'Top Brand' ELSE 'Other Brand' END AS brand_category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 50 THEN 'Heavy User' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) BETWEEN 20 AND 50 THEN 'Moderate User' ELSE 'Light User' END AS app_usage_category FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 26 AND ga.age <= 69 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 165.11 AND -45.47 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 63.21 AND 9.25 AND (ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) > '0' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 200 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 90 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC LIMIT 6797;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 138.52 AND -41.22 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -56.73 AND -56.26 AND ga.age >= 28 AND ga.age <= 43 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 11 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 8 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_app_events, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 80.47 AND -95.8 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 71 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp) AS event_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) AS event_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.timestamp) AS event_month, EXTRACT(WEEK FROM e.timestamp) AS event_week, EXTRACT(DOY FROM e.timestamp) AS event_day_of_year, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -167.35 AND 86.06 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -38.08 AND -79.28 AND ga.age >= 94 AND ga.age <= 36 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(WEEK FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(DOY FROM e.timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 498 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 271 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 32 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, total_installs DESC;

WITH device_aggregates AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installed, COUNT(*) AS total_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 129.78 AND -63.59 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -0.91 AND -29.48 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 941 ), enriched_devices AS ( SELECT da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active, da.total_installed, da.total_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, da.first_event, da.last_event, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM device_aggregates da LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON da.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON da.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae2 ON da.device_id = ae2.event_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON ae2.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active, da.total_installed, da.total_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, da.first_event, da.last_event, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model ) SELECT ed.gender, ed.group1, ed.phone_brand, ed.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ed.device_id) AS device_count, AVG(ed.age) AS avg_age, AVG(ed.distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, SUM(ed.total_active) AS sum_total_active, SUM(ed.total_installed) AS sum_total_installed, SUM(ed.total_events) AS sum_total_events, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ed.distinct_labels) AS median_labels, MIN(ed.first_event) AS earliest_event, MAX(ed.last_event) AS latest_event FROM enriched_devices ed WHERE ed.age BETWEEN 76 AND 41 AND ed.total_events >= 5322 GROUP BY ed.gender, ed.group1, ed.phone_brand, ed.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ed.device_id) > 48 AND AVG(ed.distinct_apps) > 92.77 ORDER BY device_count DESC, avg_distinct_apps DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH device_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, ae.app_id, ae.is_active, ga.age, ga.gender, pbd.phone_brand, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp) AS event_seq FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-02 00:00:00' ), moving_avg AS ( SELECT device_id, timestamp, age, gender, phone_brand, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS active_apps_moving_count, AVG(age) OVER ( PARTITION BY phone_brand, gender ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_age_by_brand_gender FROM device_events WHERE is_active = 1 ) SELECT phone_brand, gender, AVG(avg_age_by_brand_gender) AS final_avg_age, SUM(active_apps_moving_count) AS total_active_events, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS unique_devices FROM moving_avg WHERE age > 37 GROUP BY phone_brand, gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) >= 67 ORDER BY final_avg_age DESC, total_active_events DESC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 65.54 AND 39.75 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' ) SELECT phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, category, COUNT(*) AS event_count, SUM(is_active) AS active_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM ranked_events WHERE rn <= 1 AND age >= 76 GROUP BY phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, category HAVING COUNT(*) > 856 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(SUM(ae.is_active)) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.age) AS avg_active_per_gender_age FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 22 AND ga.age <= 20 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 39 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_installed FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age > 67 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ae.app_id IN ( SELECT app_id FROM app_events_relevant WHERE is_installed = 1 AND is_active > 0 ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 1 ORDER BY total_active DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_within_group FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 36 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 179.4 AND 24.15 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 19 ORDER BY total_events DESC, ga.device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_and_active_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_but_inactive_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS distinct_installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS distinct_active_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN lc.category = 'Games' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS game_labels, SUM(CASE WHEN lc.category = 'Social' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS social_labels, SUM(CASE WHEN lc.category NOT IN ('Games', 'Social') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_labels, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -51.45 AND -86.81 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 41.09 AND 75.29 AND ga.age >= 31 AND ga.age <= 63 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 675 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 492 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 76 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_demographic, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY pbdm.phone_brand) AS avg_apps_per_brand FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 22 AND ga.age <= 67 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -89.37 AND -104.77 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 71.79 AND -79.99 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 374 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 14 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_group, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, pbdm.phone_brand ORDER BY SUM(ae.is_active) DESC) AS active_app_rank_by_gender_brand FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 24 AND ga.age <= 46 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -164.04 AND 141.55 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 2.57 AND 5.17 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 973 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 13 ORDER BY total_events DESC, active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.timestamp) AS third_quartile_timestamp, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) FROM app_labels al WHERE al.app_id = ANY(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ae.app_id))) AS distinct_labels, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) FROM label_categories lc WHERE lc.label_id IN (SELECT al2.label_id FROM app_labels al2 WHERE al2.app_id = ANY(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ae.app_id)))) AS distinct_categories FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -162.75 AND 137.78 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 78.12 AND -31.82 AND ga.age >= 2 AND ga.age <= 55 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 688 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 402 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(aer.is_active) FROM app_events_relevant aer JOIN events_relevant er2 ON aer.event_id = er2.event_id WHERE er2.device_id = ga.device_id AND er2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_active_ratio FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 45 AND ga.age <= 26 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-04-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-04-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 530 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 44 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app_labels al WHERE al.app_id = ae.app_id AND al.label_id IN (SELECT label_id FROM label_categories WHERE category = 'Communication' LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0)) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 16 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age > 33 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND lc.category LIKE 'Game' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 88 ORDER BY total_active DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 45 AND ga.age <= 63 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 18 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps_sum FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE pbdm.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' AND ga.age >= 49 AND ga.age <= 46 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 14 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp) AS event_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) AS event_quarter FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.latitude BETWEEN 82.2 AND -9.09 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 25 ORDER BY total_events DESC, event_year, event_quarter;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) FROM app_labels al WHERE al.app_id = ANY(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ae.app_id))) AS distinct_labels_per_app_set, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 33 AND ga.age <= 23 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -41.51 AND 156.53 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 70.71 AND -51.45 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 804 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 48 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_installs DESC;

WITH combined_events AS ( SELECT e.event_id, e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude FROM events e UNION ALL SELECT er.event_id, er.device_id, er.timestamp, er.longitude, er.latitude FROM events_relevant er ), device_info AS ( SELECT d.device_id, d.phone_brand, d.device_model, COALESCE(gt.age, ga.age) AS age, COALESCE(gt.gender, ga.gender) AS gender, COALESCE(gt.group1, ga.group1) AS group1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 d LEFT JOIN gender_age_train gt ON d.device_id = gt.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON d.device_id = ga.device_id ), app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.event_id, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active FROM app_events ae UNION ALL SELECT aer.event_id, aer.app_id, aer.is_installed, aer.is_active FROM app_events_relevant aer ), labeled_apps AS ( SELECT al.app_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id ) SELECT di.phone_brand, di.device_model, di.age, di.gender, la.category, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.app_id) FILTER (WHERE aa.is_installed = 1) AS installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.app_id) FILTER (WHERE aa.is_active = 1) AS active_apps, AVG(ce.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(ce.latitude) AS avg_latitude, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score FROM combined_events ce JOIN device_info di ON ce.device_id = di.device_id JOIN app_activity aa ON ce.event_id = aa.event_id JOIN labeled_apps la ON aa.app_id = la.app_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ce.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE ce.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ce.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND di.age BETWEEN 51 AND 31 AND ce.longitude BETWEEN -133.57 AND -79.07 AND ce.latitude BETWEEN -0.43 AND 31.68 GROUP BY di.phone_brand, di.device_model, di.age, di.gender, la.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) > 123 AND COUNT(DISTINCT aa.app_id) FILTER (WHERE aa.is_installed = 1) >= 37 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_submission_score DESC LIMIT 384;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 148.48 AND -20.11 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -29.4 AND -71.91 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 678 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 64 AND g.gender = 'F' ), event_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 27 GROUP BY re.device_id ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(daa.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(dd.age) OVER (PARTITION BY dd.phone_brand) AS avg_age_by_brand, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC) AS event_rank FROM device_demographics dd JOIN event_aggregates ea ON dd.device_id = ea.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_activity daa ON re.event_id = daa.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON daa.app_id = ald.app_id WHERE ea.total_events > 936 AND dd.age <= 67 GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) >= 36 AND SUM(daa.is_active) > 80 ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC, dd.device_id LIMIT 2302;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, AVG(gat.age) AS avg_age FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age_train gat ON e.device_id = gat.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ae.is_active = 1 AND gat.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM phone_brand_device_model2 WHERE phone_brand = 'Xiaomi') GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 19 ORDER BY app_count DESC;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS related_event_count, AVG(e2.longitude - e1.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e2.latitude - e1.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.timestamp < e2.timestamp AND e1.event_id != e2.event_id JOIN app_events ae1 ON e1.event_id = ae1.event_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON e2.event_id = ae2.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e1.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e1.longitude BETWEEN -65.25 AND 91.26 AND e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ga.age >= 25 GROUP BY e1.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) > 25 ORDER BY related_event_count DESC;
