SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.timestamp - sub.min_timestamp))) AS percentile_75_event_age_seconds, AVG(sub.avg_app_installs_per_event) AS avg_installs_per_event, MAX(sub.max_active_apps_per_event) AS max_active_apps_per_event FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN ( SELECT e2.device_id, MIN(e2.timestamp) AS min_timestamp, AVG(sub_ae.installed_count) AS avg_app_installs_per_event, MAX(sub_ae.active_count) AS max_active_apps_per_event FROM events e2 JOIN ( SELECT ae2.event_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ae2.is_installed = 1) AS installed_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ae2.is_active = 1) AS active_count FROM app_events ae2 WHERE ae2.is_installed >= 0 OR ae2.is_active >= 0 GROUP BY ae2.event_id ) sub_ae ON e2.event_id = sub_ae.event_id WHERE e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e2.longitude BETWEEN -119.67 AND 27.92 GROUP BY e2.device_id ) sub ON ga.device_id = sub.device_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 75 AND 28 AND ga.gender IN ('F', 'F') GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 935 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 440 ORDER BY total_events DESC, active_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 39 AND ga.age <= 59 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 76.19 AND -59.23 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -81.07 AND -62.45 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 640 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 46 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC LIMIT 638;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 36 AND 74 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 35.4 AND 57.27 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -84.07 AND 13.74 AND ga.device_id IN ( SELECT device_id FROM gender_age_train WHERE age > 66 AND gender = 'F' ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 111 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 297 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 95 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC LIMIT 396;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps_interacted, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps_count, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_and_active_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_but_inactive_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS distinct_installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS distinct_active_apps, (SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS active_to_installed_ratio FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 62 AND ga.age <= 38 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -61.87 AND 92.23 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 18.96 AND 84.18 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 54 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 12 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps_interacted DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -31.11 AND 33.73 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 85 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 23 ORDER BY active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age > 21 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age UNION ALL SELECT pbd.device_id, 'Unknown' AS gender, 0 AS age, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS unique_apps, 0 AS total_active FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbd JOIN events e ON pbd.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id WHERE e.longitude > -88.33 AND e.latitude < -30.88 GROUP BY pbd.device_id ORDER BY unique_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.app_id IN (SELECT app_id FROM app_labels WHERE label_id = 82) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 41 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 58 AND 61 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01' AND e.longitude > -170.54 AND e.latitude < 33.63 AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 5 ORDER BY event_count DESC, total_active_events DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_demographic FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 23 AND 31 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -114.66 AND -38.33 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 31 ORDER BY total_events DESC, event_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga INNER JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id LEFT JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 62 AND ga.age <= 40 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 8 ORDER BY distinct_app_count DESC, total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-02 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 72.43 AND 56.63 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 7.76 AND 38.94 AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 664 ORDER BY event_count DESC, total_active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 10 ORDER BY distinct_apps_installed DESC, total_active_events DESC;

WITH device_activity AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 34 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age BETWEEN 24 AND 35 ), app_label_analysis AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS label_categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) >= 11 ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active_events, da.avg_latitude, da.avg_longitude, COUNT(DISTINCT ae_relevant.app_id) AS relevant_apps_installed, SUM(CASE WHEN ae_relevant.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_installed_apps, AVG(ala.total_labels) AS avg_labels_per_app, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ala.label_categories, '; ') AS aggregated_categories FROM device_demographics dd JOIN device_activity da ON dd.device_id = da.device_id LEFT JOIN events_relevant er ON dd.device_id = er.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant ae_relevant ON er.event_id = ae_relevant.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_analysis ala ON ae_relevant.app_id = ala.app_id WHERE da.total_active_events > 654 GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active_events, da.avg_latitude, da.avg_longitude HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae_relevant.app_id) >= 9 AND AVG(ala.total_labels) > 4.93 ORDER BY da.total_active_events DESC, dd.age ASC LIMIT 2296;

WITH device_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON e.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ), aggregated_metrics AS ( SELECT de.device_id, de.phone_brand, de.device_model, de.gender, de.age, COUNT(DISTINCT de.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(de.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(de.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(de.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(*) AS total_events FROM device_events de WHERE de.longitude BETWEEN 47.17 AND -41.02 AND de.latitude BETWEEN -84.83 AND -30.51 GROUP BY de.device_id, de.phone_brand, de.device_model, de.gender, de.age HAVING COUNT(*) > 346 ) SELECT am.phone_brand, am.device_model, am.gender, CASE WHEN am.age < 20 THEN 'Under 20' WHEN am.age BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN '20-30' WHEN am.age BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN '31-40' WHEN am.age > 40 THEN 'Over 40' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS age_group, COUNT(am.device_id) AS device_count, AVG(am.distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, SUM(am.total_active) AS sum_total_active, MIN(am.avg_longitude) AS min_avg_longitude, MAX(am.avg_latitude) AS max_avg_latitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY am.total_events) AS median_total_events FROM aggregated_metrics am JOIN events_relevant er ON am.device_id = er.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON er.event_id = aer.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON aer.app_id = aa.app_id WHERE am.age >= 66 AND am.age <= 72 GROUP BY am.phone_brand, am.device_model, am.gender, age_group HAVING AVG(am.distinct_apps) > 3.46 ORDER BY device_count DESC, sum_total_active DESC LIMIT 520;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 176.75 AND 139.68 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 49.12 AND 71.01 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 825 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 54 AND g.gender = 'F' ), event_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 12 GROUP BY re.device_id ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(das.is_active) AS total_active_apps, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dd.gender ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC) AS event_rank_by_gender FROM device_demographics dd JOIN event_aggregates ea ON dd.device_id = ea.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON das.app_id = ald.app_id WHERE ea.total_events > 236 GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) >= 21 AND SUM(das.is_active) > 17 ORDER BY app_rank, ga.device_id) >= '2016-05-15 00:00:00' ORDER BY total_events DESC, installed_apps DESC, ga.device_id LIMIT 3787;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 111.18 AND -72.96 AND e.latitude BETWEEN e.timestamp), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(WEEK FROM e.timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 897 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 150 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 35 ORDER BY SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, (MAX(e.timestamp) - MIN(e.timestamp)) AS event_time_span, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id), 0)::numeric AS active_app_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ae.is_installed) DESC) AS install_percent_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY ga.age) AS prev_event_count_in_group FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -141.94 AND 31.2 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -36.08 AND 3.52 AND ga.age >= 52 AND ga.age <= 98 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 342 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 105 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 965 UNION SELECT gat.device_id, NULL AS age, NULL AS gender, NULL AS group1, pbdm2.phone_brand, pbdm2.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT er.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(aer.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(aer.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(er.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(er.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al2.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc2.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc2.category) AS label_categories, MAX(er.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(er.timestamp) AS first_event_time, (MAX(er.timestamp) - MIN(er.timestamp)) AS event_time_span, SUM(CASE WHEN aer.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id), 0)::numeric AS active_app_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT er.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(aer.is_installed) DESC) AS install_percent_rank, NULL AS prev_event_count_in_group FROM gender_age_test gat JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm2 ON gat.device_id = pbdm2.device_id JOIN events_relevant er ON gat.device_id = er.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON er.event_id = aer.event_id JOIN app_labels al2 ON aer.app_id = al2.app_id JOIN label_categories lc2 ON al2.label_id = lc2.label_id WHERE er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND er.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND er.longitude BETWEEN 101.71 AND -165.03 AND er.latitude BETWEEN 88.28 AND 63.73 GROUP BY gat.device_id, pbdm2.phone_brand, pbdm2.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT er.event_id) > 170 AND COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) >= 193 AND SUM(aer.is_installed) > 293 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, al.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, lc.label_id, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1) AS installed_and_active_count, MAX(e.timestamp) AS latest_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS earliest_event_time FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -177.02 AND 47.24 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -77.23 AND 52.68 AND ga.age >= 38 AND (ae.is_installed = 1 OR ae.is_active = 1) GROUP BY CUBE( ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, al.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, lc.label_id, lc.category ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 376 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 65 ORDER BY total_events DESC, latest_event_time DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude > 78.33 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > (SELECT AVG(app_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ae_inner.app_id) AS app_count FROM app_events ae_inner WHERE ae_inner.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ae_inner.event_id) AS sub) ORDER BY installed_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_install_status FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age BETWEEN 56 AND 58 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand), (ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand), (ga.group1, pb.phone_brand), (pb.phone_brand), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 93 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

WITH active_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, ae.app_id, ae.is_active, ae.is_installed, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, al.label_id, lc.category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ), aggregated_stats AS ( SELECT device_id, phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(is_active) AS active_apps, SUM(is_installed) AS installed_apps, AVG(age) AS avg_age, COUNT(DISTINCT label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT category) AS distinct_categories FROM active_events WHERE rn <= 71 GROUP BY device_id, phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) > 38 AND AVG(age) BETWEEN 24 AND 46 ), high_value_devices AS ( SELECT a.device_id, a.phone_brand, a.device_model, a.gender, a.group1, a.total_events, a.total_apps, a.active_apps, a.installed_apps, a.avg_age, a.distinct_labels, a.distinct_categories, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39 FROM aggregated_stats a JOIN sample_submission ss ON a.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE ss.f23 > '0.0' OR ss.m22 > '0.0' ) SELECT device_id, phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, total_events, total_apps, active_apps, installed_apps, avg_age, distinct_labels, distinct_categories FROM high_value_devices WHERE total_apps >= 30 INTERSECT SELECT device_id, phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, total_events, total_apps, active_apps, installed_apps, avg_age, distinct_labels, distinct_categories FROM aggregated_stats WHERE distinct_labels > 35 AND distinct_categories > 14 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_age ASC LIMIT 493;

WITH device_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-06-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 27 AND ga.age <= 52 ), app_stats AS ( SELECT de.device_id, de.app_id, de.age, de.gender, de.phone_brand, COUNT(*) AS event_count, SUM(de.is_active) AS active_sum, AVG(de.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(de.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM device_events de GROUP BY de.device_id, de.app_id, de.age, de.gender, de.phone_brand ), window_stats AS ( SELECT as1.device_id, as1.app_id, as1.age, as1.gender, as1.phone_brand, as1.event_count, as1.active_sum, as1.avg_longitude, as1.avg_latitude, AVG(as1.event_count) OVER ( PARTITION BY as1.gender, as1.phone_brand ORDER BY as1.age ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_events, SUM(as1.active_sum) OVER ( PARTITION BY as1.gender ORDER BY as1.age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_active FROM app_stats as1 WHERE as1.event_count > 4 ) SELECT ws.gender, ws.phone_brand, ws.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.app_id) AS unique_apps, AVG(ws.event_count) AS avg_events_per_device, AVG(ws.moving_avg_events) AS avg_moving_window, MAX(ws.cumulative_active) AS max_cumulative_active, AVG(ws.avg_longitude) AS overall_avg_longitude, AVG(ws.avg_latitude) AS overall_avg_latitude FROM window_stats ws GROUP BY ws.gender, ws.phone_brand, ws.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ws.device_id) >= 21 AND AVG(ws.event_count) > 11.38 ORDER BY ws.gender, ws.phone_brand, ws.age;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude > -33.64 AND e.latitude < 0.1 ), device_info AS ( SELECT p.device_id, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, g.age, g.gender, g.group1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 p JOIN gender_age g ON p.device_id = g.device_id WHERE g.age >= 47 ) SELECT di.phone_brand, di.device_model, di.gender, di.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.device_id) AS unique_device_count, AVG(di.age) AS avg_age, MAX(re.timestamp) AS latest_event_time FROM device_info di JOIN ranked_events re ON di.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 JOIN app_events ae ON re.device_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.category = 'A' GROUP BY di.phone_brand, di.device_model, di.gender, di.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.device_id) > 94 ORDER BY unique_device_count DESC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 82.13 AND 25.99 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -7.09 AND 35.97 AND ae.is_active = 1 AND ga.age >= 28 AND ga.age <= 54 ), aggregated_labels AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.age, re.gender, re.group1, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT re.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT re.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(CASE WHEN re.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN re.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 65 GROUP BY re.device_id, re.age, re.gender, re.group1, re.phone_brand, re.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.label_id) > 515 ), device_summary AS ( SELECT al.device_id, al.age, al.gender, al.group1, al.phone_brand, al.device_model, al.distinct_labels, al.distinct_categories, al.installed_apps, al.active_apps, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY al.distinct_labels DESC, al.active_apps DESC) AS label_rank FROM aggregated_labels al LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON al.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE al.installed_apps >= 5284 ) SELECT ds.device_id, ds.age, ds.gender, ds.group1, ds.phone_brand, ds.device_model, ds.distinct_labels, ds.distinct_categories, ds.installed_apps, ds.active_apps, ds.label_rank, COALESCE(ds.f23, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f24_26, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f27_28, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f29_32, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f33_42, 0) + COALESCE(ds.f43, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m22, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m23_26, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m27_28, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m29_31, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m32_38, 0) + COALESCE(ds.m39, 0) AS total_prediction_score FROM device_summary ds WHERE ds.label_rank <= 7445 ORDER BY ds.label_rank, ds.active_apps DESC, ds.device_id LIMIT 72972;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -45.73 AND 67.24 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 49 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 32 ORDER BY event_count DESC, g.device_id;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id LEFT JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01' AND g.age >= 57 AND g.age <= 34 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, p.phone_brand, p.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 7 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ga.age > 21 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 84 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND lc.category = 'A' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) < 19 ORDER BY device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 46 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 80 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.gender = 'F' AND lc.category = 'Game' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender ORDER BY device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE (e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' OR e.longitude > -165.95) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm WHERE pbdm.device_id = ga.device_id AND pbdm.phone_brand = 'samsung' ) AND ga.age BETWEEN 54 AND 35 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 8 ORDER BY total_active DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_sum, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS installed_avg, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS label_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS categories, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.device_id) AS brand_model_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 34 AND ga.age <= 45 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 24 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 3 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_sum, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS installed_avg, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS label_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS categories, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.device_id) AS brand_model_count FROM gender_age_train ga JOIN events_relevant e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -18.51 AND -134.01 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -15.67 AND 84.98 AND ga.age >= 24 AND ga.age <= 24 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 9 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 35 ORDER BY event_count DESC, active_sum DESC LIMIT 570;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, COUNT(DISTINCT al.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) AS distinct_labels, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id), 0)::numeric AS active_event_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_demographic FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -162.66 AND -19.57 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -58.8 AND -14.56 AND ga.age >= 7 AND ga.age <= 31 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 918 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 867 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude, avg_latitude;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 23 AND ga.age <= 65 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 75 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 33 UNION ALL SELECT pbd.device_id, 'Unknown' AS gender, 0 AS age, COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(aer.is_active) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al2.label_id) AS distinct_labels, AVG(er.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(er.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbd JOIN events_relevant er ON pbd.device_id = er.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON er.event_id = aer.event_id JOIN app_labels al2 ON aer.app_id = al2.app_id JOIN label_categories lc2 ON al2.label_id = lc2.label_id WHERE er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND pbd.phone_brand = 'Xiaomi' GROUP BY pbd.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) > 97 AND SUM(aer.is_active) >= 49 ORDER BY installed_apps DESC, active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_installed FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age > 26 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.device_id IN ( SELECT device_id FROM events_relevant WHERE longitude BETWEEN 158.21 AND 18.5 ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 13 ORDER BY total_active DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, SUM(CASE WHEN lc.category = 'Communication' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS communication_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN lc.category = 'Game' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS game_apps, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, (MAX(e.timestamp) - MIN(e.timestamp)) AS event_time_span, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 29 AND ga.age <= 24 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 40.68 AND -24.47 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -67.35 AND -3.04 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 14 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 18 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, total_submission_score DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age > 80 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 138.09 AND -137.83 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 6.22 AND -6.57 AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 646 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 10 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE (ga.age > 56 OR ga.gender = 'F') AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 76.47 AND -108.59 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 3.5 AND -44.16 AND NOT (lc.category = 'Game') GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 882 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 30 ORDER BY total_events DESC, active_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps_installed, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 49 AND ga.age <= 56 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 54 ORDER BY distinct_apps_installed DESC, ga.device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, MAX(pb.phone_brand) AS phone_brand, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS group_rank FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -103.38 AND 2.17 AND ga.age >= 27 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 328 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 14 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, MAX(pb.phone_brand) AS phone_brand, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS group_rank FROM gender_age_train ga JOIN events_relevant e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.latitude BETWEEN -24.2 AND 37.31 AND ga.age <= 9 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) < 450 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <= 906 ORDER BY installed_apps DESC, active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, SUM(s.f23 + s.f24_26 + s.f27_28 + s.f29_32 + s.f33_42 + s.f43 + s.m22 + s.m23_26 + s.m27_28 + s.m29_31 + s.m32_38 + s.m39) AS total_submission_score FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission s ON ga.device_id = s.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -113.95 AND -51.63 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -58.68 AND 69.42 AND ga.age >= 5 AND ga.age <= 45 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 440 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 306 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_submission_score DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, SUM(CASE WHEN pb.phone_brand = 'Samsung' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_brand_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.device_model) AS distinct_device_models, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_and_active, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_not_active, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_installed, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-02-01 00:00:00' THEN e.event_id END) AS events_in_date_range, SUM(CASE WHEN lc.category = 'Game' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_category_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_train gat ON ga.device_id = gat.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_test gatest ON ga.device_id = gatest.device_id LEFT JOIN events_relevant er ON e.event_id = er.event_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON ae.event_id = aer.event_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.longitude > -174.27 AND e.latitude < 42.03 AND ga.age >= 27 AND ga.age <= 59 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 32 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

WITH device_activity AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, al.label_id, lc.category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ), moving_avg AS ( SELECT device_id, timestamp, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 40 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS event_count_rolling, AVG(age) OVER ( PARTITION BY phone_brand, gender ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 71 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_age_by_brand_gender, SUM(is_active) OVER ( PARTITION BY device_id, app_id ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_active_events FROM device_activity WHERE rn <= 968 ), aggregated AS ( SELECT da.phone_brand, da.device_model, da.gender, da.group1, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT da.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(da.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(da.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(da.age) AS avg_age, MIN(ma.event_count_rolling) AS min_rolling_events, MAX(ma.avg_age_by_brand_gender) AS max_avg_age, SUM(ma.cumulative_active_events) AS total_cumulative_active FROM device_activity da JOIN moving_avg ma ON da.device_id = ma.device_id AND da.timestamp = ma.timestamp JOIN label_categories lc ON da.category = lc.category WHERE da.longitude BETWEEN -6.04 AND -164.3 AND da.latitude BETWEEN -5.63 AND 52.59 GROUP BY da.phone_brand, da.device_model, da.gender, da.group1, lc.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) > 31 ) SELECT phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, category, unique_devices, unique_apps, total_installs, total_active, avg_age, min_rolling_events, max_avg_age, total_cumulative_active, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY unique_devices DESC) AS rank_by_devices, LAG(total_active, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY phone_brand, gender ORDER BY unique_devices DESC) AS prev_total_active FROM aggregated ORDER BY SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS install_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, COUNT(DISTINCT al.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) AS distinct_labels, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, SUM(s.f23 + s.f24_26 + s.f27_28 + s.f29_32 + s.f33_42 + s.f43 + s.m22 + s.m23_26 + s.m27_28 + s.m29_31 + s.m32_38 + s.m39) AS total_submission_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = ga.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e2.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_event_count, (SELECT AVG(pb_count.count_model) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_model FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm2 WHERE pbdm2.device_id = ga.device_id GROUP BY pbdm2.device_model) pb_count) AS avg_models_per_brand FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission s ON ga.device_id = s.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 100.49 AND -31.98 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 48.45 AND 88.15 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 439 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude ASC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -124.7 AND -8.24 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 42.23 AND -59.74 AND ae.is_active = 0 AND ga.age >= 55 AND ga.age <= 43 ), aggregated_stats AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT re.label_id) AS distinct_labels, SUM(re.is_installed) AS total_installs, AVG(re.age) AS avg_age, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(re.timestamp) AS first_event_time, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.latitude) AS median_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 218 GROUP BY re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) > 92 AND AVG(re.age) BETWEEN 12.19 AND 20.85 ), windowed_analysis AS ( SELECT as1.*, LAG(as1.distinct_apps, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.phone_brand, as1.gender ORDER BY as1.avg_age) AS prev_distinct_apps, LEAD(as1.total_installs, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.device_model, as1.group1 ORDER BY as1.last_event_time) AS next_total_installs, SUM(as1.distinct_labels) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.phone_brand ORDER BY as1.avg_age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_labels, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY as1.gender ORDER BY as1.distinct_apps DESC) AS rank_by_apps FROM aggregated_stats as1 JOIN events_relevant er ON as1.device_id = er.device_id WHERE er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND er.timestamp <= '2016-01-01' ) SELECT wa.phone_brand, wa.device_model, wa.gender, wa.group1, wa.distinct_apps, wa.distinct_labels, wa.total_installs, wa.avg_age, wa.last_event_time, wa.first_event_time, wa.median_longitude, wa.median_latitude, wa.prev_distinct_apps, wa.next_total_installs, wa.running_total_labels, wa.rank_by_apps, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY wa.phone_brand, wa.gender) AS count_per_brand_gender, AVG(wa.distinct_apps) OVER (PARTITION BY wa.device_model ORDER BY wa.avg_age ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_apps FROM windowed_analysis wa LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON wa.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE wa.rank_by_apps <= 92 AND wa.running_total_labels > 4764 ORDER BY wa.rank_by_apps, wa.running_total_labels DESC LIMIT 1551;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e1.event_id, e1.device_id, e1.timestamp, e1.longitude, e1.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e1.device_id ORDER BY e1.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e1 WHERE e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e1.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.event_id, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_active = 0 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id >= 704 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age BETWEEN 53 AND 52 ), event_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM ranked_events re GROUP BY re.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) > 50 ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(daa.is_installed) AS total_installed, SUM(daa.is_active) AS total_active, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39 FROM device_demographics dd JOIN event_aggregates ea ON dd.device_id = ea.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_activity daa ON re.event_id = daa.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON daa.app_id = ald.app_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON dd.device_id = ss.device_id GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) >= 43 ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC, dd.age ASC LIMIT 555;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, AVG(gat.age) AS avg_age FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age_train gat ON e.device_id = gat.device_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM phone_brand_device_model2 WHERE phone_brand = 'Xiaomi') GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 6 ORDER BY app_count DESC;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM events e LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -161.69 AND 151.52 GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 91 ORDER BY app_count DESC;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS related_event_count, AVG(e2.longitude - e1.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e2.latitude - e1.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.event_id != e2.event_id JOIN app_events ae1 ON e1.event_id = ae1.event_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON e2.event_id = ae2.event_id JOIN app_labels al1 ON ae1.app_id = al1.app_id JOIN app_labels al2 ON ae2.app_id = al2.app_id JOIN label_categories lc1 ON al1.label_id = lc1.label_id JOIN label_categories lc2 ON al2.label_id = lc2.label_id WHERE e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e1.longitude BETWEEN -83.76 AND -148.81 AND e2.latitude BETWEEN -23.17 AND 61.8 GROUP BY e1.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) > 27 ORDER BY related_event_count DESC;

SELECT e1.device_id, e1.event_id AS first_event_id, e2.event_id AS second_event_id, ga.age, ga.gender, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae1.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae2.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps_count, AVG(e1.longitude - e2.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e1.latitude - e2.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff, MAX(e2.timestamp) AS latest_second_event_time, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY e1.device_id, ga.age) AS device_age_event_pairs, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae1.app_id) DESC) AS installed_apps_rank FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.event_id <> e2.event_id AND e1.timestamp < e2.timestamp JOIN gender_age ga ON e1.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON e1.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN app_events ae1 ON e1.event_id = ae1.event_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON e2.event_id = ae2.event_id AND ae1.app_id = ae2.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae1.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e1.longitude > -32.08 AND e2.latitude < 4.75 AND ga.age >= 25 AND e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e2.timestamp <= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY e1.device_id, e1.event_id, e2.event_id, ga.age, ga.gender, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae1.app_id) > 558 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae2.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 91 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC, latest_second_event_time DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY g.gender) AS avg_installed_by_gender FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE g.age >= 51 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.age, g.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 39 ORDER BY installed_apps DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT a.app_id) AS unique_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS unique_labels, MAX(lc.category) AS sample_category FROM gender_age g INNER JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id LEFT JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON a.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE g.age >= 23 AND g.age <= 59 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 27 ORDER BY event_count DESC, g.device_id;

SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = g.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = g.device_id) AS avg_f23 FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE g.age BETWEEN 18 AND 46 AND e.timestamp BETWEEN '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -159.81 AND 166.35 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -48.57 AND 20.52 AND ae.is_installed >= 1 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 877 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 70 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, g.device_id LIMIT 4864;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND g.age >= 23 AND g.age <= 52 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -37.85 AND 70.51 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -53.74 AND 3.5 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 10 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY g.gender ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS gender_event_rank FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE g.age >= 44 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING AVG(e.latitude) > 28.41 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY g.gender ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS gender_event_rank FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE g.age >= 51 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING AVG(e.latitude) > -67.89 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-06-01 00:00:00' AND g.age >= 24 AND g.age <= 52 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 11 ORDER BY total_events DESC, g.device_id;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, (MAX(e.timestamp) - MIN(e.timestamp)) AS event_time_span, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id), 0)::numeric AS active_event_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY g.gender, g.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_demographic FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -26.37 AND -20.93 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 2.8 AND -40.54 AND g.age >= 64 AND g.age <= 15 AND ae.is_installed >= 1 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 33817 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 7550 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 51516 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_active DESC LIMIT 484;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude > 154.56 AND e.latitude < -66.7 ), device_info AS ( SELECT p.device_id, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, g.age, g.gender, g.group1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 p JOIN gender_age g ON p.device_id = g.device_id WHERE g.age >= 67 ) SELECT di.phone_brand, di.device_model, di.gender, di.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.device_id) AS unique_device_count, AVG(di.age) AS avg_age, MAX(re.timestamp) AS latest_event_time FROM device_info di JOIN ranked_events re ON di.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 JOIN app_events ae ON re.device_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.category = 'A' GROUP BY di.phone_brand, di.device_model, di.gender, di.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.device_id) > 16 ORDER BY unique_device_count DESC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.event_id, e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, al.label_id, lc.category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS event_rank FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -108.08 AND 17.45 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -45.62 AND 30.9 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 64 ), aggregated_stats AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(re.is_active) AS active_app_events, AVG(re.age) AS avg_age, MIN(re.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT re.category, ', ' ORDER BY re.category) AS label_categories FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.event_rank <= 75 GROUP BY re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) > 29 AND SUM(re.is_active) >= 36 ) SELECT as1.device_id, as1.phone_brand, as1.device_model, as1.gender, as1.group1, as1.total_events, as1.unique_apps, as1.active_app_events, as1.avg_age, as1.first_event_time, as1.last_event_time, as1.label_categories, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY as1.total_events DESC, as1.active_app_events DESC) AS activity_rank FROM aggregated_stats as1 LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON as1.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE as1.avg_age <= 64 ORDER BY activity_rank, as1.device_id LIMIT 9138;
