SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 30 ORDER BY distinct_apps_installed DESC, total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 20 AND ga.age <= 62 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -54.4 AND 52.95 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 71 ORDER BY unique_apps_installed DESC, active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 46 AND ga.age <= 57 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 46 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 42 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_installs DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -107.54 AND 133.54 AND ga.age >= 58 AND lc.category = 'A' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 582 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 95 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude ASC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -62.99 AND 155.13 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 78 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

WITH device_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, ae.app_id, ae.is_active, ga.age, ga.gender, pbd.phone_brand, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp) AS event_seq FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-02-01 00:00:00' ), moving_avg AS ( SELECT device_id, timestamp, age, gender, phone_brand, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS active_apps_moving_count, AVG(age) OVER ( PARTITION BY gender, phone_brand ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_age_moving FROM device_events WHERE is_active = 1 ) SELECT gender, phone_brand, DATE(timestamp) AS event_date, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS unique_devices, SUM(active_apps_moving_count) AS total_active_events, AVG(avg_age_moving) AS overall_avg_age FROM moving_avg GROUP BY gender, phone_brand, DATE(timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) > 34 ORDER BY event_date DESC, unique_devices DESC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -4.76 AND 17.18 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 32.51 AND 80.17 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 0 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 302 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 0 AND g.gender = 'F' ), event_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 26 GROUP BY re.device_id ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) AS distinct_apps_installed, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.category) AS distinct_label_categories, SUM(daa.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(dd.age) OVER (PARTITION BY dd.phone_brand) AS avg_age_by_brand, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC) AS event_rank FROM device_demographics dd JOIN event_aggregates ea ON dd.device_id = ea.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_activity daa ON re.event_id = daa.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON daa.app_id = ald.app_id WHERE ea.total_events > 672 AND dd.age <= 19 GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) >= 10 ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC, dd.device_id LIMIT 4130;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -67.99 AND -82.12 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 7.73 AND 69.45 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, r.device_id, r.timestamp FROM app_events ae JOIN ranked_events r ON ae.event_id = r.event_id WHERE r.rn <= 29 ), brand_model_info AS ( SELECT p.device_id, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, g.age, g.gender, g.group1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 p LEFT JOIN gender_age g ON p.device_id = g.device_id ), app_label_categories AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id >= 957 ), aggregated_metrics AS ( SELECT bm.device_id, bm.phone_brand, bm.device_model, bm.age, bm.gender, bm.group1, daa.app_id, alc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT daa.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(daa.is_installed) AS total_installed, SUM(daa.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(daa.is_active) AS avg_active_rate FROM device_app_activity daa JOIN brand_model_info bm ON daa.device_id = bm.device_id LEFT JOIN app_label_categories alc ON daa.app_id = alc.app_id GROUP BY bm.device_id, bm.phone_brand, bm.device_model, bm.age, bm.gender, bm.group1, daa.app_id, alc.category HAVING SUM(daa.is_active) > 16 ) SELECT am.phone_brand, am.device_model, am.gender, am.group1, am.category, COUNT(DISTINCT am.device_id) AS unique_devices, SUM(am.event_count) AS total_events, SUM(am.total_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(am.total_active) AS total_actives, AVG(am.avg_active_rate) AS overall_active_rate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY am.age) AS median_age FROM aggregated_metrics am WHERE am.age BETWEEN 64 AND 38 GROUP BY am.phone_brand, am.device_model, am.gender, am.group1, am.category HAVING SUM(am.total_active) >= 795 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, total_actives DESC LIMIT 431;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 113.78 AND 97.94 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 12.72 AND -1.69 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, re.device_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude FROM app_events ae JOIN ranked_events re ON ae.event_id = re.event_id WHERE re.rn <= 47 AND ae.is_installed = 1 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category, daa.device_id, daa.timestamp, daa.is_active FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN device_app_activity daa ON al.app_id = daa.app_id WHERE lc.category IN ('A', 'A') ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT gat.device_id, gat.age, gat.gender, gat.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ald.category, ald.timestamp, ald.is_active FROM gender_age_train gat JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON gat.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON gat.device_id = ald.device_id WHERE gat.age >= 46 AND gat.age <= 33 ), aggregated_metrics AS ( SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT dd.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(CASE WHEN dd.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps_count, AVG(dd.age) OVER (PARTITION BY dd.phone_brand, dd.gender) AS avg_age_by_brand_gender, MAX(dd.timestamp) AS last_activity_time FROM device_demographics dd GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model ), final_join AS ( SELECT am.device_id, am.age, am.gender, am.group1, am.phone_brand, am.device_model, am.distinct_categories, am.active_apps_count, am.avg_age_by_brand_gender, am.last_activity_time, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY am.active_apps_count DESC, am.distinct_categories DESC) AS activity_rank FROM aggregated_metrics am LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON am.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE am.active_apps_count > 814 AND am.distinct_categories >= 3 ) SELECT device_id, age, gender, group1, phone_brand, device_model, distinct_categories, active_apps_count, avg_age_by_brand_gender, last_activity_time, f23, f24_26, f27_28, f29_32, f33_42, f43, m22, m23_26, m27_28, m29_31, m32_38, m39, activity_rank FROM final_join ORDER BY activity_rank, last_activity_time DESC LIMIT 108;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 13.66 AND 151.21 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -43.64 AND -81.03 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, r.device_id, r.timestamp, r.longitude, r.latitude FROM app_events ae JOIN ranked_events r ON ae.event_id = r.event_id WHERE r.rn <= 84 AND ae.is_installed = 1 ), brand_model_info AS ( SELECT p.device_id, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, g.age, g.gender, g.group1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 p LEFT JOIN gender_age g ON p.device_id = g.device_id WHERE g.age >= 70 AND (g.gender = 'F' OR g.gender IS NULL) ), app_label_categories AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.category IN ('A', 'A', 'A') ), aggregated_metrics AS ( SELECT bmi.phone_brand, bmi.device_model, bmi.gender, bmi.group1, alc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT daa.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT daa.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(daa.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(bmi.age) FILTER (WHERE bmi.age IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age, MIN(daa.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(daa.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM device_app_activity daa JOIN brand_model_info bmi ON daa.device_id = bmi.device_id JOIN app_label_categories alc ON daa.app_id = alc.app_id GROUP BY bmi.phone_brand, bmi.device_model, bmi.gender, bmi.group1, alc.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT daa.device_id) > 412 AND SUM(daa.is_active) >= 4695 ) SELECT am.phone_brand, am.device_model, am.gender, am.group1, am.category, am.unique_devices, am.total_events, am.total_active, am.avg_age, am.first_event_time, am.last_event_time, ss.f23, ss.m22, ss.m39, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY am.phone_brand, am.gender ORDER BY am.unique_devices DESC) AS brand_gender_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY am.total_active DESC) AS overall_active_rank FROM aggregated_metrics am LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON am.unique_devices::bigint = ss.device_id WHERE (am.avg_age > 46.25 OR am.avg_age IS NULL) AND (am.first_event_time >= '2016-01-01' OR am.first_event_time IS NULL) ORDER BY am.unique_devices DESC, am.total_active DESC LIMIT 138;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude > 101.91 AND e.latitude < 5.47 ), device_info AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age BETWEEN 70 AND 57 ), app_metrics AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active FROM app_events ae JOIN events e ON ae.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ae.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 61 ) SELECT di.device_id, di.age, di.gender, di.phone_brand, di.device_model, re.timestamp AS last_event_time, re.longitude, re.latitude, am.event_count, am.total_active, AVG(am.event_count) OVER (PARTITION BY di.phone_brand) AS avg_events_per_brand FROM device_info di LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON di.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN events e ON di.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_metrics am ON ae.app_id = am.app_id WHERE di.gender = 'F' GROUP BY di.device_id, di.age, di.gender, di.phone_brand, di.device_model, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, am.event_count, am.total_active ORDER BY di.age DESC, am.event_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 253;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 26 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS label_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e2 ON ga.device_id = e2.device_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON e2.event_id = ae2.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae2.app_id = al.app_id WHERE ga.age >= 21 AND pbdm.phone_brand = 'Xiaomi' GROUP BY ga.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) >= 32;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM events e LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id AND ae.is_installed = 1 LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude > 6.74 GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) < 25 ORDER BY installed_apps DESC;

SELECT e1.device_id, e1.event_id AS first_event_id, e2.event_id AS second_event_id, ga.age, ga.gender, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae1.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae2.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps_count, AVG(e1.longitude - e2.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e1.latitude - e2.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff, MAX(e2.timestamp) AS latest_second_event_time, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY e1.device_id, ga.age) AS device_age_event_pairs, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae1.app_id) DESC) AS installed_apps_rank FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.event_id <> e2.event_id AND e1.timestamp < e2.timestamp JOIN gender_age ga ON e1.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON e1.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN app_events ae1 ON e1.event_id = ae1.event_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON e2.event_id = ae2.event_id AND ae1.app_id = ae2.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae1.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e1.longitude > 125.46 AND e2.latitude < -37.33 AND ga.age >= 69 AND e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e2.timestamp <= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY e1.device_id, e1.event_id, e2.event_id, ga.age, ga.gender, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae1.app_id) > 338 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae2.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 843 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC, latest_second_event_time DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS categories, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id), 0) AS active_app_percentage, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_gender, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.device_id ORDER BY MIN(e.timestamp)) AS prev_event_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 20 AND ga.age <= 43 AND (pbdm.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' OR pbdm.device_model LIKE '%Galaxy%') AND e.longitude BETWEEN -63.58 AND 169.28 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 37.71 AND 10.04 AND ga.gender IN ('F', 'F') AND ga.group1 LIKE 'F%' AND lc.category LIKE '%Game%' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 440 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 65 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 40 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(e.latitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC LIMIT 416;

WITH combined_events AS ( SELECT e.event_id, e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude FROM events e UNION ALL SELECT er.event_id, er.device_id, er.timestamp, er.longitude, er.latitude FROM events_relevant er ), app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.event_id, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active FROM app_events ae UNION ALL SELECT aer.event_id, aer.app_id, aer.is_installed, aer.is_active FROM app_events_relevant aer ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT gat.device_id, gat.age, gat.gender, gat.group1 FROM gender_age_train gat UNION ALL SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1 FROM gender_age ga ) SELECT pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, dd.gender, dd.group1, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(aa.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(dd.age) AS avg_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dd.age) AS median_age, SUM(CASE WHEN aa.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_installed_apps, MAX(ce.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(ce.timestamp) AS first_event_time, CORR(ce.longitude, ce.latitude) AS geo_correlation FROM combined_events ce JOIN device_demographics dd ON ce.device_id = dd.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ce.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN app_activity aa ON ce.event_id = aa.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ce.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ce.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND dd.age >= 22 AND dd.age <= 55 AND ce.longitude BETWEEN -95.36 AND -161.71 AND ce.latitude BETWEEN -13.16 AND -9.16 GROUP BY pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, dd.gender, dd.group1, lc.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) > 305 AND COUNT(DISTINCT aa.app_id) >= 53 AND SUM(aa.is_active) > 154 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_age ASC, last_event_time DESC LIMIT 704;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -116.07 AND 49.34 OR e.latitude NOT BETWEEN 75.02 AND -1.11 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ae.app_id) AS total_events_per_app FROM app_events ae WHERE ae.is_installed = 0 OR ae.is_active = 1 ), joined_data AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.event_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, das.app_id, das.is_installed, das.is_active, das.total_events_per_app, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, al.label_id, lc.category, ss.f23, ss.m22 FROM ranked_events re INNER JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON re.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON re.device_id = pbdm.device_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON das.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON re.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE re.rn <= 98 AND (ga.age > 51 OR ga.gender = 'F') AND (pbdm.phone_brand IS NOT NULL OR pbdm.device_model IS NOT NULL) AND (ss.f23 > '0.0' OR ss.m22 < '0.0') ), aggregated AS ( SELECT jd.device_id, jd.phone_brand, jd.device_model, jd.gender, jd.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(jd.is_active) AS active_apps_sum, AVG(jd.age) FILTER (WHERE jd.age IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age, MAX(jd.total_events_per_app) AS max_events_per_app, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT jd.category, ', ' ORDER BY jd.category) AS categories_list FROM joined_data jd GROUP BY jd.device_id, jd.phone_brand, jd.device_model, jd.gender, jd.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT jd.event_id) > 45 AND SUM(jd.is_active) BETWEEN 93 AND 12 AND (MAX(jd.total_events_per_app) < 983 OR AVG(jd.age) FILTER (WHERE jd.age IS NOT NULL) > 30) ) SELECT a.device_id, a.phone_brand, a.device_model, a.gender, a.group1, a.total_events, a.total_apps, a.active_apps_sum, a.avg_age, a.max_events_per_app, a.categories_list, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_events DESC, a.active_apps_sum DESC) AS activity_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.gender ORDER BY a.avg_age DESC) AS age_rank_by_gender FROM aggregated a WHERE a.avg_age IS NOT NULL AND (a.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' OR a.device_model LIKE '%Galaxy%') ORDER BY a.total_events DESC, a.active_apps_sum DESC LIMIT 9226;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 88.82 AND 63.56 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -29.6 AND -46.89 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ae.app_id) AS total_events_per_app, SUM(ae.is_active) OVER (PARTITION BY ae.app_id) AS total_active_per_app FROM app_events ae WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 ), joined_data AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.event_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, das.app_id, das.is_installed, das.is_active, das.total_events_per_app, das.total_active_per_app, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, al.label_id, lc.category, ss.f23, ss.m22 FROM ranked_events re JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON re.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON re.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN app_labels al ON das.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON re.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE re.rn <= 14 AND ga.age >= 2 AND ga.age <= 76 ) SELECT jd.phone_brand, jd.device_model, jd.gender, jd.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(jd.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(jd.age) AS avg_age, AVG(jd.f23) AS avg_f23, AVG(jd.m22) AS avg_m22, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT jd.category, ', ' ORDER BY jd.category) AS label_categories FROM joined_data jd GROUP BY jd.phone_brand, jd.device_model, jd.gender, jd.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT jd.device_id) > 288 AND COUNT(DISTINCT jd.app_id) >= 3 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, total_events DESC LIMIT 826;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 9.31 AND -63.68 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -80.66 AND 76.15 ), device_app_metrics AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, re.device_id, re.timestamp, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model FROM app_events ae INNER JOIN ranked_events re ON ae.event_id = re.event_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON re.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON re.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE re.rn <= 36 AND (ga.age >= 54 OR ga.age IS NULL) AND (ga.gender = 'F' OR ga.gender IS NULL) ), app_label_aggregates AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ';' ORDER BY lc.category) AS categories FROM app_labels al INNER JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id ) SELECT dam.phone_brand, dam.device_model, dam.gender, dam.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT dam.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT dam.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(dam.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(dam.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(dam.age) AS avg_age, MIN(ala.distinct_labels) AS min_labels_per_app, MAX(ala.distinct_labels) AS max_labels_per_app, AVG(ala.distinct_labels) AS avg_labels_per_app, COUNT(DISTINCT ala.categories) AS distinct_category_sets FROM device_app_metrics dam INNER JOIN app_label_aggregates ala ON dam.app_id = ala.app_id WHERE dam.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND dam.timestamp < '2016-01-01' AND (dam.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' OR dam.device_model LIKE '%Galaxy%') GROUP BY dam.phone_brand, dam.device_model, dam.gender, dam.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dam.device_id) > 395 AND AVG(dam.age) BETWEEN 19 AND 98 AND (SUM(dam.is_active) > 7020 OR SUM(dam.is_installed) > 8896) ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, total_active DESC LIMIT 119;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e1.event_id, e1.device_id, e1.timestamp, e1.longitude, e1.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e1.device_id ORDER BY e1.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e1 WHERE e1.longitude BETWEEN 105.4 AND 84.76 ), device_app_metrics AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, re.device_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude FROM app_events ae JOIN ranked_events re ON ae.event_id = re.event_id WHERE re.rn = 1 ), brand_model_agg AS ( SELECT pbd.device_id, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT dam.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(dam.is_active) AS total_active_apps FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbd LEFT JOIN device_app_metrics dam ON pbd.device_id = dam.device_id GROUP BY pbd.device_id, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model ), gender_age_enhanced AS ( SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, bma.phone_brand, bma.device_model, bma.distinct_app_count, bma.total_active_apps, CASE WHEN ga.age < 20 THEN 'teen' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 20 AND 35 THEN 'young_adult' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN 'middle_aged' ELSE 'senior' END AS age_group FROM gender_age ga JOIN brand_model_agg bma ON ga.device_id = bma.device_id WHERE ga.age >= 62 ), label_category_agg AS ( SELECT al.app_id, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id ), app_behavior AS ( SELECT dam.device_id, dam.app_id, aa.app_id AS app_exists, lca.categories, dam.is_installed, dam.is_active, dam.timestamp, dam.longitude, dam.latitude FROM device_app_metrics dam LEFT JOIN app_all aa ON dam.app_id = aa.app_id LEFT JOIN label_category_agg lca ON dam.app_id = lca.app_id ), final_aggregation AS ( SELECT gae.age_group, gae.gender, gae.phone_brand, gae.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.app_id) FILTER (WHERE ab.is_installed = 1) AS installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.app_id) FILTER (WHERE ab.is_active = 1) AS active_apps, AVG(gae.distinct_app_count) AS avg_distinct_apps_per_device, SUM(gae.total_active_apps) AS total_active_apps_across_devices, MAX(ab.timestamp) AS latest_event_timestamp, MIN(ab.timestamp) AS earliest_event_timestamp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gae.age) AS median_age FROM gender_age_enhanced gae LEFT JOIN app_behavior ab ON gae.device_id = ab.device_id WHERE gae.age <= 10 GROUP BY gae.age_group, gae.gender, gae.phone_brand, gae.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ab.device_id) > 75 ) SELECT fa.age_group, fa.gender, fa.phone_brand, fa.device_model, fa.unique_devices, fa.installed_apps, fa.active_apps, fa.avg_distinct_apps_per_device, fa.total_active_apps_across_devices, fa.latest_event_timestamp, fa.earliest_event_timestamp, fa.median_age, ss.f23, ss.m22, (fa.unique_devices * 1.0 / NULLIF(ss.f23 + ss.m22, 0)) AS device_to_submission_ratio FROM final_aggregation fa LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON fa.unique_devices = ss.device_id ORDER BY fa.total_active_apps_across_devices DESC, fa.unique_devices DESC LIMIT 155;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -155.87 AND 173.12 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 49 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 32 ORDER BY event_count DESC, total_active DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -5.08 AND 108.98 AND g.age >= 56 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 90 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, g.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = g.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = g.device_id) AS avg_f23 FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON g.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-04-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 69.31 AND 109.56 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -27.65 AND -48.85 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gender_age_train gt WHERE gt.device_id = g.device_id AND gt.age > 35 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 4945) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gender_age_test gt2 WHERE gt2.device_id = g.device_id LIMIT 1 OFFSET 8506) GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, g.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 527 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 60 ORDER BY total_events DESC, g.device_id LIMIT 120;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, g.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ael.label_id) FROM app_labels ael WHERE ael.app_id = ae.app_id ) AS label_count_per_app FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON g.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -145.02 AND 159.55 AND g.age >= 65 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, g.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, ae.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 839 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ga.age > 42 GROUP BY ga.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 15 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_sum FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 56 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 3 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_sum FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE ga.age <= 68 AND e.timestamp <= '2016-06-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING SUM(ae.is_active) < 246 ORDER BY device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_app_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_event_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm WHERE pbdm.device_id = ga.device_id AND pbdm.phone_brand = 'Xiaomi' ) AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 23 ORDER BY installed_app_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 40 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 38 UNION ALL SELECT pbd.device_id, NULL::integer AS age, NULL::character varying AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT aer.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(aer.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbd JOIN events_relevant er ON pbd.device_id = er.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON er.event_id = aer.event_id WHERE er.longitude BETWEEN -108.25 AND 34.52 AND aer.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY pbd.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) >= 2;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1) AS active_installs, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, SUM(ae.is_installed * ae.is_active) AS install_active_product, GROUPING(ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category) AS grouping_id FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -127.48 AND 0.1 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -55.7 AND 1.77 AND ga.age >= 74 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category), (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id), (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id), (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model), (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand), (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1), (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender), (ga.device_id, ga.age), (ga.device_id), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 90 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 90 ORDER BY total_events DESC, ga.device_id, grouping_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pb.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps_sum FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE pb.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' AND ga.age >= 37 AND ga.age <= 43 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pb.phone_brand HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 41 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pb.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01' AND ga.age >= 18 AND ga.age <= 28 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pb.phone_brand), (ga.gender, ga.age), (ga.gender), (pb.phone_brand), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 82 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps_installed, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels_used, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS distinct_events_attended, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -54.61 AND 172.87 AND ga.age >= 82 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 42 ORDER BY distinct_apps_installed DESC, ga.device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS install_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS label_categories, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_gender FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -103.25 AND 139.01 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 56.85 AND 3.28 AND ga.age >= 24 AND ga.age <= 67 AND (pb.phone_brand LIKE '%a%' OR pb.device_model LIKE '%1%') AND lc.category ~ '^[A-Z].*$' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 624 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) >= 81 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 301 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_submission_score DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, MAX(pb.phone_brand) AS phone_brand, MAX(pb.device_model) AS device_model FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 50 AND ga.age <= 57 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -140.11 AND 48.87 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -28.56 AND 32.06 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 74 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 23 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_installs DESC LIMIT 397;

WITH device_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING SUM(ae.is_active) > 43 ) SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, de.distinct_apps, de.total_active, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COALESCE(ss.f23, 0) AS f23_score FROM gender_age ga JOIN device_events de ON ga.device_id = de.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 65 AND 51 ORDER BY de.distinct_apps DESC, ga.age ASC LIMIT 583;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 76.68 AND 100.41 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -70.44 AND 19.25 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 703 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 48 AND g.gender = 'F' ), event_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 95 GROUP BY re.device_id ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(das.is_active) AS total_active_apps, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dd.gender ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC) AS event_rank_by_gender FROM device_demographics dd JOIN event_aggregates ea ON dd.device_id = ea.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON das.app_id = ald.app_id WHERE ea.total_events > 683 GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) >= 3 ORDER BY app_rank, event_rank_by_gender LIMIT 9008;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e1.event_id, e1.device_id, e1.timestamp, e1.longitude, e1.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e1.device_id ORDER BY e1.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e1 WHERE e1.longitude BETWEEN 108.87 AND -141.42 ), device_app_metrics AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, re.device_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude FROM app_events ae JOIN ranked_events re ON ae.event_id = re.event_id WHERE re.rn = 1 ), brand_model_agg AS ( SELECT pbd.device_id, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT dam.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(dam.is_active) AS total_active_apps FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbd LEFT JOIN device_app_metrics dam ON pbd.device_id = dam.device_id GROUP BY pbd.device_id, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model ), gender_age_enhanced AS ( SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, bma.phone_brand, bma.device_model, bma.distinct_app_count, bma.total_active_apps, CASE WHEN ga.age < 20 THEN 'teen' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 20 AND 35 THEN 'young_adult' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN 'middle_aged' ELSE 'senior' END AS age_group FROM gender_age ga JOIN brand_model_agg bma ON ga.device_id = bma.device_id WHERE ga.age >= 63 ), label_category_agg AS ( SELECT al.app_id, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id ), app_behavior AS ( SELECT dam.device_id, dam.app_id, aa.app_id AS app_exists, lca.categories, dam.is_installed, dam.is_active, dam.timestamp, dam.longitude, dam.latitude FROM device_app_metrics dam LEFT JOIN app_all aa ON dam.app_id = aa.app_id LEFT JOIN label_category_agg lca ON dam.app_id = lca.app_id ), final_aggregation AS ( SELECT gae.age_group, gae.gender, gae.phone_brand, gae.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.app_id) FILTER (WHERE ab.is_installed = 1) AS installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.app_id) FILTER (WHERE ab.is_active = 1) AS active_apps, AVG(gae.distinct_app_count) AS avg_distinct_apps_per_device, SUM(gae.total_active_apps) AS total_active_apps_across_devices, MAX(ab.timestamp) AS latest_event_timestamp, MIN(ab.timestamp) AS earliest_event_timestamp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gae.age) AS median_age FROM gender_age_enhanced gae LEFT JOIN app_behavior ab ON gae.device_id = ab.device_id WHERE gae.age <= 55 GROUP BY gae.age_group, gae.gender, gae.phone_brand, gae.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ab.device_id) > 4 ) SELECT fa.age_group, fa.gender, fa.phone_brand, fa.device_model, fa.unique_devices, fa.installed_apps, fa.active_apps, fa.avg_distinct_apps_per_device, fa.total_active_apps_across_devices, fa.latest_event_timestamp, fa.earliest_event_timestamp, fa.median_age, ss.f23, ss.m22, (fa.unique_devices * 1.0 / NULLIF(ss.f23 + ss.m22, 0)) AS device_to_submission_ratio FROM final_aggregation fa LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON fa.unique_devices = ss.device_id ORDER BY fa.total_active_apps_across_devices DESC, fa.unique_devices DESC LIMIT 538;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, AVG(gat.age) AS avg_age FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age_train gat ON e.device_id = gat.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM phone_brand_device_model2 WHERE phone_brand = 'Xiaomi') GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 29 ORDER BY app_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -158.67 AND 86.39 AND g.age >= 64 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 71 AND AVG(e.longitude) < -83.58 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE al.app_id = ae.app_id AND lc.category = 'Games' ) AND e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-16 00:00:00' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 39 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps_sum FROM gender_age ga LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id LEFT JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 39 AND ga.age <= 25 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 14 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC, ga.device_id;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude > -16.17 AND e.latitude < -35.18 ), device_info AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age BETWEEN 50 AND 35 ), app_metrics AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active FROM app_events ae JOIN events e ON ae.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ae.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 12 ) SELECT di.device_id, di.age, di.gender, di.phone_brand, di.device_model, re.timestamp AS last_event_time, re.longitude, re.latitude, am.event_count, am.total_active, AVG(am.event_count) OVER (PARTITION BY di.phone_brand) AS avg_events_per_brand FROM device_info di LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON di.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN events e ON di.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_metrics am ON ae.app_id = am.app_id WHERE di.gender = 'F' GROUP BY di.device_id, di.age, di.gender, di.phone_brand, di.device_model, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, am.event_count, am.total_active ORDER BY di.age DESC, am.event_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 401;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_within_group FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 57 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -43.31 AND 112.66 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 67 ORDER BY total_events DESC, ga.device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-06-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 19 AND ga.age <= 52 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -116.85 AND -53.51 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 33.25 AND 64.13 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 2 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 4 ORDER BY total_events DESC, distinct_apps DESC LIMIT 724;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, CASE WHEN ga.age < 20 THEN 'Teen' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 20 AND 35 THEN 'Young Adult' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN 'Adult' ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_group FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 19 AND ga.age <= 19 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 83 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND er.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_event_count, (SELECT AVG(ss.f23) FROM sample_submission ss WHERE ss.device_id = ga.device_id) AS avg_f23 FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 20 AND ga.age <= 70 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gender_age_train gat WHERE gat.device_id = ga.device_id AND gat.gender = 'F' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) AND e.longitude BETWEEN 132.06 AND 177.31 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 56.17 AND 54.47 AND ae.is_installed > 0 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 164 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, ga.age ASC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(aer.is_active) FROM app_events_relevant aer JOIN events_relevant er2 ON aer.event_id = er2.event_id WHERE er2.device_id = ga.device_id AND er2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_active_ratio FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 36 AND ga.age <= 29 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 69.32 AND 115.79 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -51.07 AND 89.25 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 14 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand, ', ' ORDER BY pb.phone_brand) AS phone_brands, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_event_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ga.age BETWEEN 51 AND 57 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 63 ORDER BY distinct_app_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_gender FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 38 AND ga.age <= 41 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 1000 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 9 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT pbdm.phone_brand) AS distinct_brands, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pbdm.device_model, ', ' ORDER BY pbdm.device_model) AS device_models, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id), 0)::numeric AS active_event_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_demographic FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 146.8 AND 93.98 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 35.83 AND -43.41 AND ga.age >= 24 AND ga.age <= 71 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 358 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 3594 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 487 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude, avg_latitude LIMIT 656;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -176.5 AND 98.95 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 51 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

WITH device_activity AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 96 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, CASE WHEN g.age < 20 THEN 'teen' WHEN g.age BETWEEN 20 AND 35 THEN 'young_adult' WHEN g.age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN 'middle_aged' ELSE 'senior' END AS age_group FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 70 AND g.age <= 75 ), app_label_analysis AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) >= 43 ), device_app_metrics AS ( SELECT da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active_events, da.avg_latitude, da.avg_longitude, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, dd.age_group, COUNT(DISTINCT ala.app_id) AS apps_with_labels, AVG(ala.total_labels) AS avg_labels_per_app FROM device_activity da JOIN device_demographics dd ON da.device_id = dd.device_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON da.device_id = ae2.event_id JOIN app_label_analysis ala ON ae2.app_id = ala.app_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = da.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND er.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND er.latitude BETWEEN 53.9 AND -60.5 AND er.longitude BETWEEN -82.5 AND -13.12 ) GROUP BY da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active_events, da.avg_latitude, da.avg_longitude, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, dd.age_group ) SELECT dam.device_id, dam.distinct_apps, dam.total_active_events, dam.avg_latitude, dam.avg_longitude, dam.age, dam.gender, dam.group1, dam.phone_brand, dam.device_model, dam.age_group, dam.apps_with_labels, dam.avg_labels_per_app, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dam.age_group, dam.gender ORDER BY dam.total_active_events DESC) AS activity_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY dam.distinct_apps DESC) AS app_diversity_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dam.phone_brand ORDER BY dam.avg_labels_per_app DESC) AS label_percentile FROM device_app_metrics dam LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON dam.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE dam.total_active_events > 389 ORDER BY dam.total_active_events DESC, dam.distinct_apps DESC LIMIT 40;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn, AVG(ae.is_active) OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_active FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 26 AND ga.age <= 40 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -136.32 AND -87.82 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 86.3 AND -89.66 ), aggregated AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(re.is_installed) AS total_installed, SUM(re.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(re.moving_avg_active) AS avg_moving_active, MAX(re.age) AS max_age, MIN(re.age) AS min_age, COUNT(*) AS total_events, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.latitude) AS median_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 373 GROUP BY re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) > 34 AND SUM(re.is_active) >= 65 ) SELECT a.device_id, a.phone_brand, a.device_model, a.gender, a.group1, a.distinct_apps, a.total_installed, a.total_active, a.avg_moving_active, a.max_age, a.min_age, a.total_events, a.median_longitude, a.median_latitude, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_active DESC, a.distinct_apps DESC) AS activity_rank FROM aggregated a LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON a.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE a.total_installed > 38 ORDER BY activity_rank, a.device_id LIMIT 3964;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM phone_brand_device_model2 WHERE phone_brand = 'Xiaomi') GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 9 ORDER BY app_count DESC;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, AVG(gat.age) AS avg_age FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age_train gat ON e.device_id = gat.device_id WHERE ae.is_active = 1 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM phone_brand_device_model2 WHERE phone_brand = 'Xiaomi') GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 1 ORDER BY app_count DESC;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM events e LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -76.11 AND 88.68 GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) < 63 ORDER BY app_count DESC, last_event_time DESC;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS related_event_count, AVG(e2.longitude - e1.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e2.latitude - e1.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.event_id != e2.event_id JOIN app_events ae1 ON e1.event_id = ae1.event_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON e2.event_id = ae2.event_id JOIN app_labels al1 ON ae1.app_id = al1.app_id JOIN app_labels al2 ON ae2.app_id = al2.app_id JOIN label_categories lc1 ON al1.label_id = lc1.label_id JOIN label_categories lc2 ON al2.label_id = lc2.label_id WHERE e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e1.longitude BETWEEN -136.59 AND 99.41 AND e2.latitude BETWEEN -69.16 AND 10.36 GROUP BY e1.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) > 15 ORDER BY related_event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, AVG(ae.is_active) OVER (PARTITION BY g.gender) AS avg_active_by_gender, SUM(ae.is_installed) OVER (PARTITION BY g.age ORDER BY e.timestamp RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_installs FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE g.age >= 41 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, e.timestamp, ae.is_active, ae.is_installed ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND g.age >= 50 AND g.age <= 33 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 24.74 AND -108.95 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 47.99 AND -28.9 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 41 ORDER BY event_count DESC, total_active_apps DESC;
