WITH device_activity AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -154.69 AND -66.14 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 35.22 AND 5.1 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 74 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = g.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-06-01') AS recent_events_count FROM gender_age g LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 26 AND g.age <= 43 ), app_label_analysis AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) >= 22 ) SELECT da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (da.last_event_time - da.first_event_time)) / 3600 AS activity_hours, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, dd.recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(ala.total_labels) FROM app_label_analysis ala WHERE ala.app_id IN (SELECT app_id FROM app_events WHERE event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM events WHERE device_id = da.device_id))) AS avg_labels_per_app, (SELECT SUM(s.f23 + s.f24_26 + s.f27_28 + s.f29_32 + s.f33_42 + s.f43 + s.m22 + s.m23_26 + s.m27_28 + s.m29_31 + s.m32_38 + s.m39) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = da.device_id) AS total_submission_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dd.gender ORDER BY da.total_active_events DESC) AS gender_activity_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY da.distinct_apps DESC) AS global_app_rank FROM device_activity da JOIN device_demographics dd ON da.device_id = dd.device_id WHERE da.total_active_events > 701 AND dd.recent_events_count >= 11 ORDER BY da.total_active_events DESC, da.distinct_apps DESC LIMIT 941;

WITH device_aggregates AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, COUNT(*) AS total_events, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 31 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT COALESCE(ga.device_id, gat.device_id) AS device_id, COALESCE(ga.age, 0) AS age, COALESCE(ga.gender, 'unknown') AS gender, COALESCE(ga.group1, 'unknown') AS demographic_group, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model FROM gender_age ga FULL OUTER JOIN gender_age_train gat ON ga.device_id = gat.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON COALESCE(ga.device_id, gat.device_id) = pb.device_id ), app_label_analysis AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM app_events ae JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY ae.app_id ) SELECT dd.demographic_group, dd.gender, CASE WHEN dd.age < 20 THEN 'under_20' WHEN dd.age BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN '20_30' WHEN dd.age BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN '31_40' WHEN dd.age > 40 THEN 'over_40' ELSE 'unknown' END AS age_group, dd.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) AS device_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ala.app_id) AS total_apps_used, SUM(da.distinct_apps) AS sum_distinct_apps, AVG(da.distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, SUM(da.active_apps) AS total_active_apps, SUM(da.installed_apps) AS total_installed_apps, SUM(da.total_events) AS grand_total_events, MIN(da.first_event) AS earliest_event, MAX(da.last_event) AS latest_event, CORR(da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude) AS geo_correlation FROM device_aggregates da JOIN device_demographics dd ON da.device_id = dd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON da.device_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_analysis ala ON ae.app_id = ala.app_id WHERE dd.age >= 72 AND dd.age <= 25 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (dd.demographic_group, dd.gender, age_group, dd.phone_brand), (dd.demographic_group, dd.gender, age_group), (dd.demographic_group, dd.gender), (dd.demographic_group), (dd.phone_brand), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) > 488 ORDER BY device_count DESC, demographic_group, gender, age_group, phone_brand LIMIT 6986;

WITH device_aggregates AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installed, COUNT(*) AS total_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 44 AND g.age <= 71 ), app_label_analysis AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 15 ), device_app_label_summary AS ( SELECT da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active, da.total_installed, da.total_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, da.first_event, da.last_event, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ala.app_id) AS apps_with_many_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ala.label_categories, ' | ') AS aggregated_categories FROM device_aggregates da JOIN device_demographics dd ON da.device_id = dd.device_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON da.device_id = ae2.event_id JOIN app_label_analysis ala ON ae2.app_id = ala.app_id GROUP BY da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active, da.total_installed, da.total_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, da.first_event, da.last_event, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model ) SELECT gender, group1, phone_brand, device_model, COUNT(device_id) AS device_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, AVG(total_active) AS avg_total_active, AVG(total_installed) AS avg_total_installed, SUM(total_events) AS grand_total_events, MIN(first_event) AS earliest_event, MAX(last_event) AS latest_event, AVG(avg_longitude) AS avg_center_longitude, AVG(avg_latitude) AS avg_center_latitude, SUM(apps_with_many_labels) AS total_apps_many_labels, MAX(aggregated_categories) AS sample_categories FROM device_app_label_summary GROUP BY gender, group1, phone_brand, device_model HAVING COUNT(device_id) > 22 AND AVG(distinct_apps) >= 42.91 ORDER BY device_count DESC, avg_distinct_apps DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 61.68 AND 59.51 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 80.32 AND 58.87 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 820 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 62 AND g.gender = 'F' ), event_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 25 GROUP BY re.device_id ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(das.is_active) AS total_active_apps, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dd.gender ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC) AS event_rank_by_gender FROM device_demographics dd JOIN event_aggregates ea ON dd.device_id = ea.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON das.app_id = ald.app_id WHERE ea.total_events > 413 GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) >= 47 ORDER BY app_rank, event_rank_by_gender LIMIT 8228;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM events e LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id AND ae.is_installed = 1 LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude > -64.91 GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) < 23 ORDER BY last_event_time DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = g.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE g.age BETWEEN 53 AND 38 AND ae.is_installed = 1 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 19 ORDER BY installed_apps DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -174.96 AND 168.34 AND g.age >= 56 AND g.device_id IN ( SELECT device_id FROM phone_brand_device_model2 WHERE phone_brand IN ( SELECT phone_brand FROM phone_brand_device_model2 GROUP BY phone_brand HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_model) > 8 ) ) GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 100 ORDER BY installed_apps DESC, avg_latitude;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -146.03 AND 105.65 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 2 AND AVG(e.longitude) < -0.57 ORDER BY event_count DESC, g.device_id;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 92.11 AND 147.21 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 81.6 AND 77.99 AND g.age >= 72 AND g.age <= 43 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 299 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 416 ORDER BY event_count DESC, g.device_id;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -101.8 AND 19.6 AND lc.category = 'Games' AND g.age >= 56 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 74 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 6 ORDER BY total_events DESC, g.device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ga.age > 28 GROUP BY ga.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 19 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 59 AND ga.age <= 26 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 87 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 50 UNION ALL SELECT pbd.device_id, NULL AS age, NULL AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(aer.is_active) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT er.event_id) AS total_events, AVG(er.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(er.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbd JOIN events_relevant er ON pbd.device_id = er.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON er.event_id = aer.event_id WHERE er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND er.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND pbd.phone_brand = 'samsung' GROUP BY pbd.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) > 30 AND SUM(aer.is_active) >= 47 ORDER BY total_events DESC, active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(SUM(ae.is_active)) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.age) AS avg_active_per_gender_age FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 53 AND ga.age <= 45 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 11 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS rank_by_apps FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 47 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 14 ORDER BY unique_apps_installed DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE (e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AND (ga.age > 28 OR ga.gender = 'F') AND NOT (e.longitude IS NULL OR e.latitude IS NULL) AND lc.category NOT IN ('Game', 'Game') GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 75 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand, ', ' ORDER BY pb.phone_brand) AS phone_brands, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.device_model, ', ' ORDER BY pb.device_model) AS device_models, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, MAX(ss.f23) AS max_f23, MIN(ss.m39) AS min_m39 FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 31 AND ga.age <= 48 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 131.0 AND 81.65 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -80.07 AND -39.53 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 619 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 79 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 32 AND ga.age <= 34 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01' AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 88 ORDER BY distinct_app_count DESC, total_active_events DESC;

WITH combined_events AS ( SELECT e.event_id, e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude FROM events e UNION ALL SELECT er.event_id, er.device_id, er.timestamp, er.longitude, er.latitude FROM events_relevant er ), app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.event_id, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active FROM app_events ae UNION ALL SELECT aer.event_id, aer.app_id, aer.is_installed, aer.is_active FROM app_events_relevant aer ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT gat.device_id, gat.age, gat.gender, gat.group1 FROM gender_age_train gat UNION ALL SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1 FROM gender_age ga ) SELECT dd.gender, dd.group1, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(aa.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(aa.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(dd.age) AS avg_age, MIN(ce.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(ce.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM combined_events ce JOIN app_activity aa ON ce.event_id = aa.event_id JOIN device_demographics dd ON ce.device_id = dd.device_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ce.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE ce.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ce.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND dd.age >= 60 AND dd.age <= 49 AND ce.longitude BETWEEN 15.99 AND -161.69 AND ce.latitude BETWEEN -3.17 AND -41.41 GROUP BY dd.gender, dd.group1, lc.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) > 485 AND SUM(aa.is_installed) >= 3075 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, total_events DESC LIMIT 150;

WITH device_activity AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 100 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age BETWEEN 18 AND 40 ), app_categories AS ( SELECT al.app_id, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) >= 26 ), ranked_devices AS ( SELECT da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.active_events, da.avg_latitude, da.avg_longitude, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dd.phone_brand ORDER BY da.distinct_apps DESC) AS brand_rank FROM device_activity da JOIN device_demographics dd ON da.device_id = dd.device_id WHERE da.active_events > 101 ) SELECT rd.phone_brand, rd.device_model, rd.gender, rd.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT rd.device_id) AS device_count, AVG(rd.distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, SUM(rd.active_events) AS total_active_events, MIN(rd.age) AS min_age, MAX(rd.age) AS max_age, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ac.categories, '; ' ORDER BY ac.categories) AS aggregated_categories FROM ranked_devices rd JOIN events e ON rd.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_categories ac ON ae.app_id = ac.app_id WHERE rd.brand_rank <= 14 GROUP BY rd.phone_brand, rd.device_model, rd.gender, rd.group1 HAVING AVG(rd.distinct_apps) > 25.47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT rd.device_id) >= 25 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC, device_count DESC LIMIT 213;

WITH device_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id, al.label_id, lc.category, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON a.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON e.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ), aggregated_metrics AS ( SELECT de.device_id, de.phone_brand, de.device_model, de.age, de.gender, de.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT de.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT de.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(de.is_installed) AS total_installed, SUM(de.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(de.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(de.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(de.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(de.timestamp) AS first_event_time, COUNT(DISTINCT de.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(de.f23) AS sum_f23, SUM(de.f24_26) AS sum_f24_26, SUM(de.f27_28) AS sum_f27_28, SUM(de.f29_32) AS sum_f29_32, SUM(de.f33_42) AS sum_f33_42, SUM(de.f43) AS sum_f43, SUM(de.m22) AS sum_m22, SUM(de.m23_26) AS sum_m23_26, SUM(de.m27_28) AS sum_m27_28, SUM(de.m29_31) AS sum_m29_31, SUM(de.m32_38) AS sum_m32_38, SUM(de.m39) AS sum_m39 FROM device_events de WHERE de.rn = 1 GROUP BY de.device_id, de.phone_brand, de.device_model, de.age, de.gender, de.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT de.event_id) > 58 AND AVG(de.longitude) BETWEEN -43.03 AND 99.5 ), unmatched_devices AS ( SELECT gat.device_id FROM gender_age_test gat LEFT JOIN aggregated_metrics am ON gat.device_id = am.device_id WHERE am.device_id IS NULL ), final_analysis AS ( SELECT am.*, ud.device_id AS unmatched_device_id, CASE WHEN ud.device_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Unmatched' ELSE 'Matched' END AS match_status, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY am.total_events DESC) AS event_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY am.distinct_apps) AS app_percentile, LAG(am.total_active, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY am.gender ORDER BY am.last_event_time) AS prev_active_count FROM aggregated_metrics am LEFT JOIN unmatched_devices ud ON am.device_id = ud.device_id WHERE am.age >= 55 AND am.age <= 49 ) SELECT fa.device_id, fa.phone_brand, fa.device_model, fa.age, fa.gender, fa.group1, fa.total_events, fa.distinct_apps, fa.total_installed, fa.total_active, fa.avg_longitude, fa.avg_latitude, fa.last_event_time, fa.first_event_time, fa.distinct_categories, fa.sum_f23, fa.sum_f24_26, fa.sum_f27_28, fa.sum_f29_32, fa.sum_f33_42, fa.sum_f43, fa.sum_m22, fa.sum_m23_26, fa.sum_m27_28, fa.sum_m29_31, fa.sum_m32_38, fa.sum_m39, fa.unmatched_device_id, fa.match_status, fa.event_rank, fa.app_percentile, fa.prev_active_count, (fa.total_events * 1.0 / NULLIF(fa.distinct_apps, 0)) AS events_per_app, (fa.total_active * 1.0 / NULLIF(fa.total_installed, 0)) AS active_ratio FROM final_analysis fa WHERE fa.event_rank <= 729 ORDER BY fa.total_events DESC, fa.device_id LIMIT 1706;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 14.71 AND 83.87 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_labels al WHERE al.app_id = ae.app_id) AS label_count FROM app_events ae WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 ), joined_data AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.event_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, das.app_id, das.is_active, das.label_count, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, (SELECT AVG(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = re.device_id) AS avg_f23 FROM ranked_events re JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON re.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON re.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE re.rn <= 15 AND ga.age >= 38 ), aggregated AS ( SELECT jd.phone_brand, jd.device_model, jd.gender, jd.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(jd.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(jd.label_count) AS avg_labels_per_app, AVG(jd.age) AS avg_age, MIN(jd.avg_f23) AS min_avg_f23, MAX(jd.timestamp) AS latest_event_time FROM joined_data jd GROUP BY jd.phone_brand, jd.device_model, jd.gender, jd.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT jd.device_id) > 250 ) SELECT a.phone_brand, a.device_model, a.gender, a.group1, a.unique_devices, a.unique_apps, a.total_active, a.avg_labels_per_app, a.avg_age, a.min_avg_f23, a.latest_event_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id IN (SELECT jd2.device_id FROM joined_data jd2 WHERE jd2.phone_brand = a.phone_brand AND jd2.device_model = a.device_model) AND e2.timestamp BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-01') AS brand_model_event_count FROM aggregated a ORDER BY a.unique_devices DESC, a.total_active DESC LIMIT 356;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 158.75 AND 179.06 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -49.38 AND -5.51 ), device_app_metrics AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_installation_rate FROM ranked_events re JOIN app_events ae ON re.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE re.rn <= 30 GROUP BY re.device_id ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT gat.device_id, gat.age, gat.gender, gat.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model FROM gender_age_train gat LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON gat.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE gat.age >= 48 AND gat.age <= 59 ), app_label_aggregates AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS label_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id ), final_aggregation AS ( SELECT dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT dam.device_id) AS device_count, AVG(dam.distinct_app_count) AS avg_apps_per_device, SUM(dam.total_active_events) AS total_activity, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dd.age) AS median_age, COUNT(DISTINCT ala.categories) AS unique_category_sets FROM device_demographics dd JOIN device_app_metrics dam ON dd.device_id = dam.device_id JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON re.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_label_aggregates ala ON ae.app_id = ala.app_id WHERE dam.avg_installation_rate > 0.59 GROUP BY dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand HAVING AVG(dam.distinct_app_count) > 44.93 AND COUNT(DISTINCT dam.device_id) >= 960 ) SELECT gender, group1, phone_brand, device_count, avg_apps_per_device, total_activity, median_age, unique_category_sets, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_activity DESC) AS activity_rank FROM final_aggregation ORDER BY activity_rank, device_count DESC;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS related_event_count, AVG(e2.longitude - e1.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e2.latitude - e1.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.timestamp < e2.timestamp AND e1.event_id != e2.event_id WHERE e1.longitude BETWEEN -73.16 AND -141.75 AND e1.latitude BETWEEN 15.19 AND -8.93 AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY e1.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) > 57 ORDER BY related_event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND g.age >= 18 AND g.age <= 43 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 14 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND (g.age > 60 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 p WHERE p.device_id = g.device_id AND p.phone_brand = 'Xiaomi' )) GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 64 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -31.12 AND 128.92 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 p WHERE p.device_id = g.device_id AND p.phone_brand = 'Apple' ) GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 20 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ga.age > 71 GROUP BY ga.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 31 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-06-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 23 AND ga.age <= 37 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm WHERE pbdm.device_id = ga.device_id AND pbdm.phone_brand = 'Xiaomi' LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 25 ORDER BY unique_apps_installed DESC, total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_installed FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age > 56 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND lc.label_id IN ( SELECT label_id FROM label_categories WHERE category IN ( SELECT category FROM label_categories WHERE label_id = 944 ) ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 26 ORDER BY total_active DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS categories, COALESCE(ss.f23, 0) + COALESCE(ss.m22, 0) AS submission_score FROM gender_age ga INNER JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id LEFT JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-06-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE ga.age >= 23 AND ga.age <= 41 AND (e.longitude IS NULL OR e.longitude BETWEEN -58.39 AND 43.13) AND (e.latitude IS NULL OR e.latitude BETWEEN -29.46 AND 28.0) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ss.f23, ss.m22 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) >= 49 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC LIMIT 9478;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS distinct_event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_label_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_category_count, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS distinct_active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS distinct_installed_apps FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 23 AND ga.age <= 23 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -64.05 AND -123.87 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 74.96 AND 54.13 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 332 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 226 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(e.latitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY distinct_event_count DESC, distinct_app_count DESC, ga.device_id LIMIT 9684;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND (e.longitude BETWEEN 51.36 AND -18.47 OR e.latitude BETWEEN -66.19 AND 54.21) AND ga.age > 50 AND ga.gender = 'F' AND lc.category NOT IN ('A', 'A') AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 40 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 0 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -142.62 AND 173.78 AND ga.age >= 60 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > (SELECT AVG(app_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT app_id) AS app_count FROM app_events GROUP BY event_id) sub) ORDER BY active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, SUM(CASE WHEN lc.category = 'Communication' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS communication_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN lc.category = 'Game' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS game_apps, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, (MAX(e.timestamp) - MIN(e.timestamp)) AS event_time_span, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 60 AND ga.age <= 29 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 48.46 AND 25.97 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 41.84 AND -59.34 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 70 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 45 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, total_submission_score DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, (SELECT MAX(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = ga.device_id) AS max_f23 FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age > 29 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -87.14 AND 7.43 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 48.2 AND 68.08 AND ga.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM gender_age_train WHERE age BETWEEN 35 AND 38) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 465 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 41 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pb.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE pb.phone_brand LIKE 'Samsung' AND ga.age >= 61 AND ga.age <= 63 AND lc.category LIKE 'Game' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pb.phone_brand HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 24 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pb.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps_sum FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE pb.phone_brand LIKE 'Samsung' AND ga.age > 30 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pb.phone_brand HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 32 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_installed, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, MAX(lc.category) AS sample_category, MIN(pb.phone_brand) AS sample_brand FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -60.9 AND -144.57 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 36.47 AND -57.8 AND ga.age > 54 AND ga.age < 82 AND ae.is_installed = 1 AND pb.phone_brand LIKE 'A' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 88 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 5146 ORDER BY event_count DESC, total_active DESC;

WITH combined_events AS ( SELECT e.event_id, e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude FROM events e UNION ALL SELECT er.event_id, er.device_id, er.timestamp, er.longitude, er.latitude FROM events_relevant er ), app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.event_id, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active FROM app_events ae UNION ALL SELECT aer.event_id, aer.app_id, aer.is_installed, aer.is_active FROM app_events_relevant aer ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT gat.device_id, gat.age, gat.gender, gat.group1 FROM gender_age_train gat UNION ALL SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1 FROM gender_age ga ) SELECT pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, dd.gender, dd.age, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(aa.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(dd.age) OVER (PARTITION BY pbd.phone_brand, dd.gender) AS avg_age_by_brand_gender, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbd JOIN combined_events ce ON pbd.device_id = ce.device_id JOIN app_activity aa ON ce.event_id = aa.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN device_demographics dd ON ce.device_id = dd.device_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON pbd.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE ce.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ce.timestamp <= '2016-02-01 00:00:00' AND ce.longitude BETWEEN -136.04 AND 43.86 AND ce.latitude BETWEEN -27.16 AND 81.1 AND dd.age >= 20 AND dd.age <= 50 GROUP BY pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, dd.gender, dd.age, lc.category, pbd.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) > 28 AND SUM(aa.is_active) >= 4 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_age_by_brand_gender ASC LIMIT 997;

WITH device_activity AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 84 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, CASE WHEN g.age < 20 THEN 'teen' WHEN g.age BETWEEN 20 AND 35 THEN 'young_adult' WHEN g.age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN 'middle_aged' ELSE 'senior' END AS age_group FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 69 AND g.age <= 22 ), app_label_analysis AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) >= 17 ), device_app_metrics AS ( SELECT da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active_events, da.avg_latitude, da.avg_longitude, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, dd.age_group, COUNT(DISTINCT ala.app_id) AS apps_with_labels, AVG(ala.total_labels) AS avg_labels_per_app FROM device_activity da JOIN device_demographics dd ON da.device_id = dd.device_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON da.device_id = ae2.event_id JOIN app_label_analysis ala ON ae2.app_id = ala.app_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = da.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND er.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND er.latitude BETWEEN -54.77 AND 59.78 AND er.longitude BETWEEN -112.17 AND -70.51 ) GROUP BY da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active_events, da.avg_latitude, da.avg_longitude, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, dd.age_group ) SELECT dam.device_id, dam.distinct_apps, dam.total_active_events, dam.avg_latitude, dam.avg_longitude, dam.age, dam.gender, dam.group1, dam.phone_brand, dam.device_model, dam.age_group, dam.apps_with_labels, dam.avg_labels_per_app, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dam.age_group, dam.gender ORDER BY dam.total_active_events DESC) AS activity_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY dam.distinct_apps DESC) AS app_diversity_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dam.phone_brand ORDER BY dam.avg_labels_per_app DESC) AS label_percentile FROM device_app_metrics dam LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON dam.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE dam.total_active_events > 673 ORDER BY dam.total_active_events DESC, dam.distinct_apps DESC LIMIT 45;

WITH device_activity AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, al.label_id, lc.category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ), moving_avg AS ( SELECT device_id, timestamp, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS event_count_rolling, AVG(age) OVER ( PARTITION BY phone_brand, gender ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 43 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_age_by_brand_gender, SUM(is_active) OVER ( PARTITION BY device_id, app_id ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_active_events FROM device_activity WHERE rn <= 727 ), aggregated AS ( SELECT da.phone_brand, da.device_model, da.gender, da.group1, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT da.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(da.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(da.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(da.age) AS avg_age, MIN(ma.event_count_rolling) AS min_rolling_events, MAX(ma.avg_age_by_brand_gender) AS max_avg_age, SUM(ma.cumulative_active_events) AS total_cumulative_active FROM device_activity da JOIN moving_avg ma ON da.device_id = ma.device_id AND da.timestamp = ma.timestamp JOIN label_categories lc ON da.category = lc.category WHERE da.longitude BETWEEN -29.82 AND -61.14 AND da.latitude BETWEEN 58.7 AND 3.52 GROUP BY da.phone_brand, da.device_model, da.gender, da.group1, lc.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) > 95 ) SELECT phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, category, unique_devices, unique_apps, total_installs, total_active, avg_age, min_rolling_events, max_avg_age, total_cumulative_active, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY unique_devices DESC) AS rank_by_devices, LAG(total_active, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY phone_brand, gender ORDER BY unique_devices DESC) AS prev_total_active FROM aggregated ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, phone_brand, gender;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 176.64 AND 3.97 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 78.41 AND 59.59 AND ae.is_active = 0 AND ga.age >= 16 AND ga.age <= 39 ), aggregated_stats AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT re.label_id) AS distinct_labels, SUM(re.is_installed) AS total_installed, AVG(re.age) AS avg_age, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(re.timestamp) AS first_event_time, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.latitude) AS median_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 37 GROUP BY re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 830 ), windowed_analysis AS ( SELECT as1.device_id, as1.phone_brand, as1.device_model, as1.gender, as1.group1, as1.distinct_apps, as1.distinct_labels, as1.total_installed, as1.avg_age, as1.last_event_time, as1.first_event_time, as1.median_longitude, as1.median_latitude, SUM(as1.distinct_apps) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.phone_brand, as1.gender ORDER BY as1.avg_age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_apps_by_brand_gender, AVG(as1.distinct_labels) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.device_model, as1.group1) AS avg_labels_by_model_group, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY as1.group1 ORDER BY as1.total_installed DESC) AS rank_installed_in_group FROM aggregated_stats as1 JOIN events_relevant er ON as1.device_id = er.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON er.event_id = aer.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON aer.app_id = aa.app_id WHERE er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND er.timestamp <= '2016-01-01' AND aer.is_installed = 0 ) SELECT wa.phone_brand, wa.device_model, wa.gender, wa.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT wa.device_id) AS device_count, AVG(wa.distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, AVG(wa.distinct_labels) AS avg_distinct_labels, SUM(wa.total_installed) AS total_installed_sum, MAX(wa.avg_age) AS max_avg_age, MIN(wa.avg_age) AS min_avg_age, MAX(wa.cumulative_apps_by_brand_gender) AS max_cumulative_apps, AVG(wa.avg_labels_by_model_group) AS overall_avg_labels, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wa.rank_installed_in_group = 1) AS top_installed_devices FROM windowed_analysis wa GROUP BY wa.phone_brand, wa.device_model, wa.gender, wa.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT wa.device_id) > 10 AND AVG(wa.distinct_apps) >= 25.69 ORDER BY device_count DESC, total_installed_sum DESC LIMIT 85;

SELECT e.device_id, DATE(e.timestamp) AS event_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS daily_apps, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id)) OVER ( PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY DATE(e.timestamp) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_apps FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-16 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id, DATE(e.timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 4 ORDER BY e.device_id, event_date;

SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, AVG(e.longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_longitude_3row, AVG(e.latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_latitude_3row, pbd.phone_brand, ga.gender, ga.age FROM events e JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -170.44 AND 85.86 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' ORDER BY e.device_id, e.timestamp;

SELECT e.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, pb.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(*) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS install_events, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, pb.phone_brand ORDER BY ga.age ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_apps_per_demo, MAX(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY ga.age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_events_to_date FROM events e JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON e.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -60.94 AND 138.96 AND ga.age >= 35 AND lc.category = 'Communication' GROUP BY e.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, pb.phone_brand HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 84 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 3 ORDER BY total_apps_installed DESC, avg_longitude;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -68.72 AND 158.09 AND g.age > 20 AND lc.category IN (SELECT category FROM label_categories WHERE label_id > 490) GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 75 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -125.75 AND 164.34 AND g.age >= 48 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 78 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 50 AND ga.age <= 61 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 10 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC, distinct_app_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 33 AND 52 AND ga.gender = 'F' AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 56.59 AND -150.75 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -74.03 AND 2.24 AND lc.category = 'Game' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 864 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 69 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp) AS event_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) AS event_quarter FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2017-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -173.18 AND 141.67 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 58.37 AND -62.74 AND ga.age >= 88 AND ga.age <= 38 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 413 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_latitude ASC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pb.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id LEFT JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age > 45 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pb.phone_brand HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 73 ORDER BY active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 49 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand, ', ' ORDER BY pb.phone_brand) AS phone_brands, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.device_model, ', ' ORDER BY pb.device_model) AS device_models, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ga.age) AS median_age, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(ae.event_id), 0) AS active_percentage FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 42 AND ga.age <= 27 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 152.69 AND -130.33 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 24.66 AND 51.18 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 809 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 73 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 30 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

WITH device_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp) AS event_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.timestamp) AS event_month FROM events e INNER JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id INNER JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id INNER JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 154.68 AND -81.65 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -84.55 AND -55.42 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ae.is_active = 1 ), aggregated_stats AS ( SELECT de.phone_brand, de.device_model, de.gender, de.group1, de.event_year, de.event_month, COUNT(DISTINCT de.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT de.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT de.app_id) AS unique_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT de.label_id) AS unique_labels, AVG(de.age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN de.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS install_events, SUM(de.is_active) AS active_events, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY de.age) AS median_age FROM device_events de GROUP BY de.phone_brand, de.device_model, de.gender, de.group1, de.event_year, de.event_month ), joined_submission AS ( SELECT ag.*, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, (ag.unique_devices * ag.avg_age) AS device_age_score FROM aggregated_stats ag LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ag.unique_devices = ss.device_id WHERE ag.avg_age > 39 ) SELECT js.phone_brand, js.device_model, js.gender, js.group1, js.event_year, js.event_month, js.unique_devices, js.total_events, js.unique_apps, js.unique_labels, js.avg_age, js.install_events, js.active_events, js.median_age, js.device_age_score, SUM(js.f23 + js.f24_26 + js.f27_28 + js.f29_32 + js.f33_42 + js.f43 + js.m22 + js.m23_26 + js.m27_28 + js.m29_31 + js.m32_38 + js.m39) AS total_submission_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY js.phone_brand, js.gender ORDER BY js.device_age_score DESC) AS brand_gender_rank FROM joined_submission js GROUP BY js.phone_brand, js.device_model, js.gender, js.group1, js.event_year, js.event_month, js.unique_devices, js.total_events, js.unique_apps, js.unique_labels, js.avg_age, js.install_events, js.active_events, js.median_age, js.device_age_score, js.f23, js.f24_26, js.f27_28, js.f29_32, js.f33_42, js.f43, js.m22, js.m23_26, js.m27_28, js.m29_31, js.m32_38, js.m39 HAVING SUM(js.f23 + js.f24_26 + js.f27_28 + js.f29_32 + js.f33_42 + js.f43 + js.m22 + js.m23_26 + js.m27_28 + js.m29_31 + js.m32_38 + js.m39) > '0' AND COUNT(*) > 68 ORDER BY total_submission_score DESC, brand_gender_rank ASC LIMIT 786;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 61.88 AND -59.63 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 57.9 AND 23.62 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 0 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 940 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 59 AND g.gender = 'F' ), event_app_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, daa.app_all_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(daa.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(daa.is_installed) AS avg_installed FROM ranked_events re JOIN device_app_activity daa ON re.event_id = daa.event_id WHERE re.rn <= 14 GROUP BY re.device_id, daa.app_all_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) > 89 ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, eaa.app_all_id, eaa.event_count, eaa.total_active, eaa.avg_installed, ald.category, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.label_id) AS label_count, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score FROM device_demographics dd JOIN event_app_aggregates eaa ON dd.device_id = eaa.device_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON eaa.app_all_id = ald.app_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON dd.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE dd.age <= 97 GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, eaa.app_all_id, eaa.event_count, eaa.total_active, eaa.avg_installed, ald.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ald.label_id) >= 4 AND SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) > '0' ORDER BY total_submission_score DESC, eaa.event_count DESC LIMIT 346;

SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS distinct_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND g.age >= 51 AND g.age <= 46 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.age, g.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 88 ORDER BY distinct_events DESC, distinct_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_installed FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age > 19 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND lc.category = 'Game' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 6 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 21 AND ga.age <= 47 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 4 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 0 ORDER BY event_count DESC, total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 55 AND 37 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude > 154.61 AND lc.category = 'Game' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 6 AND AVG(e.latitude) < -69.96 ORDER BY event_count DESC, avg_latitude ASC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ( e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp < '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ) ) AND lc.category = 'Game' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 32 ORDER BY unique_apps_installed DESC, total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-02 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 22 AND ga.age <= 36 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE al.app_id = ae.app_id AND lc.category = 'Game' ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 10 ORDER BY total_active_apps DESC;
