SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_labels al WHERE al.app_id = ae.app_id AND al.label_id IN ( SELECT lc.label_id FROM label_categories lc WHERE lc.category = 'Game' LIMIT 51 OFFSET 37 ) ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 16 ORDER BY total_active DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 57 AND ga.age <= 34 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 15 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 6 ORDER BY total_installs DESC, event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id INNER JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id INNER JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id INNER JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id INNER JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 18 AND ga.age <= 26 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 45 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age > 30 AND ga.gender LIKE 'F' AND pbdm.phone_brand LIKE 'Samsung' AND lc.category LIKE 'Game' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 40 ORDER BY total_active DESC, event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS install_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS unique_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand, ', ') AS phone_brands, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(e.timestamp) - MIN(e.timestamp))) / 86400.0 AS activity_span_days, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '188 days') AND e.timestamp < (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '247 days') AND e.longitude BETWEEN -109.7 AND -157.44 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -49.46 AND -33.62 AND ga.age >= 20 AND ga.age <= 88 AND (EXTRACT(DOW FROM e.timestamp) IN (3) OR EXTRACT(DOW FROM e.timestamp) IS NULL) AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM e.timestamp) BETWEEN 5 AND 22) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 83 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 166 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(e.latitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, unique_apps DESC, activity_span_days DESC LIMIT 8910;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 46 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 38 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pbdm.phone_brand, ', ') AS phone_brands, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pbdm.device_model, ', ') AS device_models, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_labels al2 WHERE al2.app_id = ae.app_id) AS label_count_per_app, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_gender, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.device_id ORDER BY MIN(e.timestamp)) AS prev_event_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_train gat ON ga.device_id = gat.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_test gatest ON ga.device_id = gatest.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -116.09 AND 129.57 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -77.76 AND 43.7 AND ga.age >= 40 AND ga.age <= 37 AND ae.is_installed IN (0, 1) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, ae.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 70 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) >= 1 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude, avg_latitude LIMIT 9987;

WITH device_activity AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 37 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age BETWEEN 54 AND 42 ), app_label_analysis AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ') AS label_categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) > 13 ) SELECT da.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT aae.app_id) AS relevant_apps_installed, SUM(aae.is_installed) AS total_installed_flags, AVG(ala.distinct_labels) AS avg_labels_per_app, MAX(ala.label_categories) AS sample_categories, COALESCE(ss.f23, 0) AS submission_f23 FROM device_activity da JOIN device_demographics dd ON da.device_id = dd.device_id LEFT JOIN events_relevant er ON da.device_id = er.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant aae ON er.event_id = aae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_analysis ala ON aae.app_id = ala.app_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON da.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE da.total_active_events > 255 AND da.avg_longitude BETWEEN 156.2 AND 169.83 GROUP BY da.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, ss.f23 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT aae.app_id) > 12 ORDER BY da.total_active_events DESC, da.distinct_apps DESC LIMIT 443;

WITH device_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-06-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 21 AND ga.age <= 36 ), app_stats AS ( SELECT de.device_id, de.app_id, de.age, de.gender, de.phone_brand, COUNT(*) AS event_count, SUM(de.is_active) AS active_sum, AVG(de.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(de.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM device_events de GROUP BY de.device_id, de.app_id, de.age, de.gender, de.phone_brand ), window_stats AS ( SELECT as1.device_id, as1.app_id, as1.age, as1.gender, as1.phone_brand, as1.event_count, as1.active_sum, as1.avg_longitude, as1.avg_latitude, AVG(as1.event_count) OVER ( PARTITION BY as1.gender, as1.phone_brand ORDER BY as1.age ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_events, SUM(as1.active_sum) OVER ( PARTITION BY as1.gender ORDER BY as1.age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_active FROM app_stats as1 WHERE as1.event_count > 9 ) SELECT ws.gender, ws.phone_brand, ws.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.app_id) AS unique_apps, AVG(ws.event_count) AS avg_events_per_device, AVG(ws.moving_avg_events) AS avg_moving_window, MAX(ws.cumulative_active) AS max_cumulative_active, AVG(ws.avg_longitude) AS overall_avg_longitude, AVG(ws.avg_latitude) AS overall_avg_latitude FROM window_stats ws GROUP BY ws.gender, ws.phone_brand, ws.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ws.device_id) >= 41 AND AVG(ws.event_count) > 7.0 ORDER BY ws.gender, ws.phone_brand, ws.age;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 67.91 AND 76.96 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' ) SELECT phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, category, COUNT(*) AS event_count, SUM(is_active) AS active_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM ranked_events WHERE rn <= 57 AND age >= 62 GROUP BY phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, category HAVING COUNT(*) > 715 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn, AVG(ae.is_active) OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_active FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-02-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 18 AND ga.age <= 57 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -158.16 AND -54.19 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 6.39 AND 87.58 ), aggregated AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(re.is_installed) AS total_installed, SUM(re.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(re.moving_avg_active) AS avg_moving_active, MAX(re.age) AS max_age, MIN(re.age) AS min_age, COUNT(*) AS total_events, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT re.category, ', ' ORDER BY re.category) AS label_categories FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 751 GROUP BY re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) > 16 AND SUM(re.is_active) >= 66 ) SELECT a.device_id, a.phone_brand, a.device_model, a.gender, a.group1, a.distinct_apps, a.total_installed, a.total_active, a.avg_moving_active, a.max_age, a.min_age, a.total_events, a.label_categories, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_active DESC, a.distinct_apps DESC) AS activity_rank FROM aggregated a LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON a.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE a.max_age - a.min_age <= 9 ORDER BY activity_rank, a.device_id LIMIT 5418;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 59 ORDER BY app_count DESC;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS cross_event_count, AVG(e2.longitude - e1.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e2.latitude - e1.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.event_id != e2.event_id JOIN app_events ae1 ON e1.event_id = ae1.event_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON e2.event_id = ae2.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e1.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e1.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e2.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 38 GROUP BY e1.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) > 84 ORDER BY cross_event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND g.age >= 30 AND g.age <= 64 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -96.22 AND 86.58 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -76.82 AND 85.61 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 90 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -130.34 AND 76.78 AND lc.category = 'Games' AND g.age >= 28 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 100 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 27 ORDER BY total_events DESC, g.device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ga.age > 65 GROUP BY ga.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 13 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga LEFT JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude > 89.05 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 28 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 27 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING SUM(ae.is_active) > 2 ORDER BY total_active DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand, ', ' ORDER BY pb.phone_brand) AS phone_brands, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.device_model, ', ' ORDER BY pb.device_model) AS device_models, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, MAX(ss.f23) AS max_f23, MIN(ss.m39) AS min_m39 FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 60 AND ga.age <= 30 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -1.0 AND -14.09 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -52.46 AND -0.99 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 437 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 51 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -142.46 AND 171.0 AND ga.age >= 30 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 54 UNION ALL SELECT pbd.device_id, 'Unknown' AS gender, 0 AS age, COUNT(DISTINCT aer.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(aer.is_installed) AS installed_apps, AVG(er.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbd JOIN events_relevant er ON pbd.device_id = er.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON er.event_id = aer.event_id WHERE er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND er.longitude BETWEEN -10.23 AND 38.51 GROUP BY pbd.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT aer.event_id) > 57 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE (ga.age > 46 OR ga.gender = 'F') AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -152.31 AND -40.08 AND e.latitude NOT BETWEEN 30.87 AND -61.95 AND lc.category IN ('Game', 'Game') GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 87 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 10 ORDER BY total_events DESC, active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 52 AND ga.age <= 43 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 37 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND ae.is_installed = 1 AND lc.category = 'Communication' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 16 ORDER BY distinct_app_count DESC, total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, MAX(pb.phone_brand) AS phone_brand, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS group_rank FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -87.4 AND 64.72 AND ga.age >= 66 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 467 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 531 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, MAX(pb.phone_brand) AS phone_brand, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS group_rank FROM gender_age_train ga JOIN events_relevant e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.latitude BETWEEN -59.6 AND 82.07 AND ga.age <= 17 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) < 639 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <= 140 ORDER BY installed_apps DESC, active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT pbdm.phone_brand) AS distinct_brands, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pbdm.device_model, ', ' ORDER BY pbdm.device_model) AS device_models, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id), 0)::numeric AS active_event_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_demographic FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -125.41 AND 59.82 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 5.5 AND -42.95 AND ga.age >= 46 AND ga.age <= 78 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 837 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 6214 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 247 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude, avg_latitude LIMIT 478;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand) AS distinct_phone_brands, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.device_model) AS distinct_device_models, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = ga.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(lc.label_id) FROM app_labels al2 JOIN label_categories lc ON al2.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE al2.app_id IN (SELECT app_id FROM app_events ae3 WHERE ae3.event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM events e3 WHERE e3.device_id = ga.device_id))) AS avg_label_id_per_device FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_train gat ON ga.device_id = gat.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_test gatest ON ga.device_id = gatest.device_id LEFT JOIN events_relevant er ON e.event_id = er.event_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON ae.event_id = aer.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 125.57 AND 148.67 AND ga.age >= 23 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 540 AND AVG(e.latitude) < -78.68 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude ASC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand, ', ' ORDER BY pb.phone_brand) AS phone_brands, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.device_model, ', ' ORDER BY pb.device_model) AS device_models, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ga.age) AS median_age, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(ae.event_id), 0) AS active_percentage FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 49 AND ga.age <= 50 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -52.72 AND -29.33 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 28.59 AND -75.35 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 678 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 88 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 12 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

WITH active_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, ae.app_id, ae.is_active, ae.is_installed, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, al.label_id, lc.category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ), aggregated_stats AS ( SELECT device_id, phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(is_active) AS active_apps, SUM(is_installed) AS installed_apps, AVG(age) AS avg_age, COUNT(DISTINCT label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT category) AS distinct_categories FROM active_events WHERE rn <= 86 GROUP BY device_id, phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) > 25 AND AVG(age) BETWEEN 26 AND 31 ), high_value_devices AS ( SELECT a.device_id, a.phone_brand, a.device_model, a.gender, a.group1, a.total_events, a.total_apps, a.active_apps, a.installed_apps, a.avg_age, a.distinct_labels, a.distinct_categories, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39 FROM aggregated_stats a JOIN sample_submission ss ON a.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE ss.f23 > '0.0' OR ss.m22 > '0.0' ) SELECT device_id, phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, total_events, total_apps, active_apps, installed_apps, avg_age, distinct_labels, distinct_categories FROM high_value_devices WHERE total_apps >= 79 INTERSECT SELECT device_id, phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, total_events, total_apps, active_apps, installed_apps, avg_age, distinct_labels, distinct_categories FROM aggregated_stats WHERE distinct_labels > 13 AND distinct_categories > 12 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_age ASC LIMIT 757;

WITH combined_events AS ( SELECT e.event_id, e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude FROM events e UNION ALL SELECT er.event_id, er.device_id, er.timestamp, er.longitude, er.latitude FROM events_relevant er ), app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.event_id, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active FROM app_events ae UNION ALL SELECT aer.event_id, aer.app_id, aer.is_installed, aer.is_active FROM app_events_relevant aer ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT gat.device_id, gat.age, gat.gender, gat.group1 FROM gender_age_train gat UNION ALL SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1 FROM gender_age ga ) SELECT dd.gender, dd.group1, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(aa.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(aa.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(dd.age) AS avg_age, MIN(ce.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(ce.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM combined_events ce JOIN app_activity aa ON ce.event_id = aa.event_id JOIN device_demographics dd ON ce.device_id = dd.device_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ce.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE ce.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ce.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND dd.age >= 44 AND dd.age <= 57 AND ce.longitude BETWEEN -124.2 AND -144.84 AND ce.latitude BETWEEN 2.33 AND -38.01 GROUP BY dd.gender, dd.group1, lc.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) > 666 AND SUM(aa.is_installed) >= 7406 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, total_events DESC LIMIT 734;

WITH device_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, ae.app_id, ae.is_active, ga.age, ga.gender, pbd.phone_brand, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp) AS event_seq FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-02 00:00:00' ), moving_avg AS ( SELECT device_id, timestamp, age, gender, phone_brand, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS active_apps_moving_count, AVG(age) OVER ( PARTITION BY phone_brand, gender ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_age_by_brand_gender FROM device_events WHERE is_active = 1 ) SELECT phone_brand, gender, AVG(avg_age_by_brand_gender) AS final_avg_age, SUM(active_apps_moving_count) AS total_active_events, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS unique_devices FROM moving_avg WHERE age > 18 GROUP BY phone_brand, gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) >= 36 ORDER BY final_avg_age DESC, total_active_events DESC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -160.94 AND 0.21 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 27.71 AND 84.67 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, r.device_id, r.timestamp FROM app_events ae JOIN ranked_events r ON ae.event_id = r.event_id WHERE r.rn <= 84 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.category IN ('A', 'A') ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 53 AND g.gender = 'F' ), aggregated_metrics AS ( SELECT d.device_id, d.age, d.gender, d.group1, d.phone_brand, d.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(daa.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(daa.is_installed) AS avg_installation_rate, COUNT(*) AS total_events_processed, MAX(daa.timestamp) AS latest_event_time FROM device_demographics d JOIN device_app_activity daa ON d.device_id = daa.device_id JOIN app_label_details ald ON daa.app_id = ald.app_id GROUP BY d.device_id, d.age, d.gender, d.group1, d.phone_brand, d.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) > 36 AND SUM(daa.is_active) >= 162 ) SELECT am.device_id, am.age, am.gender, am.group1, am.phone_brand, am.device_model, am.distinct_app_count, am.total_active_events, am.avg_installation_rate, am.total_events_processed, am.latest_event_time, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY am.total_active_events DESC, am.distinct_app_count DESC) AS activity_rank FROM aggregated_metrics am LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON am.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE am.latest_event_time >= '2016-01-01' ORDER BY activity_rank, am.device_id LIMIT 3413;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 103.54 AND -110.31 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 20.6 AND 88.86 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, re.device_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude FROM app_events ae JOIN ranked_events re ON ae.event_id = re.event_id WHERE re.rn <= 77 AND ae.is_installed = 1 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category, daa.device_id, daa.timestamp, daa.is_active FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN device_app_activity daa ON al.app_id = daa.app_id WHERE lc.category IN ('A', 'A') ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT gat.device_id, gat.age, gat.gender, gat.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ald.category, ald.timestamp, ald.is_active FROM gender_age_train gat JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON gat.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON gat.device_id = ald.device_id WHERE gat.age >= 32 AND gat.age <= 34 ), aggregated_metrics AS ( SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT dd.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(CASE WHEN dd.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps_count, AVG(dd.age) OVER (PARTITION BY dd.phone_brand, dd.gender) AS avg_age_by_brand_gender, MAX(dd.timestamp) AS last_activity_time FROM device_demographics dd GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model ), final_join AS ( SELECT am.device_id, am.age, am.gender, am.group1, am.phone_brand, am.device_model, am.distinct_categories, am.active_apps_count, am.avg_age_by_brand_gender, am.last_activity_time, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY am.active_apps_count DESC, am.distinct_categories DESC) AS activity_rank FROM aggregated_metrics am LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON am.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE am.active_apps_count > 280 AND am.distinct_categories >= 31 ) SELECT device_id, age, gender, group1, phone_brand, device_model, distinct_categories, active_apps_count, avg_age_by_brand_gender, last_activity_time, f23, f24_26, f27_28, f29_32, f33_42, f43, m22, m23_26, m27_28, m29_31, m32_38, m39, activity_rank FROM final_join ORDER BY activity_rank, last_activity_time DESC LIMIT 668;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -1.01 AND 96.23 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -75.38 AND -40.0 AND ae.is_active = 1 AND ga.age >= 11 AND ga.age <= 1 ), aggregated_stats AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT re.label_id) AS distinct_labels, SUM(re.is_installed) AS total_installs, AVG(re.age) AS avg_age, WITH device_activity AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 57 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age BETWEEN 61 AND 35 ), app_categories AS ( SELECT al.app_id, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) >= 36 ), ranked_devices AS ( SELECT da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.active_events, da.avg_latitude, da.avg_longitude, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dd.phone_brand ORDER BY da.distinct_apps DESC) AS brand_rank FROM device_activity da JOIN device_demographics dd ON da.device_id = dd.device_id WHERE da.active_events > 479 ) SELECT rd.phone_brand, rd.device_model, rd.gender, rd.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT rd.device_id) AS device_count, AVG(rd.distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, SUM(rd.active_events) AS total_active_events, MIN(rd.age) AS min_age, MAX(rd.age) AS max_age, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ac.categories, '; ' ORDER BY ac.categories) AS aggregated_categories FROM ranked_devices rd JOIN events e ON rd.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_categories ac ON ae.app_id = ac.app_id WHERE rd.brand_rank <= 7 GROUP BY rd.phone_brand, rd.device_model, rd.gender, rd.group1 HAVING AVG(rd.distinct_apps) > 18.13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT rd.device_id) >= 37 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC, device_count DESC LIMIT 64;

WITH device_aggregates AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installed, COUNT(*) AS total_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -16.56 AND 3.93 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 53 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 57 ), app_label_analysis AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ';' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 39 ) SELECT dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, ala.label_categories, GROUPING(dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, ala.label_categories) AS grouping_id, COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) AS unique_devices, AVG(da.distinct_apps) AS avg_apps_per_device, SUM(da.total_active) AS grand_total_active, SUM(da.total_installed) AS grand_total_installed, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY da.total_events) AS median_events, MIN(dd.age) AS min_age, MAX(dd.age) AS max_age, AVG(dd.age) AS avg_age FROM device_aggregates da JOIN device_demographics dd ON da.device_id = dd.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON da.device_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_label_analysis ala ON ae.app_id = ala.app_id WHERE da.avg_latitude > 38.59 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, ala.label_categories), (dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand), (dd.gender, dd.group1), (dd.gender), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) > 859 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, grouping_id;

de.device_id, de.phone_brand, de.device_model, de.age, de.gender, de.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT de.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT de.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(de.is_installed) AS AVG(de.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(de.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(de.timestamp) AS first_event_time, SUM(de.f23) AS sum_f23, SUM(de.f24_26) AS sum_f24_26, SUM(de.f27_28) AS sum_f27_28, SUM(de.f29_32) AS sum_f29_32, SUM(de.f33_42) AS sum_f33_42, SUM(de.f43) AS sum_f43, SUM(de.m22) AS sum_m22, SUM(de.m23_26) AS sum_m23_26, SUM(de.m27_28) AS sum_m27_28, SUM(de.m29_31) AS sum_m29_31, SUM(de.m32_38) AS sum_m32_38, SUM(de.m39) AS sum_m39 FROM device_events de WHERE de.rn <= 73 GROUP BY de.device_id, de.phone_brand, de.device_model, de.age, de.gender, de.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT NULL ) SELECT ud.phone_brand, ud.device_model, ud.gender, ud.group1, COUNT(ud.device_id) AS device_count, AVG(ud.age) AS avg_age, SUM(ud.total_events) AS sum_total_events, SUM(ud.distinct_apps) AS earliest_event_time, SUM(ud.sum_f23) AS total_f23, SUM(ud.sum_f24_26) AS total_f24_26, SUM(ud.sum_f27_28) AS total_f27_28, SUM(ud.sum_f29_32) AS total_f29_32, SUM(ud.sum_f33_42) AS total_f33_42, total_m32_38, SUM(ud.sum_m39) AS total_m39 FROM unmatched_data ud WHERE ud.age >= 93 AND ud.age <= 5 GROUP BY ud.phone_brand, ud.device_model, ud.gender, ud.group1 HAVING COUNT(ud.device_id) > 27 SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = ga.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(ss.f23) FROM sample_submission ss WHERE ss.device_id = ga.device_id) AS avg_f23, (SELECT MAX(ss.m39) FROM sample_submission ss WHERE ss.device_id = ga.device_id) AS max_m39 FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 43 AND 63 AND e.timestamp BETWEEN '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -96.84 AND 62.9 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -77.6 AND 28.36 AND ae.is_installed > 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 529 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 57 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 59 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC LIMIT 290;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS label_categories, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, (MAX(e.timestamp) - MIN(e.timestamp)) AS event_time_span, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id), 0.0) AS active_app_ratio, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY ga.age) AS prev_event_count_by_gender_age FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_train gat ON ga.device_id = gat.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_test gatest ON ga.device_id = gatest.device_id LEFT JOIN events_relevant er ON e.event_id = er.event_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON ae.event_id = aer.event_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -82.54 AND -172.97 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 87.09 AND -14.67 AND ga.age >= 53 AND ga.age <= 32 AND (pb.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' OR pb.device_model LIKE '%Galaxy%') AND (ga.gender = 'F' OR ga.group1 LIKE '%F%') AND lc.category LIKE '%Game%' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 119 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 38 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 43 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(e.latitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, ga.device_id LIMIT 1985;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS categories, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id), 0) AS active_app_percentage, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_gender, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.device_id ORDER BY MIN(e.timestamp)) AS prev_event_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 38 AND ga.age <= 64 AND (pbdm.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' OR pbdm.device_model LIKE '%Galaxy%') AND e.longitude BETWEEN -135.44 AND 68.81 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -67.69 AND -14.64 AND ga.gender IN ('F', 'F') AND ga.group1 LIKE 'F%' AND lc.category LIKE '%Game%' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 913 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 88 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 10 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(e.latitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC LIMIT 160;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 168.83 AND 113.66 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 6.63 AND 14.23 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 0 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 713 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 66 AND g.gender = 'F' ), event_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 1 GROUP BY re.device_id ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(das.is_active) AS total_active_apps, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dd.gender ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC) AS event_rank_by_gender FROM device_demographics dd JOIN event_aggregates ea ON dd.device_id = ea.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON das.app_id = ald.app_id WHERE ea.total_events > 179 GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) >= 4 ORDER BY app_rank, event_rank_by_gender LIMIT 5432;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 48.67 AND -176.16 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -24.19 AND -73.22 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 0 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 723 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 33 AND g.gender = 'F' ), event_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 31 GROUP BY re.device_id ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(das.is_active) AS total_active_apps, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dd.gender ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC) AS event_rank_by_gender FROM device_demographics dd JOIN event_aggregates ea ON dd.device_id = ea.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON das.app_id = ald.app_id WHERE ea.total_events > 988 GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) >= 41 AND SUM(das.is_active) > 16 ORDER BY app_rank, SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, pb.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(ae.is_installed::numeric) AS avg_install_rate FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 53 AND lc.label_id >= 743 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, pb.phone_brand), (ga.age, ga.gender, pb.phone_brand), (ga.gender, pb.phone_brand), (pb.phone_brand), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 45 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.app_id IN (SELECT app_id FROM app_labels WHERE label_id = 160) AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING SUM(ae.is_installed) > 24 ORDER BY total_active DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -42.68 AND 13.88 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 82 ORDER BY total_active DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 26 AND ga.age <= 43 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 1 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_installed, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 61 AND ga.age <= 76 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 84 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) BETWEEN 63.98 AND 32.16 ORDER BY total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND ae.is_installed = 1 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 24 ORDER BY unique_apps_installed DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_installed, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS unique_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.device_id) AS brand_model_count, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 AND ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_installed_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude, (MAX(e.timestamp) - MIN(e.timestamp)) AS event_time_span FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 147.42 AND -156.57 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -0.35 AND 84.03 AND ga.age >= 50 AND ga.age <= 24 AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM e.timestamp) IN (5, 5) AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM e.timestamp) BETWEEN 17 AND 14 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 220 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 355 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 686 AND AVG(ae.is_installed) > 0.38 ORDER BY total_events DESC, unique_apps DESC LIMIT 345;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -89.82 AND 27.73 AND lc.category = 'Entertainment' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 48 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 164.3 AND 84.47 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 82.93 AND 28.21 ), device_app_metrics AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, re.device_id, re.timestamp, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model FROM app_events ae INNER JOIN ranked_events re ON ae.event_id = re.event_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON re.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON re.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE re.rn <= 55 AND (ga.age >= 90 OR ga.age IS NULL) AND (ga.gender = 'F' OR ga.gender IS NULL) ), app_label_aggregates AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ';' ORDER BY lc.category) AS categories FROM app_labels al INNER JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id ) SELECT dam.phone_brand, dam.device_model, dam.gender, dam.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT dam.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT dam.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(dam.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(dam.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(dam.age) AS avg_age, MIN(ala.distinct_labels) AS min_labels_per_app, MAX(ala.distinct_labels) AS max_labels_per_app, AVG(ala.distinct_labels) AS avg_labels_per_app, COUNT(DISTINCT ala.categories) AS distinct_category_sets FROM device_app_metrics dam INNER JOIN app_label_aggregates ala ON dam.app_id = ala.app_id WHERE dam.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND dam.timestamp < '2016-01-01' AND (dam.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' OR dam.device_model LIKE '%Galaxy%') GROUP BY dam.phone_brand, dam.device_model, dam.gender, dam.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dam.device_id) > 965 AND AVG(dam.age) BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND (SUM(dam.is_active) > 4620 OR SUM(dam.is_installed) > 9848) ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, total_active DESC LIMIT 918;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -4.83 AND -130.34 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -47.36 AND -43.01 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ga.age >= 68 ) SELECT re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) AS unique_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT re.label_id) AS unique_labels, SUM(re.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(re.age) AS avg_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.age) AS median_age FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 7 GROUP BY re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) > 368 AND AVG(re.age) < 53 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_age ASC LIMIT 494;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude > -65.91 AND e.latitude < -42.75 ), device_info AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age BETWEEN 33 AND 48 ), app_metrics AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active FROM app_events ae JOIN events e ON ae.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ae.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 79 ) SELECT di.device_id, di.age, di.gender, di.phone_brand, di.device_model, re.timestamp AS last_event_time, re.longitude, re.latitude, am.event_count, am.total_active, AVG(am.event_count) OVER (PARTITION BY di.phone_brand) AS avg_events_per_brand FROM device_info di LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON di.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN events e ON di.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_metrics am ON ae.app_id = am.app_id WHERE di.gender = 'F' GROUP BY di.device_id, di.age, di.gender, di.phone_brand, di.device_model, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, am.event_count, am.total_active ORDER BY di.age DESC, am.event_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 636;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn, AVG(ae.is_active) OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_active FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 48 AND ga.age <= 51 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -150.61 AND 140.46 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -15.11 AND -77.72 ), aggregated AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(re.is_installed) AS total_installed, SUM(re.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(re.moving_avg_active) AS avg_moving_active, MAX(re.age) AS max_age, MIN(re.age) AS min_age, COUNT(*) AS total_events, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.latitude) AS median_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 688 GROUP BY re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) > 32 AND SUM(re.is_active) >= 4 ) SELECT a.device_id, a.phone_brand, a.device_model, a.gender, a.group1, a.distinct_apps, a.total_installed, a.total_active, a.avg_moving_active, a.max_age, a.min_age, a.total_events, a.median_longitude, a.median_latitude, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_active DESC, a.distinct_apps DESC) AS activity_rank FROM aggregated a LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON a.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE a.total_installed > 75 ORDER BY activity_rank, a.device_id LIMIT 5222;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude > 161.0 GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 78 ORDER BY distinct_app_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS install_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, COUNT(DISTINCT al.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) AS distinct_labels, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT aae.app_id) FROM app_events_relevant aae WHERE aae.event_id IN (SELECT e2.event_id FROM events_relevant e2 WHERE e2.device_id = ga.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00')) AS recent_app_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.latitude BETWEEN -30.38 AND -4.34 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 132.05 AND 25.54 AND ga.age >= 71 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 907 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.app_id) >= 174 ORDER BY total_events DESC, recent_app_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-02 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 18 AND ga.age <= 59 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -157.24 AND -37.9 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -80.93 AND 22.17 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 6 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 6 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_active_apps DESC LIMIT 6811;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_group, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, pbdm.phone_brand ORDER BY AVG(e.longitude) DESC) AS longitude_rank_by_gender_brand FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 50 AND ga.age <= 29 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 152.38 AND 21.37 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 21.15 AND -70.3 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 468 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 339 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

as1.distinct_labels, as1.total_installs, as1.avg_age, as1.last_event_time, as1.first_event_time, AVG(as1.distinct_apps) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.phone_brand, as1.gender) AS brand_gender_avg_apps, RANK() WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -173.1 AND -172.0 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -30.37 AND -28.65 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 0 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 8 AND g.gender = 'F' ), event_app_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, daa.app_all_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(daa.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(daa.is_installed) AS avg_installed FROM ranked_events re JOIN device_app_activity daa ON re.event_id = daa.event_id WHERE re.rn <= 92 GROUP BY re.device_id, daa.app_all_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) > 24 ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, eaa.app_all_id, eaa.event_count, eaa.total_active, eaa.avg_installed, ald.category, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.label_id) AS label_count, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps_count, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_installed, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM gender_age ga LEFT JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE ga.age >= 43 AND ga.age <= 31 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-06-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 14 ORDER BY total_events DESC, active_apps_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS unique_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS categories, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pbdm.phone_brand, ', ') AS brands, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pbdm.device_model, ', ') AS models, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id), 0)::numeric AS active_rate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_gender, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank_overall FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 168.07 AND -122.64 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 7.36 AND 14.54 AND ga.age >= 2 AND ga.age <= 60 AND (pbdm.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' OR pbdm.device_model LIKE '%Galaxy%') AND lc.category LIKE '%Game%' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 988 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 38 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 358 ORDER BY total_events DESC, unique_apps DESC LIMIT 38;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pb.phone_brand = 'Samsung' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_brand_count, AVG(ga.age) AS avg_age, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(CASE WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 21 AND 62 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age_bracket_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.longitude BETWEEN -88.66 AND 53.95 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -17.75 AND 28.81 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS geo_bbox_events, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = ga.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN gender_age_train gat ON ga.device_id = gat.device_id JOIN gender_age_test gatest ON ga.device_id = gatest.device_id LEFT JOIN events_relevant er ON e.event_id = er.event_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON ae.event_id = aer.event_id WHERE ga.age > 12 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude IS NOT NULL AND e.latitude IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 841 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 65 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_age ASC LIMIT 1000;
