SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, AVG(ae.is_active) OVER (PARTITION BY g.gender) AS avg_active_by_gender, SUM(ae.is_installed) OVER (PARTITION BY g.age ORDER BY e.timestamp RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_installs FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE g.age >= 24 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, e.timestamp, ae.is_active, ae.is_installed ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE g.age > 29 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING SUM(ae.is_active) > 62 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE g.age > 42 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING SUM(ae.is_active) > 23 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps_installed, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels_used, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand) AS distinct_phone_brands FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE ga.age >= 60 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 50 ORDER BY distinct_apps_installed DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ga.age > 29 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 56 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND lc.category = 'A' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) <= 16 ORDER BY device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_gender FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 18 AND ga.age <= 63 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 55 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_in_group, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY ga.age) AS prev_total_apps_by_gender_age FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 25 AND ga.age <= 58 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -158.76 AND 150.07 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 30.86 AND -14.85 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 35 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, SUM(ae.is_installed) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_installed_30days, AVG(ae.is_active) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_active_avg_30days, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 46 AND ga.age <= 41 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -51.82 AND 163.05 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -63.52 AND -30.64 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, e.timestamp, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps_installed DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps_interacted, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(aer.is_active) FROM app_events_relevant aer JOIN events_relevant er2 ON aer.event_id = er2.event_id WHERE er2.device_id = ga.device_id AND er2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_avg_active, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY SUM(ae.is_installed) DESC) AS install_rank_in_group FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 21.12 AND -69.34 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 16.87 AND -51.2 AND ga.age >= 78 AND ga.age <= 98 AND ae.is_installed > 0 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 675 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 35 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 308 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_installs DESC, avg_longitude, avg_latitude LIMIT 490;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ( e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' ) ) AND ga.age BETWEEN 63 AND 38 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 8 ORDER BY installed_apps DESC, ga.device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps_count, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 26 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE al.app_id = ae.app_id AND lc.category = 'Communication' ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 8 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, SUM(CASE WHEN ga.gender = 'F' AND ga.age BETWEEN 23 AND 26 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f23_26_flag, SUM(CASE WHEN ga.gender = 'M' AND ga.age >= 32 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m32_plus_flag, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, (MAX(e.timestamp) - MIN(e.timestamp)) AS event_time_span, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 74 AND ga.age <= 51 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -112.27 AND 116.89 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 36.76 AND -87.28 AND (ss.f23 > '0.0' OR ss.m22 > '0.0') GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 583 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 202 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 56 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(e.latitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, total_submission_score DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp) AS event_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) AS event_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.timestamp) AS event_month, EXTRACT(WEEK FROM e.timestamp) AS event_week, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_demographic, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.device_id ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp)) AS prev_quarter_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 22.08 AND 107.1 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -25.96 AND -14.89 AND ga.age >= 74 AND ga.age <= 27 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp) = 2016 OR EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) = 4) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(WEEK FROM e.timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 530 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 81 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 190 ORDER BY total_events DESC, event_year DESC, event_quarter DESC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 105.31 AND -90.44 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_labels al WHERE al.app_id = ae.app_id) AS label_count FROM app_events ae WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 ), joined_data AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.event_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, das.app_id, das.is_active, das.label_count, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, (SELECT AVG(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = re.device_id) AS avg_f23 FROM ranked_events re JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON re.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON re.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE re.rn <= 89 AND ga.age >= 64 ), aggregated AS ( SELECT jd.phone_brand, jd.device_model, jd.gender, jd.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(jd.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(jd.label_count) AS avg_labels_per_app, AVG(jd.age) AS avg_age, MIN(jd.avg_f23) AS min_avg_f23, MAX(jd.timestamp) AS latest_event_time FROM joined_data jd GROUP BY jd.phone_brand, jd.device_model, jd.gender, jd.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT jd.device_id) > 17 ) SELECT a.phone_brand, a.device_model, a.gender, a.group1, a.unique_devices, a.unique_apps, a.total_active, a.avg_labels_per_app, a.avg_age, a.min_avg_f23, a.latest_event_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id IN (SELECT jd2.device_id FROM joined_data jd2 WHERE jd2.phone_brand = a.phone_brand AND jd2.device_model = a.device_model) AND e2.timestamp BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-01') AS brand_model_event_count FROM aggregated a ORDER BY a.unique_devices DESC, a.total_active DESC LIMIT 466;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ) SELECT phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS unique_devices, AVG(age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, SUM(CASE WHEN is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_events FROM ranked_events WHERE rn <= 8 GROUP BY phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1 HAVING AVG(age) > 45 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC LIMIT 43;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.event_id, e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, al.label_id, lc.category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS event_rank FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 31.23 AND -18.08 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -12.72 AND 62.82 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ga.age >= 31 ) SELECT re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(re.is_active) AS active_app_events, AVG(re.age) AS avg_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.age) AS median_age FROM ranked_events re JOIN app_labels al ON re.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE re.event_rank <= 18 AND re.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, lc.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) > 977 AND AVG(re.age) < 42 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_age ASC LIMIT 540;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS related_event_count, AVG(e2.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e2.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.event_id != e2.event_id JOIN app_events ae ON e2.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e1.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e1.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 57 GROUP BY e1.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) > 6 ORDER BY related_event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT a.app_id) AS unique_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS unique_labels, MAX(lc.category) AS sample_category FROM gender_age g INNER JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id LEFT JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON a.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE g.age >= 62 AND g.age <= 20 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 27 ORDER BY event_count DESC, g.device_id;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) FILTER (WHERE e.longitude IS NOT NULL) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) FILTER (WHERE e.latitude IS NOT NULL) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude > 36.13 AND lc.category = 'Communication' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 84 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps_installed, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels_used, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id WHERE ga.age > 24 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 47 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp) AS event_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) AS event_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.timestamp) AS event_month, EXTRACT(WEEK FROM e.timestamp) AS event_week, EXTRACT(DOY FROM e.timestamp) AS event_day_of_year, SUM(s.f23 + s.f24_26 + s.f27_28 + s.f29_32 + s.f33_42 + s.f43 + s.m22 + s.m23_26 + s.m27_28 + s.m29_31 + s.m32_38 + s.m39) AS total_submission_score FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN sample_submission s ON ga.device_id = s.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 39.2 AND -170.32 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 58.07 AND 86.6 AND ga.age >= 77 AND ga.age <= 14 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(WEEK FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(DOY FROM e.timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 132 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 275 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 45 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 62 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, total_installs DESC, total_active DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1) AS active_installs, SUM(ae.is_installed * ae.is_active) AS weighted_activity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_per_group, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ae.is_installed) DESC) AS install_dense_rank FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-02-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -97.7 AND 112.54 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -58.14 AND 75.81 AND ga.age >= 30 AND ga.age <= 48 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category), (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model), (ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand), (ga.gender, ga.group1, lc.category), (lc.category, ae.app_id), (ga.group1), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 46 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 44 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude, avg_latitude;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ga.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM phone_brand_device_model2 WHERE phone_brand = 'Xiaomi') GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 6 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 50 AND ga.age <= 41 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 121.37 AND -0.64 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -49.37 AND -13.25 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 3 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 48 ORDER BY total_active DESC, event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 64 AND ga.age <= 34 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -164.75 AND 35.36 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 3.84 AND -35.35 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 60 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 40 ORDER BY total_active DESC, event_count DESC;

WITH device_aggregates AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installed, COUNT(*) AS total_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 110.34 AND 139.13 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 86.13 AND -72.45 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 997 ), enriched_devices AS ( SELECT da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active, da.total_installed, da.total_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, da.first_event, da.last_event, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM device_aggregates da LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON da.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON da.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae2 ON da.device_id = ae2.event_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON ae2.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active, da.total_installed, da.total_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, da.first_event, da.last_event, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model ) SELECT ed.gender, ed.group1, ed.phone_brand, ed.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ed.device_id) AS device_count, AVG(ed.age) AS avg_age, AVG(ed.distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, SUM(ed.total_active) AS sum_total_active, SUM(ed.total_installed) AS sum_total_installed, SUM(ed.total_events) AS sum_total_events, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ed.distinct_labels) AS median_labels, MIN(ed.first_event) AS earliest_event, MAX(ed.last_event) AS latest_event FROM enriched_devices ed WHERE ed.age BETWEEN 54 AND 79 AND ed.total_events >= 6270 GROUP BY ed.gender, ed.group1, ed.phone_brand, ed.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ed.device_id) > 43 AND AVG(ed.distinct_apps) > 26.82 ORDER BY device_count DESC, avg_distinct_apps DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -93.41 AND 60.69 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -43.33 AND -66.56 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 0 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 77 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 53 AND g.gender = 'F' ), event_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 43 GROUP BY re.device_id ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(das.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(dd.age) OVER (PARTITION BY dd.phone_brand) AS avg_age_by_brand, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC) AS event_rank FROM device_demographics dd JOIN event_aggregates ea ON dd.device_id = ea.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON das.app_id = ald.app_id WHERE ea.total_events > 634 GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) >= 31 ORDER BY event_rank, dd.device_id LIMIT 1995;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 133.53 AND -46.81 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 62.76 AND 72.6 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 477 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 31 AND g.gender = 'F' ), event_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 90 GROUP BY re.device_id ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(das.is_active) AS total_active_apps, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dd.gender ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC) AS event_rank_by_gender FROM device_demographics dd JOIN event_aggregates ea ON dd.device_id = ea.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON das.app_id = ald.app_id WHERE ea.total_events > 707 GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) >= 41 ORDER BY app_rank, event_rank_by_gender LIMIT 8837;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-02 00:00:00' ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae INNER JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_active = 1 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 24 AND g.age <= 37 ), app_label_categories AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al INNER JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 135 ), complex_join AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.event_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, daa.app_id, daa.is_installed, daa.is_active, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, alc.category, ss.f23, ss.m22 FROM ranked_events re INNER JOIN device_app_activity daa ON re.event_id = daa.event_id LEFT JOIN device_demographics dd ON re.device_id = dd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_label_categories alc ON daa.app_id = alc.app_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON re.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE re.rn = 1 ) SELECT cj.gender, cj.phone_brand, cj.category, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.event_id) AS unique_events, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.app_id) AS unique_apps, AVG(cj.age) AS avg_age, SUM(cj.is_active) AS total_active, SUM(cj.f23) AS sum_f23, SUM(cj.m22) AS sum_m22, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cj.latitude) AS median_latitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cj.longitude) AS median_longitude FROM complex_join cj GROUP BY cj.gender, cj.phone_brand, cj.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cj.device_id) > 676 AND AVG(cj.age) BETWEEN 27.45 AND 36.68 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, avg_age ASC LIMIT 3108;

SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, AVG(e.longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_longitude_5prev, AVG(e.latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_latitude_5prev, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_events FROM events e JOIN gender_age_train gat ON e.device_id = gat.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON e.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND gat.age >= 62 ORDER BY e.device_id, e.timestamp;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e1.event_id) AS event_count_1, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS event_count_2, AVG(e2.longitude - e1.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e2.latitude - e1.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.event_id != e2.event_id JOIN app_events ae1 ON e1.event_id = ae1.event_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON e2.event_id = ae2.event_id JOIN app_labels al1 ON ae1.app_id = al1.app_id JOIN app_labels al2 ON ae2.app_id = al2.app_id JOIN label_categories lc1 ON al1.label_id = lc1.label_id JOIN label_categories lc2 ON al2.label_id = lc2.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e1.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON e1.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE e1.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e2.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 31 GROUP BY e1.device_id, pbdm.phone_brand, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e1.event_id) > 82 ORDER BY event_count_1 DESC, avg_longitude_diff DESC;

SELECT e1.device_id, e1.longitude AS start_longitude, e1.latitude AS start_latitude, e2.longitude AS end_longitude, e2.latitude AS end_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT ae1.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae2.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events_count, AVG(gat.age) AS avg_age, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT gat.gender, ', ') AS gender_list, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) AS distinct_label_count, MAX(pb.phone_brand) AS phone_brand, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY e1.device_id ORDER BY e1.timestamp) AS event_sequence_number, LEAD(e2.timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY e1.device_id ORDER BY e1.timestamp) AS next_event_time FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.event_id <> e2.event_id AND e1.timestamp < e2.timestamp JOIN app_events ae1 ON e1.event_id = ae1.event_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON e2.event_id = ae2.event_id JOIN gender_age_train gat ON e1.device_id = gat.device_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae1.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON e1.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e1.longitude BETWEEN 97.29 AND 148.05 AND e1.latitude BETWEEN 4.59 AND 51.04 AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND gat.age >= 32 AND ae1.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY e1.device_id, e1.longitude, e1.latitude, e2.longitude, e2.latitude, e1.timestamp, e2.timestamp, pb.device_id, pb.phone_brand HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae1.app_id) > 919 AND AVG(gat.age) < 27 ORDER BY e1.device_id, e1.timestamp;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(COALESCE(ae.is_active, 0)) AS avg_active_rate FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 23 AND ga.age <= 32 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 28 UNION ALL SELECT pbd.device_id, NULL AS age, NULL AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_apps_installed, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.app_id) AS avg_active_rate FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbd JOIN events e ON pbd.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-02-01' GROUP BY pbd.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) < 71 ORDER BY total_apps_installed DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps_installed, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS total_apps_active, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS install_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, COUNT(*) AS total_event_rows, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 935 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(e.latitude) IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT gat.device_id, NULL AS age, NULL AS gender, NULL AS group1, pb2.phone_brand, al2 ON aer.app_id = al2.app_id JOIN label_categories lc2 ON al2.label_id = lc2.label_id WHERE er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND er.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND er.longitude BETWEEN 42.03 AND 136.96 AND er.latitude BETWEEN -37.26 AND 82.1 GROUP BY gat.device_id, pb2.phone_brand, pb2.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) > 193 AND AVG(er.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(er.latitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_apps_installed DESC, avg_longitude DESC, avg_latitude DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, (SELECT AVG(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = ga.device_id) AS avg_sample_f23 FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 143.79 AND -62.97 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -44.36 AND 52.45 AND ga.age >= 18 AND ga.age <= 29 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 950 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 228 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gender_age_train gat WHERE gat.device_id = ga.device_id AND gat.age > ga.age) < 50 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(aer.is_active) FROM app_events_relevant aer JOIN events_relevant er2 ON aer.event_id = er2.event_id WHERE er2.device_id = ga.device_id AND er2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_avg_active FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-04-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 31.73 AND 49.88 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 53.63 AND 16.67 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gender_age_train gat WHERE gat.device_id = ga.device_id AND gat.age >= 19) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gender_age_test gat2 WHERE gat2.device_id = ga.device_id) AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 45 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 8 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC LIMIT 65;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(aer.is_active) FROM app_events_relevant aer JOIN events_relevant er2 ON aer.event_id = er2.event_id WHERE er2.device_id = ga.device_id AND er2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_active_ratio FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 48 AND 19 AND ga.gender LIKE 'F' AND pbdm.phone_brand LIKE 'A' AND pbdm.device_model LIKE 'A' AND e.timestamp BETWEEN '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -81.93 AND -107.87 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -5.98 AND 15.67 AND lc.category LIKE 'A' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 986 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 27 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 19 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(e.latitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, total_installs DESC LIMIT 310;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps_interacted, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(aer.is_active) FROM app_events_relevant aer JOIN events_relevant er2 ON aer.event_id = er2.event_id WHERE er2.device_id = ga.device_id AND er2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_avg_active, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_in_group, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ae.is_installed) DESC) AS install_dense_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(e.longitude)) AS longitude_percentile, SUM(SUM(ae.is_active)) OVER (PARTITION BY pbdm.phone_brand ORDER BY ga.age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_active_by_brand_age FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 151.23 AND -77.72 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -38.43 AND 33.48 AND ga.age >= 25 AND ga.age <= 50 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 27 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 42 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_installs DESC LIMIT 848;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events, SUM(ae.is_active) FILTER (WHERE ae.is_installed > 0) AS active_if_installed, GROUPING(ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category) AS grouping_id FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -69.42 AND -157.7 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 26.79 AND -78.15 AND ga.age >= 35 GROUP BY CUBE (ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category), ga.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 259 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 50 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude, avg_latitude LIMIT 6424;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, pb.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 61 AND ga.age <= 44 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -157.47 AND -83.02 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 42.81 AND -22.89 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, pb.phone_brand), (ga.age, ga.gender, pb.phone_brand), (ga.gender, pb.phone_brand), (pb.phone_brand), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 799 ORDER BY total_events DESC, ga.device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_install_rate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-06-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -166.63 AND -5.17 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -49.04 AND 83.06 AND ga.age >= 28 AND ga.age <= 21 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 72 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC LIMIT 962;

WITH device_aggregates AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installed, COUNT(*) AS total_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 177.53 AND 28.24 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -47.06 AND -23.15 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 943 ), enriched_devices AS ( SELECT da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active, da.total_installed, da.total_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, da.first_event, da.last_event, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM device_aggregates da LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON da.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON da.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae2 ON da.device_id = ae2.event_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON ae2.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active, da.total_installed, da.total_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, da.first_event, da.last_event, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model ) SELECT ed.gender, ed.group1, ed.phone_brand, ed.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ed.device_id) AS device_count, AVG(ed.age) AS avg_age, AVG(ed.distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, SUM(ed.total_active) AS sum_total_active, SUM(ed.total_installed) AS sum_total_installed, SUM(ed.total_events) AS sum_total_events, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ed.distinct_labels) AS median_labels, MIN(ed.first_event) AS earliest_event, MAX(ed.last_event) AS latest_event FROM enriched_devices ed WHERE ed.age BETWEEN 78 AND 75 AND ed.total_events >= 2216 GROUP BY ed.gender, ed.group1, ed.phone_brand, ed.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ed.device_id) > 84 AND AVG(ed.distinct_apps) > 28.14 ORDER BY device_count DESC, avg_distinct_apps DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH device_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON e.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ), aggregated_metrics AS ( SELECT de.device_id, de.phone_brand, de.device_model, de.gender, de.age, COUNT(DISTINCT de.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(de.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(de.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(de.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(*) AS total_events FROM device_events de WHERE de.longitude BETWEEN 169.2 AND 136.26 AND de.latitude BETWEEN -45.73 AND -6.41 GROUP BY de.device_id, de.phone_brand, de.device_model, de.gender, de.age HAVING COUNT(*) > 64 ) SELECT am.phone_brand, am.device_model, am.gender, CASE WHEN am.age < 20 THEN 'Under 20' WHEN am.age BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN '20-30' WHEN am.age BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN '31-40' WHEN am.age > 40 THEN 'Over 40' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS age_group, COUNT(am.device_id) AS device_count, AVG(am.distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, SUM(am.total_active) AS sum_total_active, MIN(am.avg_longitude) AS min_avg_longitude, MAX(am.avg_latitude) AS max_avg_latitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY am.total_events) AS median_total_events FROM aggregated_metrics am JOIN events_relevant er ON am.device_id = er.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON er.event_id = aer.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON aer.app_id = aa.app_id WHERE am.age >= 10 AND am.age <= 48 GROUP BY am.phone_brand, am.device_model, am.gender, age_group HAVING AVG(am.distinct_apps) > 6.94 ORDER BY device_count DESC, sum_total_active DESC LIMIT 603;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -119.98 AND 82.8 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -34.37 AND -80.86 ), device_app_metrics AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_installation_rate FROM ranked_events re JOIN app_events ae ON re.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE re.rn <= 17 GROUP BY re.device_id ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT gat.device_id, gat.age, gat.gender, gat.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model FROM gender_age_train gat LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON gat.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE gat.age >= 61 AND gat.age <= 64 ), app_label_aggregates AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS label_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id ), final_aggregation AS ( SELECT dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT dam.device_id) AS device_count, AVG(dam.distinct_app_count) AS avg_apps_per_device, SUM(dam.total_active_events) AS total_activity, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dd.age) AS median_age, COUNT(DISTINCT ala.categories) AS unique_category_sets FROM device_demographics dd JOIN device_app_metrics dam ON dd.device_id = dam.device_id JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON re.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_label_aggregates ala ON ae.app_id = ala.app_id WHERE dam.avg_installation_rate > 0.95 GROUP BY dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand HAVING AVG(dam.distinct_app_count) > 8.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT dam.device_id) >= 554 ) SELECT gender, group1, phone_brand, device_count, avg_apps_per_device, total_activity, median_age, unique_category_sets, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_activity DESC) AS activity_rank FROM final_aggregation ORDER BY activity_rank, device_count DESC;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS cross_event_count, AVG(e2.longitude - e1.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e2.latitude - e1.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.timestamp < e2.timestamp AND e2.longitude > 47.47 AND e2.latitude > 62.04 JOIN app_events ae ON e2.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e1.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ga.age >= 89 AND lc.category = 'Communication' GROUP BY e1.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) > 960 ORDER BY cross_event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, (MAX(e.timestamp) - MIN(e.timestamp)) AS event_time_span FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 119.19 AND -65.85 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 41.0 AND -35.67 AND ga.age >= 58 AND ga.age <= 87 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 559 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 95 AND (SELECT AVG(sub_ae.is_active) FROM app_events sub_ae WHERE sub_ae.app_id IN (SELECT sub_al.app_id FROM app_labels sub_al WHERE sub_al.label_id IN (SELECT sub_lc.label_id FROM label_categories sub_lc WHERE sub_lc.category = ga.group1))) > 0.9 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = ga.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = ga.device_id) AS avg_f23, (SELECT MAX(s.f43) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = ga.device_id) AS max_f43 FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 25 AND ga.age <= 52 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -88.0 AND 65.53 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -85.8 AND -32.82 AND ga.gender = 'F' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 586 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 256 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC LIMIT 984;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events, SUM(ae.is_active) FILTER (WHERE ae.is_installed > 0) AS active_if_installed, GROUPING(ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category) AS grouping_id FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -77.03 AND 147.99 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -22.47 AND -22.16 AND ga.age >= 68 GROUP BY CUBE (ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category), ga.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 219 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 4 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude, avg_latitude LIMIT 5245;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, al.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, lc.label_id, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1) AS installed_and_active_count, MAX(e.timestamp) AS latest_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS earliest_event_time FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -90.91 AND 55.26 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -70.88 AND 42.83 AND ga.age >= 59 AND (ae.is_installed = 1 OR ae.is_active = 1) GROUP BY CUBE( ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, al.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, lc.label_id, lc.category ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 775 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 87 ORDER BY total_events DESC, latest_event_time DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand) AS distinct_brands, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -162.28 AND -98.42 AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 893 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 498 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand) AS distinct_brands, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM gender_age ga JOIN events_relevant e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.latitude BETWEEN 5.8 AND 30.88 AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 251 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 378 ORDER BY device_id, gender, age;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank_by_gender FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 72 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING SUM(ae.is_active) > 83 ORDER BY app_rank_by_gender, total_active_events DESC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -106.25 AND 42.19 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -59.2 AND 73.57 AND ae.is_active = 1 AND ga.age >= 20 AND ga.age <= 78 ), aggregated_stats AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT re.label_id) AS distinct_labels, SUM(re.is_installed) AS total_installs, AVG(re.age) AS avg_age, re.latitude) AS median_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 48 GROUP BY re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 34 ), window_analysis AS ( SELECT as1.device_id, as1.phone_brand, as1.device_model, as1.gender, as1.group1, as1.distinct_apps, as1.distinct_labels, as1.total_installs, as1.avg_age, as1.last_event_time, as1.first_event_time, as1.median_longitude, as1.median_latitude, AVG(as1.distinct_apps) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.phone_brand, as1.gender ORDER BY as1.last_event_time ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_apps, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY as1.group1 ORDER BY as1.total_installs DESC) AS install_rank, LAG(as1.distinct_labels, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.device_model ORDER BY as1.last_event_time) AS prev_labels FROM aggregated_stats as1 WHERE as1.avg_age > 45.73 ) SELECT wa.device_id, wa.phone_brand, wa.device_model, wa.gender, wa.group1, wa.distinct_apps, wa.distinct_labels, wa.total_installs, wa.avg_age, wa.last_event_time, wa.first_event_time, wa.median_longitude, wa.median_latitude, wa.moving_avg_apps, wa.install_rank, wa.prev_labels, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id), 0) AS active_app_percentage, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_in_group FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 64 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 20.33 AND 131.72 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 60.86 AND -18.86 AND ga.device_id IN ( SELECT device_id FROM events_relevant er JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON er.event_id = aer.event_id WHERE aer.is_installed = 1 AND aer.is_active = 1 AND er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY er.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) > 82 ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 812 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 30 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 63 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp) AS event_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) AS event_quarter FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.timestamp < '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude > 91.44 AND e.latitude > 57.51 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 64 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 30 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS AVG(e.longitude)) AS longitude_percentile, LAG(ga.age, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY ga.device_id) AS prev_age_in_group FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN
