ga.group1, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 481 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 13 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_installs DESC LIMIT 964;

WITH device_activity AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 36 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age BETWEEN 57 AND 35 ), app_label_analysis AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS label_categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) >= 17 ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active_events, da.avg_latitude, da.avg_longitude, COUNT(DISTINCT ae_relevant.app_id) AS relevant_apps_installed, SUM(CASE WHEN ae_relevant.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_installed_apps, AVG(ala.total_labels) AS avg_labels_per_app, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ala.label_categories, '; ') AS aggregated_categories FROM device_demographics dd JOIN device_activity da ON dd.device_id = da.device_id LEFT JOIN events_relevant er ON dd.device_id = er.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant ae_relevant ON er.event_id = ae_relevant.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_analysis ala ON ae_relevant.app_id = ala.app_id WHERE da.total_active_events > 833 GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active_events, da.avg_latitude, da.avg_longitude HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae_relevant.app_id) >= 27 AND AVG(ala.total_labels) > 3.93 ORDER BY da.total_active_events DESC, dd.age ASC LIMIT 4827;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -124.91 AND -83.6 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 22.39 AND -13.49 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae LEFT JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 OR ae.is_active = 1 ), joined_labels AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al INNER JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.category NOT IN ('A', 'A') ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g FULL OUTER JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 24 AND g.age <= 71 AND g.gender = 'F' ), complex_aggregation AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS event_count, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 24 GROUP BY re.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) > 1 ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ca.event_count, ca.avg_longitude, ca.avg_latitude, ca.last_event_time, COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, COUNT(DISTINCT jl.label_id) AS distinct_label_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT jl.category, ', ' ORDER BY jl.category) AS label_categories FROM device_demographics dd INNER JOIN complex_aggregation ca ON dd.device_id = ca.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_activity daa ON re.event_id = daa.event_id LEFT JOIN joined_labels jl ON daa.app_id = jl.app_id WHERE (dd.phone_brand IS NOT NULL OR dd.device_model IS NOT NULL) AND (ca.avg_longitude > 34.18 OR ca.avg_latitude < -28.37) AND NOT (dd.age = 21 AND dd.gender = 'F') GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ca.event_count, ca.avg_longitude, ca.avg_latitude, ca.last_event_time ORDER BY ca.event_count DESC, dd.age ASC LIMIT 647;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -39.22 AND -55.65 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 46.8 AND 80.45 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, r.device_id, r.timestamp, r.longitude, r.latitude FROM app_events ae JOIN ranked_events r ON ae.event_id = r.event_id WHERE r.rn <= 26 AND ae.is_installed = 1 ), brand_model_info AS ( SELECT p.device_id, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, g.age, g.gender, g.group1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 p LEFT JOIN gender_age g ON p.device_id = g.device_id WHERE g.age >= 37 AND (g.gender = 'F' OR g.gender IS NULL) ), app_label_categories AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.category IN ('A', 'A', 'A') ), aggregated_metrics AS ( SELECT bmi.phone_brand, bmi.device_model, bmi.gender, bmi.group1, alc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT daa.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT daa.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(daa.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(bmi.age) FILTER (WHERE bmi.age IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age, MIN(daa.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(daa.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM device_app_activity daa JOIN brand_model_info bmi ON daa.device_id = bmi.device_id JOIN app_label_categories alc ON daa.app_id = alc.app_id GROUP BY bmi.phone_brand, bmi.device_model, bmi.gender, bmi.group1, alc.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT daa.device_id) > 499 AND SUM(daa.is_active) >= 1777 ) SELECT am.phone_brand, am.device_model, am.gender, am.group1, am.category, am.unique_devices, am.total_events, am.total_active, am.avg_age, am.first_event_time, am.last_event_time, ss.f23, ss.m22, ss.m39, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY am.phone_brand, am.gender ORDER BY am.unique_devices DESC) AS brand_gender_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY am.total_active DESC) AS overall_active_rank FROM aggregated_metrics am LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON am.unique_devices::bigint = ss.device_id WHERE (am.avg_age > 46.2 OR am.avg_age IS NULL) AND (am.first_event_time >= '2016-01-01' OR am.first_event_time IS NULL) ORDER BY am.unique_devices DESC, am.total_active DESC LIMIT 985;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -93.46 AND -66.44 OR e.latitude NOT BETWEEN -18.79 AND -85.94 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ae.app_id) AS total_events_per_app FROM app_events ae WHERE ae.is_installed = 0 OR ae.is_active = 0 ), joined_data AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.event_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, das.app_id, das.is_installed, das.is_active, das.total_events_per_app, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, al.label_id, lc.category, ss.f23, ss.m22 FROM ranked_events re INNER JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON re.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON re.device_id = pbdm.device_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON das.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON re.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE re.rn <= 5 AND (ga.age > 41 OR ga.gender = 'F') AND (pbdm.phone_brand IS NOT NULL OR pbdm.device_model IS NOT NULL) AND (ss.f23 > '0.0' OR ss.m22 < '0.0') ), aggregated AS ( SELECT jd.device_id, jd.phone_brand, jd.device_model, jd.gender, jd.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(jd.is_active) AS active_apps_sum, AVG(jd.age) FILTER (WHERE jd.age IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age, MAX(jd.total_events_per_app) AS max_events_per_app, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT jd.category, ', ' ORDER BY jd.category) AS categories_list FROM joined_data jd GROUP BY jd.device_id, jd.phone_brand, jd.device_model, jd.gender, jd.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT jd.event_id) > 32 AND SUM(jd.is_active) BETWEEN 76 AND 64 AND (MAX(jd.total_events_per_app) < 674 OR AVG(jd.age) FILTER (WHERE jd.age IS NOT NULL) > 73) ) SELECT a.device_id, a.phone_brand, a.device_model, a.gender, a.group1, a.total_events, a.total_apps, a.active_apps_sum, a.avg_age, a.max_events_per_app, a.categories_list, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_events DESC, a.active_apps_sum DESC) AS activity_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.gender ORDER BY a.avg_age DESC) AS age_rank_by_gender FROM aggregated a WHERE a.avg_age IS NOT NULL AND (a.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' OR a.device_model LIKE '%Galaxy%') ORDER BY a.total_events DESC, a.active_apps_sum DESC LIMIT 6810;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.latitude BETWEEN 12.34 AND 38.18 ) SELECT phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS unique_devices, AVG(age) AS avg_age, MAX(timestamp) AS latest_event_time FROM ranked_events WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY phone_brand, device_model, gender, group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) > 25 AND AVG(age) >= 32 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, avg_age ASC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -94.68 AND 126.75 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 10 AND AVG(e.longitude) < -106.89 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND (e.longitude > 97.01 OR e.latitude < 18.7) AND g.age BETWEEN 52 AND 64 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 p WHERE p.device_id = g.device_id AND p.phone_brand = 'Apple') AND g.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM gender_age_train WHERE gender = 'F') GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 536 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_installed FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age > 29 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND lc.category = 'Game' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 14 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand, ', ' ORDER BY pb.phone_brand) AS brands_list FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 73 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age > 28 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.latitude BETWEEN -80.81 AND -39.29 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 40 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 15 ORDER BY event_count DESC, total_active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 36 AND ga.age <= 27 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01' AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 89 ORDER BY total_events DESC, ga.device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(aer.is_active) FROM app_events_relevant aer JOIN events_relevant er2 ON aer.event_id = er2.event_id WHERE er2.device_id = ga.device_id AND er2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_active_ratio FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -95.52 AND -178.08 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 20.72 AND 65.95 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 725 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 59 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, installed_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, SUM(s.f23 + s.f24_26 + s.f27_28 + s.f29_32 + s.f33_42 + s.f43 + s.m22 + s.m23_26 + s.m27_28 + s.m29_31 + s.m32_38 + s.m39) AS total_submission_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_demographic, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model) AS avg_apps_per_device_model FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission s ON ga.device_id = s.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 30 AND ga.age <= 38 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 18.04 AND 81.02 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 24.24 AND -58.21 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 167 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 215 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(aer.is_active) FROM app_events_relevant aer JOIN events_relevant er2 ON aer.event_id = er2.event_id WHERE er2.device_id = ga.device_id AND er2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01') AS recent_active_ratio FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 50 AND 63 AND e.timestamp BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -19.53 AND 87.0 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 74.19 AND -88.57 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 682 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 10 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 62 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC LIMIT 9452;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 23.38 AND -120.1 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -82.28 AND -13.0 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae LEFT JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 OR ae.is_active = 0 ), joined_labels AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al INNER JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.category NOT IN ('A', 'A') ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g FULL OUTER JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 56 AND g.age <= 57 AND g.gender = 'F' ), complex_aggregation AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS event_count, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 21 GROUP BY re.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) > 24 ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ca.event_count, ca.avg_longitude, ca.avg_latitude, ca.last_event_time, COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, COUNT(DISTINCT jl.label_id) AS distinct_label_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT jl.category, ', ' ORDER BY jl.category) AS label_categories FROM device_demographics dd INNER JOIN complex_aggregation ca ON dd.device_id = ca.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_activity daa ON re.event_id = daa.event_id LEFT JOIN joined_labels jl ON daa.app_id = jl.app_id WHERE (dd.phone_brand IS NOT NULL OR dd.device_model IS NOT NULL) AND (ca.avg_longitude > 42.77 OR ca.avg_latitude < 49.14) AND NOT (dd.age = 22 AND dd.gender = 'F') GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ca.event_count, ca.avg_longitude, ca.avg_latitude, ca.last_event_time ORDER BY ca.event_count DESC, dd.age ASC LIMIT 368;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e1.event_id, e1.device_id, e1.timestamp, e1.longitude, e1.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e1.device_id ORDER BY e1.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e1 WHERE e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e1.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' ), device_app_metrics AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, re.device_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model FROM app_events ae JOIN ranked_events re ON ae.event_id = re.event_id LEFT JOIN gender_age ga ON re.device_id = ga.device_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON re.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE re.rn = 1 ), app_label_aggregates AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id ), complex_join AS ( SELECT dam.device_id, dam.app_id, dam.age, dam.gender, dam.group1, dam.phone_brand, dam.device_model, dam.timestamp, dam.longitude, dam.latitude, ala.distinct_labels, ala.label_categories, aa.app_id AS all_app_id, CASE WHEN dam.is_active = 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN dam.is_installed = 1 THEN 'Installed' ELSE 'None' END AS app_status, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY dam.device_id) AS apps_per_device, AVG(dam.age) OVER (PARTITION BY dam.phone_brand, dam.device_model) AS avg_age_by_model FROM device_app_metrics dam JOIN app_label_aggregates ala ON dam.app_id = ala.app_id LEFT JOIN app_all aa ON dam.app_id = aa.app_id WHERE dam.age BETWEEN 43 AND 38 ), final_aggregation AS ( SELECT cj.device_id, cj.phone_brand, cj.device_model, cj.gender, cj.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(cj.distinct_labels) AS total_labels, MAX(cj.apps_per_device) AS max_apps_per_device, AVG(cj.avg_age_by_model) AS overall_avg_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cj.age) AS median_age, BOOL_OR(CASE WHEN cj.app_status = 'Active' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS has_active_app FROM complex_join cj GROUP BY cj.device_id, cj.phone_brand, cj.device_model, cj.gender, cj.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cj.app_id) > 48 AND AVG(cj.avg_age_by_model) < 56.33 ) SELECT fa.device_id, fa.phone_brand, fa.device_model, fa.gender, fa.group1, fa.total_apps, fa.total_labels, fa.max_apps_per_device, fa.overall_avg_age, fa.median_age, fa.has_active_app, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fa.total_apps DESC, fa.total_labels DESC) AS overall_rank FROM final_aggregation fa LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON fa.device_id = ss.device_id ORDER BY overall_rank, fa.device_id LIMIT 4605;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, AVG(gat.age) AS avg_age FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age_train gat ON e.device_id = gat.device_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM phone_brand_device_model2 WHERE phone_brand = 'Xiaomi') GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 28 ORDER BY app_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_in_group FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age > 35 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 94 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp) AS event_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) AS event_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.timestamp) AS event_month, EXTRACT(WEEK FROM e.timestamp) AS event_week, EXTRACT(DOW FROM e.timestamp) AS event_dow, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -75.35 AND -44.26 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 69.63 AND -45.16 AND ga.age >= 50 AND ga.age <= 96 AND (ae.is_installed = 1 OR ae.is_active = 1) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(WEEK FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(DOW FROM e.timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 293 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 398 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 97 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 97 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(e.latitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, total_installs DESC, total_active DESC, total_labels DESC, total_categories DESC, total_submission_score DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1) AS active_installs, GROUPING(ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category) AS grouping_id FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -171.4 AND -104.27 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 82.95 AND -64.42 AND ga.age >= 84 AND ga.age <= 43 GROUP BY CUBE (ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category), ga.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 144 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 147 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_installs DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 30 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING SUM(ae.is_active) > 1 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -119.81 AND -111.42 AND ga.age >= 56 AND ga.age <= 60 GROUP BY CUBE(ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ga.device_id) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 214 ORDER BY event_count DESC, app_count DESC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 64.22 AND -136.81 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -69.97 AND 51.04 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ae.app_id) AS total_events_per_app FROM app_events ae WHERE ae.is_installed = 0 AND ae.is_active = 0 ), joined_data AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.event_id, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, das.app_id, das.is_installed, das.is_active, das.total_events_per_app, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, al.label_id, lc.category, ss.f23, ss.m22 FROM ranked_events re JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON re.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON re.device_id = pbdm.device_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON das.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON re.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE re.rn <= 66 AND ga.age >= 58 AND ga.age <= 93 ) SELECT jd.phone_brand, jd.device_model, jd.gender, jd.group1, jd.category, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(jd.total_events_per_app) AS sum_events_per_app, AVG(jd.age) AS avg_age, MIN(jd.timestamp) AS earliest_timestamp, MAX(jd.timestamp) AS latest_timestamp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY jd.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY jd.latitude) AS median_latitude, COALESCE(SUM(jd.f23), 0) AS total_f23, COALESCE(SUM(jd.m22), 0) AS total_m22 FROM joined_data jd GROUP BY jd.phone_brand, jd.device_model, jd.gender, jd.group1, jd.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT jd.event_id) > 794 AND COUNT(DISTINCT jd.device_id) >= 147 AND AVG(jd.age) BETWEEN 46 AND 72 ORDER BY total_events DESC, unique_devices DESC LIMIT 159;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS related_event_count, AVG(e2.longitude - e1.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e2.latitude - e1.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.timestamp < e2.timestamp AND e1.event_id != e2.event_id JOIN app_events ae1 ON e1.event_id = ae1.event_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON e2.event_id = ae2.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e1.device_id = ga.device_id WHERE e1.longitude BETWEEN -87.99 AND 119.61 AND e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ga.age >= 87 GROUP BY e1.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) > 76 ORDER BY related_event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND g.age >= 61 AND g.age <= 51 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 99 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event, COALESCE(SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39), 0) AS total_submission_score FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id LEFT JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE ga.age > 35 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -99.46 AND 67.8 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -21.64 AND 0.77 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 46 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 3 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, total_submission_score DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = ga.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = ga.device_id) AS avg_f23 FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 152.15 AND -172.03 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -12.05 AND 21.37 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 792 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 471 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 61 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = ga.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = ga.device_id) AS avg_f23, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_in_group, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ae.is_active) DESC) AS active_dense_rank FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 19 AND ga.age <= 47 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -179.52 AND -10.39 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -12.95 AND 4.44 AND ae.is_installed > 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 402 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 261 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_active DESC LIMIT 5052;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -136.99 AND 112.15 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -88.79 AND -0.52 ), device_app_metrics AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(ae.is_installed) AS avg_installation_rate FROM ranked_events re JOIN app_events ae ON re.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE re.rn <= 4 GROUP BY re.device_id ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT gat.device_id, gat.age, gat.gender, gat.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model FROM gender_age_train gat LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON gat.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE gat.age >= 31 AND gat.age <= 42 ), app_label_aggregates AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS label_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps_installed, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels_used, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS distinct_events_attended, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -35.16 AND 138.93 AND ga.age >= 24 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 30 ORDER BY distinct_apps_installed DESC, ga.device_id;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 74.28 AND -159.8 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -40.36 AND -48.1 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, r.device_id, r.timestamp FROM app_events ae JOIN ranked_events r ON ae.event_id = r.event_id WHERE r.rn <= 4 ), brand_model_info AS ( SELECT p.device_id, p.phone_brand, p.device_model, g.age, g.gender, g.group1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 p LEFT JOIN gender_age g ON p.device_id = g.device_id ), app_label_categories AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id >= 279 ), aggregated_metrics AS ( SELECT bm.device_id, bm.phone_brand, bm.device_model, bm.age, bm.gender, bm.group1, daa.app_id, alc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT daa.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(daa.is_installed) AS total_installed, SUM(daa.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(daa.is_active) AS avg_active_rate FROM device_app_activity daa JOIN brand_model_info bm ON daa.device_id = bm.device_id LEFT JOIN app_label_categories alc ON daa.app_id = alc.app_id GROUP BY bm.device_id, bm.phone_brand, bm.device_model, bm.age, bm.gender, bm.group1, daa.app_id, alc.category HAVING SUM(daa.is_active) > 95 ) SELECT am.phone_brand, am.device_model, am.gender, am.group1, am.category, COUNT(DISTINCT am.device_id) AS unique_devices, SUM(am.event_count) AS total_events, SUM(am.total_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(am.total_active) AS total_actives, AVG(am.avg_active_rate) AS overall_active_rate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY am.age) AS median_age FROM aggregated_metrics am WHERE am.age BETWEEN 41 AND 22 GROUP BY am.phone_brand, am.device_model, am.gender, am.group1, am.category HAVING SUM(am.total_active) >= 729 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, total_actives DESC LIMIT 157;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps_installed, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = ga.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_event_count, (SELECT AVG(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = ga.device_id) AS avg_f23_submission, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS app_install_rank_in_group, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY pbdm.phone_brand) AS total_apps_per_brand FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 38 AND ga.age <= 79 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.longitude IS NOT NULL AND er.latitude IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app_events_relevant aer WHERE aer.event_id = e.event_id AND aer.is_installed = 1) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 48 AND AVG(e.latitude) BETWEEN 44.02 AND 83.98 ORDER BY total_apps_installed DESC, avg_latitude ASC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -179.68 AND -134.15 AND ga.age >= 33 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 667 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -172.07 AND 37.17 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -10.46 AND 62.51 AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 43 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, AVG(ss.f23) AS avg_f23, AVG(ss.f24_26) AS avg_f24_26, AVG(ss.f27_28) AS avg_f27_28, AVG(ss.f29_32) AS avg_f29_32, AVG(ss.f33_42) AS avg_f33_42, AVG(ss.f43) AS avg_f43, AVG(ss.m22) AS avg_m22, AVG(ss.m23_26) AS avg_m23_26, AVG(ss.m27_28) AS avg_m27_28, AVG(ss.m29_31) AS avg_m29_31, AVG(ss.m32_38) AS avg_m32_38, AVG(ss.m39) AS avg_m39 FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 28 AND ga.age <= 41 AND e.longitude >= 148.76 AND e.longitude <= -12.36 AND e.latitude >= 19.77 AND e.latitude <= -34.35 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 340 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 192 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 79 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id), 0)::numeric AS active_app_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_in_group, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.device_id ORDER BY MIN(e.timestamp)) AS prev_event_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 38 AND ga.age <= 35 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -53.99 AND -132.19 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 17.79 AND -21.24 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 722 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 93 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude, avg_latitude;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = ga.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e2.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_event_count, (SELECT AVG(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = ga.device_id AND s.f23 > '0.0') AS avg_f23_sample FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 54 AND ga.age <= 63 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -26.61 AND 21.69 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 17.25 AND -22.77 AND ae.is_installed > 1 AND (pbdm.phone_brand LIKE 'A' OR pbdm.device_model LIKE 'A') GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 228 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 39 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 710 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 37 AND ga.age <= 24 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -134.06 AND -63.72 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -13.7 AND 20.1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 966 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 100 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC LIMIT 505;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, a.app_id AS app_all_id, al.label_id, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.longitude > 36.66 AND e.latitude < 2.66) AS geo_filtered_events, SUM(ae.is_installed * ae.is_active) AS installed_active_product FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON a.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age BETWEEN 28 AND 24 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, ae.app_id, a.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category), (ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model), (ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand), (ga.gender, pbdm.phone_brand, lc.category), (lc.category, ae.app_id), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 588 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 11 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude ASC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 42 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 14 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 31 AND ga.age <= 25 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -178.02 AND -13.87 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 72.96 AND 22.82 AND ae.is_installed = 0 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 288 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 393 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pb.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age BETWEEN 63 AND 33 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pb.phone_brand), (ga.gender, ga.age, pb.phone_brand), (ga.gender, pb.phone_brand), (ga.age), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 10 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installed, GROUPING(ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand) AS grouping_id FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 58 AND ga.age <= 40 GROUP BY CUBE(ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand), ga.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 98 ORDER BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, AVG(lc.label_id) AS avg_label_id, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(pb.phone_brand) AS sample_brand, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installed, COUNT(*) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.longitude > 106.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_longitude_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 77 AND ga.age <= 54 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 853 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 4 UNION ALL SELECT gat.device_id, 'unknown' AS gender, 'unknown' AS group1, COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN aer.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al2.label_id) AS total_labels, AVG(lc2.label_id) AS avg_label_id, MAX(er.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(pb2.phone_brand) AS sample_brand, SUM(aer.is_installed) AS total_installed, COUNT(*) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN er.longitude > -46.15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_longitude_events, AVG(er.latitude) AS avg_latitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY er.longitude) AS median_longitude FROM gender_age_test gat JOIN events_relevant er ON gat.device_id = er.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON er.event_id = aer.event_id JOIN app_labels al2 ON aer.app_id = al2.app_id JOIN label_categories lc2 ON al2.label_id = lc2.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb2 ON gat.device_id = pb2.device_id WHERE er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND er.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY gat.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT aer.app_id) > 897 AND SUM(aer.is_installed) >= 68 ORDER BY total_apps DESC, event_count DESC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -7.33 AND -162.84 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -0.67 AND -34.37 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_labels al WHERE al.app_id = ae.app_id) AS label_count FROM app_events ae WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 ), aggregated_device_info AS ( SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN aer.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id LEFT JOIN events_relevant re ON ga.device_id = re.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON re.event_id = aer.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 61 AND ga.age <= 80 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) > 997 ) SELECT adi.device_id, adi.age, adi.gender, adi.group1, adi.phone_brand, adi.device_model, adi.total_events, adi.active_app_events, (SELECT AVG(age) FROM gender_age_train WHERE gender = adi.gender AND group1 = adi.group1) AS avg_age_by_demographic, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT app_id) FROM device_app_activity daa JOIN ranked_events re ON daa.event_id = re.event_id WHERE re.device_id = adi.device_id AND daa.label_count > 50) AS unique_apps_with_labels, (SELECT SUM(f23 + f24_26 + f27_28 + f29_32 + f33_42 + f43 + m22 + m23_26 + m27_28 + m29_31 + m32_38 + m39) FROM sample_submission ss WHERE ss.device_id = adi.device_id) AS total_submission_score FROM aggregated_device_info adi JOIN ranked_events re ON adi.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 ORDER BY adi.total_events DESC, adi.active_app_events DESC LIMIT 599;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 52.22 AND -136.5 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 18.91 AND 41.53 AND ae.is_active = 0 AND ga.age >= 61 AND ga.age <= 30 ), aggregated_stats AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT re.label_id) AS distinct_labels, SUM(re.is_installed) AS total_installed, AVG(re.age) AS avg_age, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(re.timestamp) AS first_event_time, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.latitude) AS median_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 100 GROUP BY re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 870 ), windowed_analysis AS ( SELECT as1.device_id, as1.phone_brand, as1.device_model, as1.gender, as1.group1, as1.distinct_apps, as1.distinct_labels, as1.total_installed, as1.avg_age, as1.last_event_time, as1.first_event_time, as1.median_longitude, as1.median_latitude, SUM(as1.distinct_apps) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.phone_brand, as1.gender ORDER BY as1.avg_age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_apps_by_brand_gender, AVG(as1.distinct_labels) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.device_model, as1.group1) AS avg_labels_by_model_group, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY as1.group1 ORDER BY as1.total_installed DESC) AS rank_installed_in_group FROM aggregated_stats as1 JOIN events_relevant er ON as1.device_id = er.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON er.event_id = aer.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON aer.app_id = aa.app_id WHERE er.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND er.timestamp <= '2016-01-01' AND aer.is_installed = 0 ) SELECT wa.phone_brand, wa.device_model, wa.gender, wa.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT wa.device_id) AS device_count, AVG(wa.distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, AVG(wa.distinct_labels) AS avg_distinct_labels, SUM(wa.total_installed) AS total_installed_sum, MAX(wa.avg_age) AS max_avg_age, MIN(wa.avg_age) AS min_avg_age, MAX(wa.cumulative_apps_by_brand_gender) AS max_cumulative_apps, AVG(wa.avg_labels_by_model_group) AS overall_avg_labels, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wa.rank_installed_in_group = 1) AS top_installed_devices FROM windowed_analysis wa GROUP BY wa.phone_brand, wa.device_model, wa.gender, wa.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT wa.device_id) > 16 AND AVG(wa.distinct_apps) >= 28.12 ORDER BY device_count DESC, total_installed_sum DESC LIMIT 381;

WITH device_aggregates AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installed, COUNT(*) AS total_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 25 AND g.age <= 69 ), app_label_analysis AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 3 ), device_app_label_summary AS ( SELECT da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active, da.total_installed, da.total_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, da.first_event, da.last_event, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ala.app_id) AS apps_with_many_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ala.label_categories, ' | ') AS aggregated_categories FROM device_aggregates da JOIN device_demographics dd ON da.device_id = dd.device_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON da.device_id = ae2.event_id JOIN app_label_analysis ala ON ae2.app_id = ala.app_id GROUP BY da.device_id, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active, da.total_installed, da.total_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, da.first_event, da.last_event, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model ) SELECT gender, group1, phone_brand, device_model, COUNT(device_id) AS device_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(distinct_apps) AS avg_distinct_apps, AVG(total_active) AS avg_total_active, AVG(total_installed) AS avg_total_installed, SUM(total_events) AS grand_total_events, MIN(first_event) AS earliest_event, MAX(last_event) AS latest_event, AVG(avg_longitude) AS avg_center_longitude, AVG(avg_latitude) AS avg_center_latitude, SUM(apps_with_many_labels) AS total_apps_many_labels, MAX(aggregated_categories) AS sample_categories FROM device_app_label_summary GROUP BY gender, group1, phone_brand, device_model HAVING COUNT(device_id) > 68 AND AVG(distinct_apps) >= 39.23 ORDER BY device_count DESC, avg_distinct_apps DESC LIMIT 100;
