SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps_interacted, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(aer.is_active) FROM app_events_relevant aer JOIN events_relevant er2 ON aer.event_id = er2.event_id WHERE er2.device_id = ga.device_id AND er2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_avg_active, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY SUM(ae.is_installed) DESC) AS install_rank_in_group, LAG(ga.age, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, pbdm.phone_brand ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS prev_age_by_event_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-04-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -111.0 AND 76.94 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -60.13 AND -5.09 AND ga.age >= 56 AND ga.age <= 61 AND ae.is_installed >= 0 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 848 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 80 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) >= 58 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_installs DESC LIMIT 808;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_app_events, COUNT(DISTINCT al.app_id) AS distinct_labeled_apps, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, SUM(s.f23 + s.f24_26 + s.f27_28 + s.f29_32 + s.f33_42 + s.f43 + s.m22 + s.m23_26 + s.m27_28 + s.m29_31 + s.m32_38 + s.m39) AS total_submission_score FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission s ON ga.device_id = s.device_id WHERE ga.age >= 64 AND ga.age <= 56 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-10 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 19.06 AND -171.1 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 43.94 AND 59.59 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 73 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 19 ORDER BY total_events DESC, avg_longitude, avg_latitude;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND (e.longitude > -94.56 OR e.latitude < 13.89) AND ga.age BETWEEN 54 AND 59 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbd WHERE pbd.device_id = ga.device_id AND pbd.phone_brand = 'Xiaomi' ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 36 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age >= 34 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand), (ga.gender, ga.age), (ga.gender), () ) ORDER BY ga.gender, ga.age, distinct_apps_installed DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp < '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND e.latitude BETWEEN -47.1 AND 3.65 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 28 ORDER BY unique_apps_installed DESC, avg_latitude;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS categories, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id), 0) AS active_app_percentage, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_demographic FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -173.24 AND 48.89 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 15.99 AND 0.86 AND (pbdm.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' OR pbdm.device_model LIKE '%Galaxy%') AND ga.age >= 23 AND ga.age <= 48 AND ga.gender IN ('F', 'F') AND ga.group1 LIKE 'F%' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 873 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 9 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 587 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(e.latitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, ga.device_id LIMIT 1891;

WITH device_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-06-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 29 AND ga.age <= 51 ), app_stats AS ( SELECT de.device_id, de.app_id, de.age, de.gender, de.phone_brand, COUNT(*) AS event_count, SUM(de.is_active) AS active_sum, AVG(de.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(de.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM device_events de GROUP BY de.device_id, de.app_id, de.age, de.gender, de.phone_brand ), window_stats AS ( SELECT as1.device_id, as1.app_id, as1.age, as1.gender, as1.phone_brand, as1.event_count, as1.active_sum, as1.avg_longitude, as1.avg_latitude, AVG(as1.event_count) OVER ( PARTITION BY as1.gender, as1.phone_brand ORDER BY as1.age ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_events, SUM(as1.active_sum) OVER ( PARTITION BY as1.gender ORDER BY as1.age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_active FROM app_stats as1 WHERE as1.event_count > 2 ) SELECT ws.gender, ws.phone_brand, ws.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.app_id) AS unique_apps, AVG(ws.event_count) AS avg_events_per_device, AVG(ws.moving_avg_events) AS avg_moving_window, MAX(ws.cumulative_active) AS max_cumulative_active, AVG(ws.avg_longitude) AS overall_avg_longitude, AVG(ws.avg_latitude) AS overall_avg_latitude FROM window_stats ws GROUP BY ws.gender, ws.phone_brand, ws.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ws.device_id) >= 24 AND AVG(ws.event_count) > 4.24 ORDER BY ws.gender, ws.phone_brand, ws.age;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 81.81 AND -148.92 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -64.94 AND 73.39 AND ae.is_active = 1 AND ga.age >= 5 AND ga.age <= 10 ), aggregated_stats AS ( SELECT re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT re.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT re.label_id) AS distinct_labels, SUM(re.is_installed) AS total_installs, AVG(re.age) AS avg_age, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(re.timestamp) AS first_event_time, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY re.latitude) AS median_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 604 GROUP BY re.device_id, re.phone_brand, re.device_model, re.gender, re.group1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 65 ), window_analysis AS ( SELECT as1.device_id, as1.phone_brand, as1.device_model, as1.gender, as1.group1, as1.distinct_apps, as1.distinct_labels, as1.total_installs, as1.avg_age, as1.last_event_time, as1.first_event_time, as1.median_longitude, as1.median_latitude, AVG(as1.distinct_apps) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.phone_brand, as1.gender) AS avg_apps_by_brand_gender, SUM(as1.total_installs) OVER (PARTITION BY as1.device_model, as1.group1 ORDER BY as1.last_event_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_installs, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY as1.group1 ORDER BY as1.distinct_labels DESC) AS label_rank FROM aggregated_stats as1 WHERE as1.avg_age > 80.63 ) SELECT wa.device_id, wa.phone_brand, wa.device_model, wa.gender, wa.group1, wa.distinct_apps, wa.distinct_labels, wa.total_installs, wa.avg_age, wa.last_event_time, wa.first_event_time, wa.median_longitude, wa.median_latitude, wa.avg_apps_by_brand_gender, wa.cumulative_installs, wa.label_rank, ss.f23, ss.f24_26, ss.f27_28, ss.f29_32, ss.f33_42, ss.f43, ss.m22, ss.m23_26, ss.m27_28, ss.m29_31, ss.m32_38, ss.m39 FROM window_analysis wa LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON wa.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE wa.label_rank <= 30 AND wa.cumulative_installs >= 1616 ORDER BY wa.label_rank, wa.cumulative_installs DESC LIMIT 821;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id), 0)::numeric AS active_app_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_in_group FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 131.62 AND -7.98 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -67.89 AND 63.75 AND ga.age BETWEEN 66 AND 77 AND ga.device_id IN ( SELECT device_id FROM gender_age_train WHERE age > 77 AND gender = 'F' ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 389 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 93 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 310 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC LIMIT 847;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = ga.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(s.f23) FROM sample_submission s WHERE s.device_id = ga.device_id) AS avg_f23, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_in_group, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ae.is_active) DESC) AS active_dense_rank, LAG(ga.age, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender ORDER BY ga.device_id) AS prev_age, LEAD(pbdm.phone_brand, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY pbdm.device_model ORDER BY ga.device_id) AS next_phone_brand FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 18 AND ga.age <= 48 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 138.24 AND -105.72 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 67.57 AND 61.13 AND ae.is_installed >= 0 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 754 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 46 ORDER BY total_events DESC, active_count DESC LIMIT 1038;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_event_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 42 AND ga.age <= 40 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 90 ORDER BY distinct_app_count DESC, ga.device_id;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -154.02 AND 89.03 AND g.age >= 24 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 4 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

e.longitude BETWEEN 3.63 AND 79.67 OR e.latitude NOT BETWEEN 64.08 AND -40.73 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, CASE WHEN ga.age < 20 THEN 'Teen' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 20 AND 35 THEN 'Young Adult' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN 'Middle Aged' ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_group, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(ae.is_active)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id), 2) ELSE 0 END AS active_app_ratio FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 44 AND ga.age <= 26 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -116.7 AND -129.14 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -20.64 AND 3.95 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 48 ORDER BY total_events DESC, active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 32 AND ga.age <= 37 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -22.36 AND 32.52 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 87.07 AND -51.62 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 936 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 53 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, AVG(ae.is_active) AS avg_active FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND ga.age >= 56 GROUP BY CUBE(ga.group1, pb.phone_brand) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 538 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

WITH combined_events AS ( SELECT e.event_id, e.device_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude FROM events e UNION ALL SELECT er.event_id, er.device_id, er.timestamp, er.longitude, er.latitude FROM events_relevant er ), app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.event_id, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active FROM app_events ae UNION ALL SELECT aer.event_id, aer.app_id, aer.is_installed, aer.is_active FROM app_events_relevant aer ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT gat.device_id, gat.age, gat.gender, gat.group1 FROM gender_age_train gat UNION ALL SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1 FROM gender_age ga ) SELECT dd.gender, dd.group1, lc.category, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(aa.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(aa.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(dd.age) AS avg_age, MIN(ce.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(ce.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM combined_events ce JOIN app_activity aa ON ce.event_id = aa.event_id JOIN device_demographics dd ON ce.device_id = dd.device_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ce.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE ce.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ce.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND dd.age >= 54 AND dd.age <= 61 AND ce.longitude BETWEEN 139.5 AND -77.48 AND ce.latitude BETWEEN -40.06 AND 80.52 GROUP BY dd.gender, dd.group1, lc.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) > 3 AND SUM(aa.is_installed) >= 1002 ORDER BY unique_devices DESC, total_events DESC LIMIT 877;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS distinct_event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_label_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_category_count, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS distinct_active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS distinct_installed_apps FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 43 AND ga.age <= 41 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 146.08 AND 66.59 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -73.64 AND 52.37 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 19 ORDER BY distinct_event_count DESC, distinct_app_count DESC, ga.device_id;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.app_id IN (SELECT app_id FROM app_labels WHERE label_id = 839) AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING SUM(ae.is_installed) > 13 ORDER BY total_active DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 64 AND ga.age <= 56 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model), (ga.gender, ga.age), (pbdm.phone_brand), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 1 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

WITH device_activity AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 AND ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 'active_installed' WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 'installed_only' ELSE 'inactive' END AS app_status, CASE WHEN ga.age < 20 THEN 'teen' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 20 AND 35 THEN 'young_adult' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN 'middle_aged' ELSE 'senior' END AS age_group, CASE WHEN lc.category IN ('Social', 'Communication') THEN 'social_category' WHEN lc.category IN ('Game', 'Entertainment') THEN 'entertainment_category' ELSE 'other_category' END AS app_category_group FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-02 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -92.02 AND 3.5 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -19.16 AND 28.11 AND ga.age >= 32 ) SELECT da.phone_brand, da.device_model, da.gender, da.age_group, da.app_category_group, COUNT(DISTINCT da.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT da.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN da.app_status = 'active_installed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_installed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN da.app_status = 'installed_only' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_only_count, AVG(da.age) AS avg_age, MIN(da.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(da.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM device_activity da GROUP BY da.phone_brand, da.device_model, da.gender, da.age_group, da.app_category_group HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT da.event_id) > 5930 AND COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) >= 656 ORDER BY total_events DESC, unique_devices DESC LIMIT 841;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS related_event_count, AVG(e2.longitude - e1.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e2.latitude - e1.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.timestamp < e2.timestamp AND e1.event_id != e2.event_id WHERE e1.longitude BETWEEN -114.7 AND -91.91 AND e1.latitude BETWEEN -24.43 AND 87.62 AND e2.timestamp >= e1.timestamp + INTERVAL '716 hour' GROUP BY e1.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) > 43 ORDER BY related_event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.is_active = 1 AND ga.age >= 21 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 2 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 AND lc.category = 'Game' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) <= 18;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -4.27 AND 89.61 AND ga.age >= 46 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 32 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 45 ORDER BY unique_app_count DESC, total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand, ', ' ORDER BY pb.phone_brand) AS phone_brands, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 25 AND ga.age <= 56 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 39 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_in_group, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, pbdm.phone_brand) AS gender_brand_total_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 47 AND ga.age <= 31 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 27.94 AND -57.8 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 12.32 AND 54.37 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 912 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 5 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 37 AND ga.age <= 36 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 46 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) FROM app_labels al WHERE al.app_id = ae.app_id) AS app_label_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01' AND ga.age >= 50 AND ga.age <= 22 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, ae.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 7 ORDER BY total_apps DESC, active_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age > 52 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 24 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, pb.phone_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 47 AND ga.age <= 31 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, pb.phone_brand), (ga.age, ga.gender, pb.phone_brand), (ga.gender, pb.phone_brand), (pb.phone_brand), ()) ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.app_id) AS distinct_apps, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand, ', ') AS brands FROM gender_age ga LEFT JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE ga.age >= 34 AND ga.age <= 18 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 93 ORDER BY total_active DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_count, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-06-01 00:00:00' AND g.age >= 51 AND g.age <= 24 AND e.longitude IS NOT NULL AND e.latitude IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 96 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, SUM(ae.is_active) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ae.is_installed), 0) AS active_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.gender, ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) DESC) AS app_rank_by_demographic, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_overall, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ga.device_id ORDER BY MIN(e.timestamp)) AS prev_app_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 18 AND ga.age <= 41 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 75.12 AND 78.24 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 11.54 AND 41.34 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) >= 46 ORDER BY total_apps DESC, total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age > 35 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 15 ORDER BY active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 24 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -108.46 AND 52.63 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 20 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC, avg_latitude ASC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -39.21 AND 63.12 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 p WHERE p.device_id = g.device_id AND p.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 48 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) DESC) AS event_rank_by_group FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 29 AND ga.age <= 39 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 19.95 AND -157.78 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 16.12 AND 7.42 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 243 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 67 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

WITH device_activity AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, ae.app_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, al.label_id, lc.category, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 AND ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 'active_installed' WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 'installed_only' ELSE 'inactive' END AS app_status, CASE WHEN ga.age < 20 THEN 'teen' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 20 AND 35 THEN 'young_adult' WHEN ga.age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN 'middle_aged' ELSE 'senior' END AS age_group, CASE WHEN lc.category IN ('Social', 'Communication') THEN 'social_category' WHEN lc.category IN ('Game', 'Entertainment') THEN 'entertainment_category' ELSE 'other_category' END AS app_category_group FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age ga ON e.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON e.device_id = pbd.device_id LEFT JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-02 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -46.29 AND 41.17 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -23.86 AND 17.28 AND ga.age >= 11 ) SELECT da.phone_brand, da.device_model, da.gender, da.age_group, da.app_category_group, COUNT(DISTINCT da.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) AS unique_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT da.app_id) AS unique_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN da.app_status = 'active_installed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_installed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN da.app_status = 'installed_only' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_only_count, AVG(da.age) AS avg_age, MIN(da.timestamp) AS first_event_time, MAX(da.timestamp) AS last_event_time FROM device_activity da GROUP BY da.phone_brand, da.device_model, da.gender, da.age_group, da.app_category_group HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT da.event_id) > 1101 AND COUNT(DISTINCT da.device_id) >= 690 ORDER BY total_events DESC, unique_devices DESC LIMIT 525;

SELECT e1.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) AS related_event_count, AVG(e2.longitude - e1.longitude) AS avg_longitude_diff, AVG(e2.latitude - e1.latitude) AS avg_latitude_diff FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.event_id != e2.event_id JOIN app_events ae ON e2.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e1.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e2.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e1.longitude > 135.96 GROUP BY e1.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e2.event_id) > 60 ORDER BY related_event_count DESC;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand, ', ' ORDER BY pb.phone_brand) AS phone_brands, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON g.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND g.age BETWEEN 27 AND 57 GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 43 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS distinct_event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_label_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_category_count, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS distinct_active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS distinct_installed_apps FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age >= 51 AND ga.age <= 59 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 71.67 AND 142.63 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -30.29 AND 42.72 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 298 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 386 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(e.latitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY distinct_event_count DESC, total_active DESC, ga.device_id LIMIT 1525;

SELECT g.device_id, g.gender, g.age, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age g JOIN events e ON g.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 42.93 AND 128.17 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 p WHERE p.device_id = g.device_id AND p.phone_brand LIKE '%Samsung%' LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY g.device_id, g.gender, g.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 77 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand, ', ') AS phone_brands, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pb.device_model, ', ') AS device_models, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ') AS label_categories, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, (MAX(e.timestamp) - MIN(e.timestamp)) AS event_time_span, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id), 0.0) AS active_event_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS installed_distinct_apps FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -109.78 AND -104.84 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 30.41 AND -53.53 AND ga.age >= 61 AND ga.age <= 32 AND (ga.gender LIKE 'F' OR ga.group1 LIKE 'F23-') AND (pb.phone_brand LIKE 'samsung' OR pb.device_model LIKE 'GT-') AND lc.category LIKE 'Game' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 498 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 197 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) >= 912 AND AVG(e.longitude) BETWEEN -10.87 AND 64.32 AND AVG(e.latitude) BETWEEN 32.48 AND 65.7 ORDER BY total_events DESC, distinct_apps DESC, total_installs DESC LIMIT 906;

WITH device_activity AS ( SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 9 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age BETWEEN 28 AND 32 ), app_label_analysis AS ( SELECT al.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, '; ') AS label_categories FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id GROUP BY al.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lc.label_id) > 7 ) SELECT da.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT aae.app_id) AS relevant_apps_installed, SUM(aae.is_installed) AS total_installed_flags, AVG(ala.distinct_labels) AS avg_labels_per_app, MAX(ala.label_categories) AS sample_categories, COALESCE(ss.f23, 0) AS submission_f23 FROM device_activity da JOIN device_demographics dd ON da.device_id = dd.device_id LEFT JOIN events_relevant er ON da.device_id = er.device_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant aae ON er.event_id = aae.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_analysis ala ON aae.app_id = ala.app_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON da.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE da.total_active_events > 537 AND da.avg_longitude BETWEEN -25.18 AND 85.84 GROUP BY da.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, da.distinct_apps, da.total_active_events, da.avg_longitude, da.avg_latitude, ss.f23 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT aae.app_id) > 8 ORDER BY da.total_active_events DESC, da.distinct_apps DESC LIMIT 315;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN 105.67 AND -29.73 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -28.95 AND 36.45 ), device_app_activity AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae INNER JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_active = 1 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al LEFT JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g LEFT JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 66 AND g.age <= 19 ), sample_aggregates AS ( SELECT ss.device_id, AVG(ss.f23) AS avg_f23, SUM(ss.m22) AS sum_m22 FROM sample_submission ss GROUP BY ss.device_id HAVING AVG(ss.f23) > '0.0' ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, re.timestamp AS last_event_time, re.longitude, re.latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.label_id) AS distinct_label_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ald.category, ', ' ORDER BY ald.category) AS label_categories, SUM(daa.is_active) AS total_active_apps, sa.avg_f23, sa.sum_m22, CASE WHEN dd.age < 30 THEN 'Young' WHEN dd.age BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle' ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_group FROM device_demographics dd INNER JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN events_relevant er ON re.event_id = er.event_id LEFT JOIN app_events_relevant aer ON er.event_id = aer.event_id LEFT JOIN device_app_activity daa ON aer.app_id = daa.app_id AND aer.event_id = daa.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON daa.app_id = ald.app_id LEFT JOIN sample_aggregates sa ON dd.device_id = sa.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_train gat ON dd.device_id = gat.device_id LEFT JOIN gender_age_test gatest ON dd.device_id = gatest.device_id WHERE dd.gender = 'F' GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, re.timestamp, re.longitude, re.latitude, sa.avg_f23, sa.sum_m22 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT daa.app_id) >= 57 AND SUM(daa.is_active) > 25 ORDER BY total_active_apps DESC, distinct_app_count DESC LIMIT 1960;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_and_active_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 AND ae.is_active = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_but_inactive_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS distinct_installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN ae.app_id END) AS distinct_active_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN lc.category = 'Games' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS game_labels, SUM(CASE WHEN lc.category = 'Social' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS social_labels, SUM(CASE WHEN lc.category = 'Utility' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS utility_labels, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 65 AND ga.age <= 63 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 127.43 AND -47.58 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -78.45 AND -28.78 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 712 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 334 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 54 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, AVG(ae.is_active) AS avg_activity_level FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -109.56 AND 171.01 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm WHERE pbdm.device_id = ga.device_id AND pbdm.phone_brand = 'Apple' LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 41 ORDER BY distinct_app_count DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pb.phone_brand, pb.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 95 AND AVG(e.latitude) < -0.45 EXCEPT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS installed_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_apps, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.longitude) AS median_longitude, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.latitude) AS median_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 36 AND ga.age <= 45 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 74 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_app_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS installed_app_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS distinct_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.phone_brand) AS distinct_phone_brands, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.device_model) AS distinct_device_models, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 AND ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_installed_events, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 0 AND ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inactive_installed_events FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_all aa ON ae.app_id = aa.app_id JOIN app_labels al ON aa.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pb ON ga.device_id = pb.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 4.83 AND -50.28 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 68.43 AND -13.92 AND ga.age >= 47 AND ga.age <= 11 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 777 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 6067 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

SELECT pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, gat.gender, gat.group1, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(gat.age) AS avg_age FROM phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm JOIN gender_age_train gat ON pbdm.device_id = gat.device_id JOIN events e ON gat.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE pbdm.phone_brand LIKE 'Samsung' AND gat.age BETWEEN 33 AND 39 AND lc.category LIKE 'Game' GROUP BY pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, gat.gender, gat.group1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 57 ORDER BY total_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps_interacted, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.device_id = ga.device_id AND e2.timestamp >= (SELECT MIN(timestamp) FROM events WHERE device_id = ga.device_id) + INTERVAL '323 days') AS events_after_offset_days, (SELECT AVG(sub.avg_price) FROM (SELECT ae2.app_id, AVG(ae2.is_active) AS avg_price FROM app_events ae2 WHERE ae2.app_id IN (SELECT app_id FROM app_events WHERE event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM events WHERE device_id = ga.device_id)) GROUP BY ae2.app_id HAVING AVG(ae2.is_active) > 0.71) sub) AS avg_active_rate_above_threshold FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '10 months') AND e.timestamp < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND e.longitude BETWEEN -71.46 AND 23.81 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 47.69 AND -30.63 AND ga.age >= 73 AND ga.age <= 85 AND (EXTRACT(DOW FROM e.timestamp) IN (4, 5) OR EXTRACT(HOUR FROM e.timestamp) BETWEEN 17 AND 20) GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 358 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 79 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 403 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps_interacted DESC LIMIT 895;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS unique_apps_installed, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -139.74 AND 59.34 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 92 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 790 ORDER BY unique_apps_installed DESC, total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp) AS event_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp) AS event_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.timestamp) AS event_month, EXTRACT(WEEK FROM e.timestamp) AS event_week, EXTRACT(DOY FROM e.timestamp) AS event_day_of_year, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON ga.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN -126.14 AND -160.33 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 54.88 AND 82.35 AND ga.age >= 100 AND ga.age <= 49 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(WEEK FROM e.timestamp), EXTRACT(DOY FROM e.timestamp) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 183 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 134 AND SUM(ae.is_installed) > 35 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, total_installs DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_installed) AS total_installs, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_actives, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lc.category, ', ' ORDER BY lc.category) AS label_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_relevant er WHERE er.device_id = ga.device_id AND er.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND er.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_events_count, (SELECT AVG(aer.is_active) FROM app_events_relevant aer JOIN events_relevant er2 ON aer.event_id = er2.event_id WHERE er2.device_id = ga.device_id AND er2.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND er2.timestamp <= '2016-05-01 00:00:00') AS recent_active_ratio FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE (ga.age >= 39 AND ga.age <= 64) AND (ga.gender = 'F' OR ga.group1 LIKE 'F23%') AND (e.longitude BETWEEN 70.96 AND -19.08 OR e.latitude BETWEEN -32.84 AND 72.45) AND e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gender_age_test gat WHERE gat.device_id = ga.device_id) AND ae.is_installed = 1 AND (pbdm.phone_brand IN ('samsung', 'samsung') OR pbdm.device_model LIKE 'SM-%') GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 568 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 14 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 16 AND AVG(e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(e.latitude) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC, ga.age ASC LIMIT 511;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS total_labels, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, MAX(e.timestamp) AS last_event_time, MIN(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_installed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_installed_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT lc.category) AS total_categories FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-02 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 25 AND ga.age <= 63 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -178.37 AND 173.18 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -39.26 AND 62.28 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 4 AND SUM(ae.is_active) > 10 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_active_apps DESC LIMIT 149;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_apps_installed, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels_used, SUM(CASE WHEN ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_events_count FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id WHERE ga.age > 55 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 2 ORDER BY distinct_apps_installed DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS distinct_app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbd ON ga.device_id = pbd.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE ga.age BETWEEN 36 AND 40 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01' AND e.longitude > -162.51 AND e.latitude < 51.2 AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbd.phone_brand, pbd.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 16 ORDER BY event_count DESC, total_active_events DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_events, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-05-16 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 20 AND ga.age <= 56 AND lc.category = 'Games' GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 14 ORDER BY total_active_events DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pbdm.phone_brand, ', ') AS brands FROM gender_age ga JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 57 AND ga.age <= 39 AND e.longitude BETWEEN -167.3 AND 123.67 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -29.56 AND 8.22 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 63 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 98 INTERSECT SELECT ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) AS event_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_labels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pbdm.phone_brand, ', ') AS brands FROM gender_age_train ga JOIN events_relevant e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events_relevant ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.timestamp <= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND ga.age >= 59 AND ga.age <= 38 AND e.longitude BETWEEN 172.91 AND -107.39 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 64.91 AND 29.24 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.age, ga.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.event_id) > 84 AND SUM(ae.is_active) >= 33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) > 100 ORDER BY event_count DESC, total_active DESC;

SELECT e1.device_id, e1.longitude, e1.latitude, e2.longitude AS other_longitude, e2.latitude AS other_latitude, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ae1.app_id) AS installed_apps_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae1.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_apps_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ae2.app_id) AS other_installed_apps_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ae2.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_active_apps_count, COUNT(DISTINCT al.label_id) AS distinct_label_count, AVG(lc.label_id) AS avg_label_id, SUM(ss.f23 + ss.f24_26 + ss.f27_28 + ss.f29_32 + ss.f33_42 + ss.f43 + ss.m22 + ss.m23_26 + ss.m27_28 + ss.m29_31 + ss.m32_38 + ss.m39) AS total_submission_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ga.group1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ae1.app_id) DESC) AS install_rank_in_group, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT ae1.app_id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY e1.device_id ORDER BY e1.timestamp) AS prev_install_count FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e1.device_id = e2.device_id AND e1.event_id <> e2.event_id AND e1.timestamp < e2.timestamp JOIN gender_age ga ON e1.device_id = ga.device_id JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON e1.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN app_events ae1 ON e1.event_id = ae1.event_id JOIN app_events ae2 ON e2.event_id = ae2.event_id JOIN app_labels al ON ae1.app_id = al.app_id JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id LEFT JOIN sample_submission ss ON e1.device_id = ss.device_id WHERE e1.longitude BETWEEN -46.99 AND -27.39 AND e1.latitude BETWEEN 62.09 AND 87.03 AND e2.timestamp >= e1.timestamp + INTERVAL '234 days' AND ga.age >= 64 AND ga.age <= 47 AND ae1.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY e1.device_id, e1.longitude, e1.latitude, e2.longitude, e2.latitude, ga.age, ga.gender, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, e1.timestamp HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae1.app_id) > 681 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae1.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 604 ORDER BY installed_apps_count DESC, total_submission_score DESC;

SELECT ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS total_apps, SUM(ae.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(e.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(e.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM gender_age ga JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 pbdm ON ga.device_id = pbdm.device_id JOIN events e ON ga.device_id = e.device_id JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE ga.age > 53 AND e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude BETWEEN 65.5 AND 124.19 AND e.latitude BETWEEN -60.16 AND -61.93 AND ae.is_installed = 1 GROUP BY ga.device_id, ga.gender, ga.age, ga.group1, pbdm.phone_brand, pbdm.device_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) >= 10 ORDER BY total_events DESC, total_apps DESC;

WITH ranked_events AS ( SELECT e.device_id, e.event_id, e.timestamp, e.longitude, e.latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.longitude BETWEEN -116.44 AND 157.88 AND e.latitude BETWEEN 0.4 AND 59.15 ), device_app_stats AS ( SELECT ae.app_id, ae.event_id, ae.is_installed, ae.is_active, a.app_id AS app_all_id FROM app_events ae JOIN app_all a ON ae.app_id = a.app_id WHERE ae.is_installed = 1 ), app_label_details AS ( SELECT al.app_id, al.label_id, lc.category FROM app_labels al JOIN label_categories lc ON al.label_id = lc.label_id WHERE lc.label_id > 488 ), device_demographics AS ( SELECT g.device_id, g.age, g.gender, g.group1, p.phone_brand, p.device_model FROM gender_age g JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 p ON g.device_id = p.device_id WHERE g.age >= 51 AND g.gender = 'F' ), event_aggregates AS ( SELECT re.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT re.event_id) AS total_events, MAX(re.timestamp) AS last_event_time, AVG(re.longitude) AS avg_longitude, AVG(re.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM ranked_events re WHERE re.rn <= 48 GROUP BY re.device_id ) SELECT dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude, COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) AS distinct_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT ald.category) AS distinct_categories, SUM(das.is_active) AS total_active_apps, AVG(dd.age) OVER (PARTITION BY dd.phone_brand) AS avg_age_by_brand, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ea.total_events DESC) AS event_rank FROM device_demographics dd JOIN event_aggregates ea ON dd.device_id = ea.device_id LEFT JOIN ranked_events re ON dd.device_id = re.device_id AND re.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN device_app_stats das ON re.event_id = das.event_id LEFT JOIN app_label_details ald ON das.app_id = ald.app_id WHERE ea.total_events > 44 GROUP BY dd.device_id, dd.age, dd.gender, dd.group1, dd.phone_brand, dd.device_model, ea.total_events, ea.last_event_time, ea.avg_longitude, ea.avg_latitude HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT das.app_id) >= 34 ORDER BY event_rank, dd.device_id LIMIT 8864;

SELECT e.device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) AS app_count, SUM(ae.is_active) AS active_sum, AVG(g.age) AS avg_age FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id JOIN gender_age g ON e.device_id = g.device_id WHERE e.timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND e.longitude > -49.92 GROUP BY e.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.app_id) > 39 AND SUM(ae.is_active) < 452 ORDER BY app_count DESC;
